title: Emerald Blouse And Cream Saree Portrait With Mehndi
description: This prompt turns your photo into a waist-up traditional portrait built around a deep emerald green short-sleeve blouse with gold floral embroidery, worn with a cream and off-white saree carrying small gold motifs. Round sunglasses with thin gold frames, a delicate gold necklace, a slim gold watch and red mehndi patterns on the left hand and forearm complete the styling. The subject is posed lightly touching her long, wavy dark hair with one hand while looking slightly away from the lens with a soft smile. The background is a smooth, fully blurred beige wall, and soft out-of-focus shapes in the corners give the feeling of shooting past foreground objects, which pulls attention to the face and the embroidery. The framing is eye level and slightly off-centre to the left, set in a tall 9:16 format that suits phone screens, Instagram stories and reels. The light is warm and even, similar to late afternoon daylight bouncing off stone. This look works well for wedding guest outfits, Diwali or Ugadi greetings, engagement functions, and a polished profile picture. The prompt asks the tool to keep your facial features exactly as they appear in your reference photo.
styleNotes: Warm, diffused daylight keeps the skin even and lets the gold embroidery catch small highlights. The palette is restrained: emerald green, cream, gold and the red-brown of the mehndi against a soft beige backdrop. A waist-up, slightly off-centre frame with corner bokeh creates depth and draws the eye straight to the face and hands.
tips: Swap the emerald blouse for maroon or navy while keeping the cream saree for a different festive mood.
Remove the sunglasses and add a small bindi if you want a more classic, traditional portrait.
Change the aspect ratio to 4:5 for an Instagram feed post instead of a 9:16 story.

title: Peach Chanderi Saree At Mysore Palace Sunrise
description: This prompt places a woman in a full-length portrait in front of the Mysore Palace in Karnataka at sunrise. She wears a pastel peach-pink Chanderi silk saree with a soft floral print and a designer blouse, standing gracefully on the open palace grounds with the full facade behind her. The prompt asks for the real palace architecture to be kept accurate: the central tower and dome, the symmetrical wings, red-toned domes, arches, balconies and carved stonework in the Indo-Saracenic style. You upload two images, a real photo of the palace for the location and a clear photo of your face for identity, and the prompt tells the tool to preserve your facial features without beautifying them. Early golden light falls across the stone, giving warm highlights on the saree and a gentle glow on the skin. The vertical 9:16 frame shows the subject from head to toe while keeping the palace recognisable. It suits a Dasara or Mysuru travel memory, a festive profile photo, a Navaratri greeting post, or a keepsake image for anyone who has visited the city. Expect best results when your face photo is sharp, front-facing and evenly lit.
styleNotes: Low-angle golden sunrise light washes the palace stone in warm amber and adds soft rim light along the saree pleats. Peach, blush pink and gold sit against sandy stone, red domes and a pale morning sky. The composition is centred and symmetrical, with the subject in the foreground and the palace wings framing her on both sides.
tips: Change the saree colour to mint green or ivory while keeping the sunrise lighting for a fresh variation.
Ask for a three-quarter length crop if you want the face and saree border to appear larger.
Replace sunrise with blue hour to get cooler skies and softer contrast on the palace.

title: Men's Travel Portrait At Mysore Palace Sunrise
description: This prompt creates a full-body travel-style portrait of a man standing confidently on the grounds of Mysore Palace during an early golden sunrise. It works with two uploads: a real photograph of the palace, used as the strict reference for the architecture, and a clear portrait of you, used as the only reference for your face, hairstyle and facial hair. The prompt insists that the palace looks like the real building, with its grand central tower and dome, symmetrical wings, royal arches, balconies and heritage carvings, rather than an invented castle. The subject is styled in smart, well-fitted clothing suited to a premium travel or fashion shoot, and the pose is upright and relaxed with a natural expression. Warm morning light falls across the facade and the open foreground, giving the scene a calm, early-day atmosphere. The vertical 9:16 format shows the person from head to shoes with the palace silhouette behind. This works well for sharing a Mysuru trip, a Dasara season post, a travel highlight cover, or a fresh profile picture with a strong sense of place. A sharp, well-lit, front-facing selfie gives the most faithful likeness.
styleNotes: Soft golden sunrise light comes in low from the side, warming the stone facade and lighting one side of the face. The palette mixes honey gold, sandstone beige and muted red domes against a pale blue morning sky. The subject stands centred in the foreground, with the palace's symmetry creating a strong, balanced backdrop.
tips: Specify an outfit such as a cream kurta with a Mysore peta for a more traditional festive look.
Move the subject slightly off-centre to show more of one palace wing and its domes.
Request a wider lens feel if you want more of the open palace grounds visible.

title: Sage Organza Saree Beside The Golden Ambari
description: In this prompt a woman stands in front of the Golden Ambari, the gold-plated royal howdah displayed inside Mysore Palace. She wears a pastel sage-green silk organza saree with a matching designer blouse, posed gracefully in a full-length frame. The prompt asks the tool to keep the Ambari as close as possible to a real reference photo you upload: its dome-shaped golden canopy with floral engravings, the small finial at the top, carved pillars, hanging golden fringes, the cream seat cushion, and the decorated golden panels around the base. Behind it are the palace's carved stone walls and arches, lit with warm museum-style lighting, and the viewing railings are kept as they appear in real life. A second upload of your face is used as the only identity reference, with instructions not to alter or beautify your features. The 9:16 vertical layout fits the full figure and the whole Ambari in one frame. This idea suits Dasara and Navaratri posts, heritage travel memories from Mysuru, cultural event invitations, and anyone who wants a traditional portrait with Karnataka's royal history in the background.
styleNotes: Warm, focused museum lighting makes the gold carvings glow while the stone walls stay in softer shadow. Sage green and cream contrast gently with rich metallic gold and beige stone. The composition places the subject beside the canopy so both remain fully visible, with the arches adding symmetry and depth.
tips: Try a deep teal or rani pink saree instead of sage for stronger contrast against the gold.
Add jasmine flowers in the hair and temple jewellery for a more traditional bridal feel.
Ask for a slightly lower camera angle to make the Ambari canopy look taller and grander.

title: Royal Golden Howdah Portrait For Men In Mysuru
description: This prompt builds a full-body portrait of a man standing in front of the Golden Ambari inside Mysore Palace. You upload a real photograph of the Ambari, which the prompt treats as a strict reference, and a portrait of yourself for facial identity. The howdah is described in detail so it stays accurate: a large gold-plated dome canopy covered in floral engravings, a small ornamental finial, carved golden pillars, hanging golden fringes, a rectangular seating platform with a cream cushion, and elaborately carved panels on the base. The palace stone wall with heritage arches sits behind it, and warm museum lighting brings out the metallic reflections. The prompt explicitly avoids adding an elephant, idols or extra décor that is not in the real display. The subject is styled in refined, well-tailored clothing and stands with a composed, confident posture. The vertical 9:16 format keeps both the person and the entire Ambari visible. It is a good fit for Dasara greetings, a heritage trip post from Mysuru, cultural pride content, or a distinctive profile image. Use a clear, evenly lit face photo for the closest likeness.
styleNotes: Directional warm spotlights pick out the gold engravings while the background arches fall into gentle shade. The palette is dominated by metallic gold, ivory and warm stone, with the outfit providing the main accent colour. The subject stands to one side so the canopy, pillars and base remain completely visible in a balanced vertical frame.
tips: Describe a specific outfit, such as an ivory silk kurta with a gold stole, to match the gold tones.
Ask for a three-quarter body crop to make the face more prominent while keeping the canopy visible.
Lower the warmth slightly if you prefer a cleaner, more neutral museum look.

title: Burgundy Banarasi Saree In The Palace Durbar Hall
description: This prompt places a woman at the exact centre of the grand interior hall of Mysore Palace, wearing a royal burgundy Banarasi silk saree with a designer blouse. The scene relies on a real interior photograph that you upload, so the tall carved pillars, ornate golden details, royal arches, balconies, golden-brown ceilings, chandeliers and geometric floor patterns stay true to the actual hall. The prompt asks the tool not to invent extra columns, staircases or decorations and to recompose the wide hall into a vertical 9:16 frame while keeping both rows of pillars and the patterned floor visible. A second upload of your face guides identity, and the instructions ask for natural skin and no beautification. The subject stands in a full-length pose with the hall's long perspective leading the eye toward her. Indoor lighting is soft and natural, matching the historic setting. This look is well suited to Dasara and Navaratri celebrations, wedding season posts, heritage travel memories from Mysuru, and a formal profile picture with a regal backdrop. A front-facing, sharp face photo helps keep the likeness accurate.
styleNotes: Soft, ambient indoor light with warm chandelier glow gives even illumination and gentle shadows between the pillars. Deep burgundy and antique gold sit against golden-brown ceilings and patterned marble floors. Strict one-point symmetry places the subject dead centre, with pillar rows converging behind her for strong depth.
tips: Swap burgundy for emerald or mustard Banarasi silk to change the mood while keeping the hall.
Request a slight low angle so the ceiling and chandeliers fill more of the upper frame.
Add a gold choker and jhumkas to match the palace's ornate gold detailing.

title: Wine Kurta Look In The Grand Palace Hall
description: In this prompt a man stands in the middle of the grand interior hall of Mysore Palace, wearing an Indo-western royal-inspired outfit led by a rich maroon or deep wine tailored kurta. The pose is full length and facing the camera, with one hand lightly adjusting a cuff or watch, the other relaxed by his side, and a subtle, composed smile. A real photo of the palace interior is used as the main environment reference, so the ultra-wide symmetrical perspective, tall carved pillars, golden-brown ceiling, arches, chandeliers and geometric floor are kept recognisable. Your own face photo is the only identity reference, and the prompt asks for no reshaping or beautifying of your features, moustache or hairline. The vertical 9:16 frame centres the subject along the hall's main perspective line so the architecture frames him on both sides. This style is well suited to festive occasions such as Dasara, Diwali or family weddings, to a heritage trip post, or to a formal, elegant profile image. For a convincing result, upload a clear, well-lit portrait taken at eye level.
styleNotes: Warm interior lighting from chandeliers and windows creates soft highlights on the kurta fabric and polished floor. The palette pairs deep wine and maroon with antique gold, carved wood tones and patterned marble. A centred, symmetrical composition uses converging pillar rows to lead the eye straight to the subject.
tips: Change the kurta to ivory or royal blue with a contrasting stole for a different festive palette.
Replace the cuff-adjusting pose with hands clasped in front for a more formal look.
Ask for a slightly tighter crop at knee level if the face appears too small.

title: Lavender Tissue Saree With Palace Night Lights
description: This prompt creates a full-length portrait of a woman in a dusty-lavender tissue-silk saree standing in front of Mysore Palace while it is lit up at night with thousands of warm golden bulbs. Two uploads guide the result: a real night photo of the palace for the architecture and lighting, and your face photo for identity. The prompt asks that the entire facade stays visible from the leftmost wing to the rightmost wing, including the illuminated central tower and smaller domes, so it uses a distant camera position to fit the wide building into a vertical 9:16 frame. The deep black sky contrasts with the glowing outlines of the palace, while the subject stands in the foreground in an elegant, relaxed pose with the soft sheen of tissue silk catching the light. Facial features are kept true to your reference without beautification. This look suits Dasara illumination nights, festive greetings, a travel memory from a Mysuru visit, or an evening-themed profile picture. Results improve when the face photo is clear and the night reference shows the palace straight on.
styleNotes: Thousands of warm golden bulbs act as the main light source, creating a soft glow on the subject and gentle reflections on the silk. Dusty lavender and gold stand out against a deep black night sky. A distant, centred composition keeps the whole palace silhouette visible while the subject anchors the lower foreground.
tips: Try a champagne gold or soft silver saree to blend with the warm bulb lighting.
Add a subtle fill light on the face if the subject looks too dark against the palace.
Switch to a 4:5 frame for a feed post, accepting that the palace wings will be tighter.

title: Navy Blazer Evening Portrait At Lit Mysore Palace
description: This prompt shows a man standing in front of the fully illuminated Mysore Palace at night, dressed in a refined evening outfit: a deep navy tailored blazer with structured shoulders, an ivory fine-knit turtleneck, slim beige trousers and polished dark-brown leather shoes. A real night photograph of the palace serves as the architecture and background reference, and the prompt requires the full building to be visible from wing to wing, with its central dome, towers, arches and thousands of glowing golden bulbs against a black sky. A separate photo of you is used as the only face reference so your features, hairstyle and facial hair are kept natural. The subject stands confidently in the foreground in a full-length vertical 9:16 frame, with a calm, poised expression. The look blends classic menswear with the festive atmosphere of the palace lights. It is a good match for Dasara evenings, New Year or anniversary posts, a smart travel photo from Mysuru, or a formal profile picture. A clear, front-facing face photo helps keep the result recognisable.
styleNotes: Golden bulb light from the palace provides warm backlight and rim light, balanced by soft frontal fill on the face. The palette combines navy, ivory and beige with warm gold against a near-black sky. The subject is centred in the foreground while a distant viewpoint keeps the entire palace silhouette in frame.
tips: Swap the navy blazer for a black bandhgala to give the look a more traditional festive edge.
Change the turtleneck to a crisp white shirt for a classic formal variation.
Ask for a slight low angle to make the subject appear taller against the lit domes.

title: Peacock Blue Mysore Silk Saree At Dasara Procession
description: This prompt creates a full-length portrait of a woman beside a decorated elephant during the Mysore Dasara Jumbo Savari procession, with the illuminated Mysore Palace glowing behind. She wears a rich peacock-blue pure Mysore silk saree with an antique-gold zari border, woven floral and paisley patterns, and a deep magenta contrast blouse with gold embroidery at the neckline and sleeves. The pallu falls neatly over her left shoulder and the pleats are arranged in the traditional way. The palace is lit by thousands of warm golden lights, and the elephant carries festival decorations, giving the scene a strong sense of Karnataka's royal festival. Your uploaded face photo is used as the only identity reference, with instructions to keep your natural features, skin tone and hairline without beautifying them. The frame is vertical 9:16, showing the subject from head to toe. This look fits Dasara and Navaratri greetings, a cultural heritage post, a festive family album, or a traditional profile picture during the festival season. Upload a clear, evenly lit selfie for the closest likeness.
styleNotes: Warm festival lighting from the palace and procession creates golden highlights on the silk and zari border. Peacock blue and magenta contrast with antique gold, deep night tones and the elephant's colourful ornaments. The subject stands in the foreground slightly to one side, with the elephant and palace stacked behind for layered depth.
tips: Replace peacock blue with a classic red and gold Mysore silk for a bridal-style variation.
Add a jasmine gajra and temple jewellery to strengthen the traditional festival look.
Ask for daytime procession lighting if you prefer brighter colours and a blue sky.

title: Olive Denim Jacket Look With Dasara Elephant
description: This prompt places a man in front of a decorated elephant during the Mysore Dasara Jumbo Savari procession, with Mysore Palace lit up by thousands of warm golden lights in the background. Unlike the traditional versions, the outfit here is modern casual: a light olive-green denim jacket with visible stitching and chest pockets, a plain black crew-neck T-shirt, relaxed black cargo pants, clean white sneakers and a silver wristwatch. He stands with both hands in his pockets, shoulders relaxed and a subtle smile, and the complete body from head to shoes is shown. The elephant is positioned behind and slightly to the left, creating depth between the subject and the illuminated palace. Your uploaded face photo is the only identity reference, and the prompt asks to preserve your face shape, hairline, beard and skin tone without retouching. The vertical 9:16 format suits stories and reels. It works well for a Dasara visit post, a festival travel diary, a casual but festive profile photo, or a greeting to friends during Navaratri. A sharp, front-facing selfie gives the best likeness.
styleNotes: Warm golden festival lights backlight the scene and add soft rim light on the jacket and shoulders. Olive green, black and white form a calm modern palette against the gold-lit palace and the elephant's colourful decorations. The subject is centred and full length, with the elephant offset left to create layered depth.
tips: Switch the denim jacket to a beige linen shirt for a lighter daytime festival feel.
Add a traditional Mysore peta to mix casual wear with a festive cultural touch.
Ask for a closer, waist-up framing if you want the face and jacket details to stand out.

title: Twelve Men's Hairstyle Preview Grid On White
description: This prompt generates a 3x4 grid of twelve portraits of the same man, each with a different hairstyle, so you can preview new looks before visiting a barber. The list includes a buzz cut, pompadour, long wavy hair and a messy fringe, and the grid format leaves room for other popular cuts such as a mid fade, textured crop or slick back. The prompt asks the tool to keep the same facial features, beard and neutral lighting across every frame, which makes it easier to compare styles fairly. Each tile sits on a clean white background in a professional studio style with a hyper-realistic finish. You replace the bracketed description with your own details or upload a clear photo of yourself. The result is practical rather than decorative: it is useful for deciding on a new haircut, planning a wedding or interview look, or sharing a fun comparison with friends. For the most accurate preview, use a front-facing photo with your hair pulled back from the forehead and even lighting. The prompt ends with a small signature in the corner, which you can remove if you prefer a clean image.
styleNotes: Flat, neutral studio lighting keeps every tile consistent so differences come only from the hair. The palette is simple: white background, natural skin tones and dark hair. A tidy 3x4 grid with equal spacing and identical head size in each frame makes side-by-side comparison easy.
tips: Replace the listed cuts with styles you are actually considering, such as a taper fade or crew cut.
Ask for a 4:5 or square ratio if you plan to post the grid on Instagram.
Specify your beard length so it stays the same across all twelve frames.

title: Black And Gold Hairstyle Analysis Poster For Men
description: This prompt produces a dark, editorial-style hairstyle analysis poster that looks like a grooming brand infographic. Your face appears in a large central-left portrait with thick, slightly wavy, medium-length hair, a well-groomed beard and a neutral, confident expression, lit cinematically against a black background. Thin golden lines and small icons point to hair features such as texture, volume, fringe, hairline and sides. A boxed 'Hair Profile' panel in gold typography lists hair length, type, texture, suggested hair colour and face shape. Below, a 'Best Hairstyles' row shows five smaller portraits of the same face with styles like a textured crop, messy fringe, mid fade with quiff, classic taper and volumised top, each with rating dots, followed by an 'Also Good' row with alternatives such as a side part and pompadour. The poster is a practical way to explore which cuts suit your face shape before a salon visit, and it also makes a neat share for grooming content. Edit the profile values to match your real hair so the recommendations make sense, and use a well-lit, front-facing photo.
styleNotes: Low-key lighting with soft highlights and deep shadows gives a premium, moody look on a pure black base. The palette is black, metallic gold and natural skin tones, with gold reserved for lines, icons and headings. The layout is structured: hero portrait left, data panel right, and two rows of smaller style previews below.
tips: Edit the Hair Profile values, such as texture or face shape, to reflect your own hair accurately.
Swap gold accents for silver or white if you prefer a cooler, minimal infographic style.
Reduce the number of style previews to three for a cleaner, less crowded poster.

title: Same Face Twelve Haircuts Studio Lookbook
description: This prompt creates an ultra-realistic 3x4 lookbook grid of the same young man shown with twelve different haircuts while his facial features, beard, expression, head angle and studio lighting stay identical in every frame. The styles listed are buzz cut, pompadour, slick back, messy fringe, middle part, textured crop, curly top, long wavy hair, undercut, taper fade, side part and modern mullet, which covers short, medium and long options. Each portrait sits on a white background with sharp focus and a fashion lookbook finish, and the full grid is arranged in a tall 9:16 ratio that fits a phone screen. Upload a clear photo of yourself so the grid uses your face. The format is useful for comparing cuts before a barber appointment, picking a style for a wedding or new job, or making a fun before-and-after style post. Because lighting and pose are locked, the differences you see come from the hair alone. For the most realistic result, choose a reference with your forehead visible and hair not covering your ears. The small corner signature in the prompt can be removed.
styleNotes: Even, soft studio lighting from the front removes harsh shadows and keeps every frame consistent. White background, natural skin and dark hair keep the palette neutral so attention stays on the haircut. A uniform grid with matching head size, angle and spacing creates a clean catalogue feel.
tips: Swap out styles you would never try, like the modern mullet, for cuts such as a crew cut or French crop.
Ask for a light grey background if white makes lighter hair colours hard to see.
Change the ratio to 1:1 if you want a square grid for a feed post.

title: Matchstick Side Profile With Orange And Blue Light
description: This prompt creates a moody close-up side-profile portrait of a young man with messy, naturally curly black hair, a groomed beard, black rectangular sunglasses and a small hoop earring. He holds a lit matchstick between his lips, head tilted slightly upward and gaze turned sideways, giving a calm but intense expression. He wears a sleek black blazer and no hands appear in the frame. The backdrop is a solid warm orange studio wall, lit with a two-tone setup: an orange key light from the rear and side, plus a cool blue rim light along the face and neck. The tiny flame adds a soft warm glow on the lower face. The prompt asks for detailed skin texture, individual hair strands, realistic beard texture, shallow depth of field and fine film grain, with an 85mm telephoto feel. It is set in a vertical 9:16 ratio for stories and reels. This look suits an attitude-style profile picture, a cover image for music or fashion content, or a bold birthday post. Upload a reference with a clear side or three-quarter angle for the closest match.
styleNotes: Two-tone lighting does most of the work: warm orange from behind and a cool blue rim on the face create strong colour contrast. The palette is orange, teal-blue and black with warm skin tones. A tight side-profile crop with shallow focus and fine grain gives an editorial, cinematic feel.
tips: Replace the matchstick with a rose stem or simply remove it for a cleaner portrait.
Swap the orange backdrop for deep red or teal to change the colour mood.
Ask for a front-facing angle if your reference photo is not in profile.

title: Red Cafe Racer Rider Vintage Poster
description: This prompt designs a photorealistic vintage-style advertising poster of a young rider sitting confidently on a red and black cafe racer motorcycle. He has a short beard and wavy dark hair and wears black rectangular sunglasses, a red denim jacket over a red hoodie, loose black cargo pants with a silver pocket chain, and black-and-white sneakers. The motorcycle is described in detail with a glossy red fuel tank with white racing stripes, a round chrome headlight, dual exhaust pipes and wire-spoke wheels. The background is an off-white textured canvas with large, distressed red typography layered behind the rider, and the original prompt also adds a manufacturer logo and model name at the top. Studio lighting keeps the colours vivid and the details sharp, blending portrait photography with bold graphic design in a vertical 9:16 format. The concept suits bike enthusiasts who want a retro poster-style image, a garage wall print idea, or a bold profile visual. Because the original version centres on a specific brand's logo and model lettering, consider replacing them with your own name or a generic title.
styleNotes: Bright, even studio lighting keeps the motorcycle's chrome and paint crisp while the rider stays sharply lit. The palette is strongly red, black and off-white, with distressed red lettering echoing the outfit. A centred rider on the bike overlaps large background typography, creating a layered retro poster composition.
tips: Replace the brand logo and model lettering with your own name or a phrase for a personal poster.
Change the bike and outfit colour to matte black or olive green for a darker retro theme.
Add worn paper texture and faded colours for a stronger vintage print effect.

title: Bandage Wrapped Face Portrait With Black Horse
description: This prompt transforms an existing photo into a dark, mysterious cinematic portrait in which the subject's entire head and face are wrapped in thick, opaque off-white cotton bandages with overlapping layers. Hair, forehead, eyes, nose, mouth, jawline and ears are fully covered, so no facial features show through. Everything else from your photo is kept unchanged, including body proportions, pose, hands, clothing, accessories, camera angle and framing, and the original background stays in place. The example version shows the figure standing beside a black horse in warm golden-hour light, which adds to the eerie, story-like mood. A dark cinematic colour grade is applied, with deep shadows, subtle warm highlights, atmospheric haze, natural HDR contrast and visible film grain. The output is a 9:16 vertical portrait. This concept works for Halloween posts, horror or thriller-style cover art, music video stills, short film posters, or an anonymous profile image when you prefer not to show your face. Because the face is hidden, the strength of the result depends on a striking pose, outfit and background in your original photo.
styleNotes: A dark grade with crushed shadows and gentle warm highlights keeps the off-white bandages as the brightest element. The palette is muted: charcoal, earthy browns and cream, with optional golden-hour warmth. The original framing is preserved, and haze plus film grain give depth and a vintage cinematic texture.
tips: Change the bandage colour to grey or stained beige for a grittier horror-film look.
Ask for cold blue grading instead of warm tones for a winter thriller atmosphere.
Use a full-body original photo so the pose carries the mood while the face is hidden.

title: Cream Sweater Streetwear On Concrete Steps
description: This prompt creates a cinematic fashion portrait of a young Indian man sitting on wide modern concrete steps in front of a bold orange architectural wall with oversized typography reading 'FOCUS'. He has thick, voluminous, slightly messy black hair and a neatly trimmed beard, and the prompt asks to keep your own face exactly as in your uploaded photo. He wears a cream-beige ribbed knit sweater with slightly oversized sleeves, loose black cargo trousers and chunky white sneakers, finished with black rectangular sunglasses and a thin silver chain. The pose is relaxed: one knee raised with an arm resting over it, the other hand on the step for support, the other leg extended down the stairs, and the head slightly tilted toward the camera with a calm expression. Warm golden-hour light brightens the orange wall and adds soft shadows on the steps. This look suits a streetwear profile picture, a motivational post, a fashion portfolio sample, or a fresh cover photo for social media. You can easily replace the wall word with something personal to you.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour sunlight skims across the steps, giving soft shadows and a glow on the orange wall. The palette pairs bright orange with cream, black and white for a clean streetwear look. The subject sits off-centre on diagonal steps, with the large typography filling the background for a graphic balance.
tips: Replace the word FOCUS with your name or a short motto that suits your profile.
Change the wall colour to deep teal or mustard while keeping the cream sweater.
Swap the sweater for an oversized white shirt for a lighter summer version.

title: Yellow Flower Field Poster With Name Typography
description: This prompt creates a minimal 9:16 portrait poster of a young Indian man standing in a field of yellow flowers, holding a small bunch of them in his hands. He wears a plain white shirt and a backpack and looks down with a calm, thoughtful expression. Soft natural light falls on the scene, and the green background dissolves into blurred flowers and bokeh. Behind the subject, a large vertical name in a clean modern font fills most of the frame, with the small word 'PHOTOGRAPHY' spaced beneath it, giving the image the look of a designer poster or portfolio cover. The colour grade leans soft green with warm tones, creating a dreamy and gentle atmosphere. You replace the placeholder 'Your Name' with your own name or brand. This prompt works well for a photographer's portfolio cover, a personal brand banner, a birthday post, or a calm, aesthetic profile picture. It is also a good base for spring and travel themes. Upload a clear photo of yourself so the face and build match, and keep the name short so the typography stays legible.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused daylight keeps contrast low and skin tones gentle. The palette mixes fresh green, warm yellow and white, with the name lettering in a neutral tone. The subject stands centred in front of oversized vertical text, while shallow depth of field and bokeh separate him from the background.
tips: Replace 'Your Name' with your initials if your full name is long or hard to read vertically.
Swap yellow flowers for white daisies or sunflowers for a different seasonal feel.
Change PHOTOGRAPHY to a word that fits you, such as DESIGN or TRAVEL.

title: Backlit Golden Hour Portrait With Grey Blue Dupatta
description: This prompt creates a candid, soft portrait of a South Asian woman with long, straight dark hair falling over her shoulders. She wears a small black bindi, a black top and a sheer grey-blue dupatta draped over one shoulder, and she looks down with a gentle, warm smile. The defining feature is the backlighting: warm golden-hour sun sits behind her and creates a glowing halo around her hair and shoulders. The background is an out-of-focus outdoor setting turned into soft bokeh, which keeps attention on her face and expression. The prompt asks for natural skin texture, a candid photography style and a warm, earthy colour palette, framed vertically in 9:16. It suits anyone who wants a natural, understated portrait rather than a heavily styled one. Good uses include a profile picture, a birthday or Women's Day post, a quote background, or an everyday aesthetic image for Instagram. Upload a clear photo with your face visible; looking slightly down in the reference helps the result match the pose and mood of this prompt.
styleNotes: Strong golden backlight creates a rim of light around the hair while soft bounce light keeps the face visible. The palette is warm and earthy: amber, honey, black and dusty grey-blue. A close, slightly off-centre crop with creamy bokeh gives an intimate, candid feel.
tips: Swap the grey-blue dupatta for a mustard or rose shade to warm up the palette further.
Ask for her to look toward the camera if you prefer direct eye contact.
Try a 4:5 ratio for feed posts and keep the halo effect around the hair.

title: Onam Saree Motion Blur Portrait With Jasmine Bun
description: This prompt creates an intentionally artistic motion-blur portrait that looks as if it was shot with a long exposure or a smartphone in low light. The woman wears an Onam-style saree with a matching full-sleeve blouse, her hair styled in a loose braided low bun decorated with jasmine flowers, and a long face-framing strand partly covering one side of her face. She looks down and to the side with one eye mostly hidden, lips slightly parted, giving a dreamy, reflective mood. Large statement gold earrings, soft peach blush, subtle highlighter, defined lashes and matte dusty-rose lips complete the look. The prompt keeps the framing modest and asks that your face stays exactly as in your reference photo. The output is a natural-looking 9:16 vertical image. This idea fits Onam greetings, Kerala-themed festival posts, a creative profile picture, or an artistic photo series. The blur is deliberate, so expect soft edges and streaks rather than pin-sharp detail; use a clear reference so the face still reads well through the effect.
styleNotes: Soft, low ambient light combined with deliberate motion blur creates streaky highlights and a dreamy softness. The palette centres on the cream and gold of a kasavu saree, warm skin, jasmine white and dusty rose. A close, slightly tilted crop with hair across the face gives an intimate, editorial composition.
tips: Reduce the motion blur to 'subtle' if you want the face to stay sharper.
Replace the Onam saree with a red silk saree for Diwali or wedding season.
Pin the face-framing strand back if you want both eyes visible.

title: Crimson Flower Field With Peeking Teddy Bear
description: This prompt creates a playful, surreal fashion editorial shot from very low inside a vast field of vivid crimson-red flowers, looking slightly upward. On the far left edge, a large beige plush teddy bear peeks sideways into the frame, half hidden by flowers with only its head and a little of its body showing. On the far right, a stylish rugged man leans in from the opposite side wearing a cream cowboy hat, black sunglasses and deep red clothing, with a curious, surprised expression as if both have just discovered a hidden camera. A wide band of empty space separates the two, giving a bold asymmetrical layout. Crimson flowers dominate the lower foreground with natural blur, and a saturated cobalt-blue sky with scattered white clouds fills the top. The prompt pushes for extreme realism in skin, beard and eyes. The frame is vertical 9:16. This concept suits a fun birthday post, a Valentine's Day image, a quirky profile picture, or eye-catching social content. Upload a clear photo so the man's face matches yours.
styleNotes: Bright, clear daylight from above gives saturated colour and crisp detail. The palette is strongly crimson, cobalt blue and white, with cream and beige from the hat and teddy bear. An extreme low angle and wide negative space between two figures on opposite edges create an unusual, editorial composition.
tips: Swap the teddy bear for a puppy or a second person for a different playful story.
Change the crimson flowers to yellow mustard fields for a warmer, rural look.
Replace the cowboy hat with a cap or bare head if the hat does not suit your style.

title: Overhead Black SUV Bonnet Portrait In Monochrome
description: This prompt creates a top-down, drone-style black-and-white photo of a young man sitting on the bonnet of a black SUV parked on gravel. He wears a white oversized T-shirt with large printed text, light baggy jeans and black-and-white sneakers, with black sunglasses, messy hair and a beard. The driver's door is open on the left, a white cold-drink cup sits on the bonnet beside him, and tree shadows fall across the roof and glass. The overhead viewpoint turns the car into a strong graphic shape, while the gravel ground gives texture around it. The style is cinematic, moody and highly detailed, finished with a black-and-white filter in a vertical 9:16 ratio. A custom number plate is included in the prompt, which you can change to anything you like. This look suits car lovers, a road-trip memory, a cool profile picture, or a social post about a new vehicle. For the best likeness, use a reference photo where your face is clearly visible from slightly above. You may also want to replace the T-shirt text with a plain or personal print.
styleNotes: Monochrome grading with deep blacks and bright whites gives a bold, graphic look. Tree shadows add soft pattern across the car's roof and glass, contrasting with the textured gravel. The overhead composition places the subject centrally on the bonnet, with the open door creating a diagonal line.
tips: Replace the printed text on the T-shirt with your name or a plain white tee.
Remove the black-and-white filter for natural colours if your car is a striking shade.
Edit the number plate text to your own city code or initials.

title: Roadside SUV Bonnet Candid With Phone In Hand
description: This prompt creates a realistic phone-camera style portrait of a young man sitting casually on the front bonnet edge of a glossy black SUV parked slightly sideways beside a quiet road. The roadside is lined with lush green plants and tall trees, with a soft, forest-like background that blurs naturally. One hand rests behind him on the bonnet for support, while the other holds a phone near his thigh. His legs are relaxed and slightly apart, his head turned a little to the side with a calm, confident closed-mouth smile, and his hair is styled slightly longer and fluffy. The prompt puts strong emphasis on keeping your face identical to your uploaded photo, with natural skin pores and no smoothing, glow or heavy HDR. The car is rendered with detailed reflections, grille, headlights and chrome elements under ordinary outdoor light. The frame is vertical 9:16, and many users finish it in black and white for a classic lifestyle feel. This suits a new-car post, a road-trip memory, or a casual, grounded profile picture.
styleNotes: Natural outdoor daylight with mild shade from the trees keeps contrast gentle and true to a phone camera. Glossy black paint, green foliage and natural skin tones form the colour version, which converts cleanly to monochrome. The subject sits on the bonnet slightly off-centre, with the angled car leading the eye into the frame.
tips: Choose black and white or natural colour explicitly in the prompt to control the final look.
Swap the phone for sunglasses in hand for a different casual pose.
Ask for a wider frame if you want more of the car and road visible.

title: High Key Roadside Portrait Between White SUVs
description: This prompt creates a minimalist automotive portrait on an open roadside in late afternoon under an overcast sky. A confident man with thick, messy black hair and light stubble stands centred between two glossy white modern SUVs. He wears a white button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, black trousers and dark shoes. His body is slightly angled and he looks to the left, with one hand in his trouser pocket and the other resting on a headlight. The two vehicles act as a natural, symmetrical frame, and the cloudy sky leaves generous negative space above. Gravel ground, power lines and an open horizon keep the setting grounded and real. The look is finished in a high-key monochrome grade with subtle gold tones in the sky, soft diffused light, minimal shadows, lifted blacks and a matte finish. It is shot full-body at eye level with deep depth of field. This prompt suits a clean, aspirational profile picture, a car-themed post, a personal brand image, or a minimalist poster. Upload a clear photo so the face and build match yours.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused overcast light keeps shadows minimal and contrast low. The palette is almost monochrome, white, grey and black, with a faint gold tint in the sky. A symmetrical eye-level composition centres the subject between two vehicles, with wide negative space above for a calm, open feel.
tips: Change the vehicles to black SUVs for a stronger contrast against the white shirt.
Remove the gold sky tint for a pure black-and-white finish.
Replace the white shirt with a black turtleneck for a moodier editorial variation.

title: Leather Jacket Pose Between Rugged Black SUVs
description: This prompt creates a premium automotive lifestyle portrait of a young man standing between two rugged black SUVs in a quiet rural dirt clearing. He leans naturally against the front of the left vehicle with his arms crossed and wears a brown-tan leather jacket, dark blue jeans and clean white sneakers. The left SUV has a prominent front grille and headlights, while the right is a boxy off-road vehicle with a vertical grille and a small red accent. Tall green trees surround the clearing, and a soft morning haze fills the background under a pale blue sky with light clouds. The prompt uses your uploaded image as the reference for face, hairstyle, skin tone, pose, hand placement and clothing, and asks not to beautify or reshape your features. Early-morning diffused sunlight, realistic shadows and subtle haze give depth, and the overall style is crisp and photorealistic with natural colours. Many users also convert this one to black and white. It suits SUV owners, adventure or road-trip posts, and a rugged, confident profile picture.
styleNotes: Gentle early-morning sunlight filtered through haze gives soft shadows and atmospheric depth. Natural colours combine glossy black paint, tan leather, denim blue and fresh green trees. The subject is centred between two vehicles, leaning on one, which creates a balanced frame with depth from the misty tree line.
tips: Swap the leather jacket for a denim or olive field jacket to suit an outdoor theme.
Request a black-and-white grade with high contrast for a more dramatic version.
Ask for a low camera angle to make the vehicles and subject look more powerful.

title: Sky Blue Shirt And Black SUV On Dusty Terrain
description: This prompt creates a cinematic automotive lifestyle photo of a young South Asian man standing confidently in front of a glossy black SUV on dusty outdoor terrain. The vehicle sits directly behind and slightly beside him, shown with realistic reflections and detail. He keeps the outfit from your reference photo: a sky-blue graphic shirt, relaxed black trousers, clean white sneakers, dark sunglasses and a watch with a bracelet, in a loose streetwear style. His arms hang naturally at his sides, shoulders relaxed, body facing the camera with a confident but casual expression. The prompt treats your uploaded image as the top-priority reference and asks for zero drift in face, hairline, beard, body proportions, pose, camera angle and framing, with no smoothing or face reshaping. The look is often finished in dramatic black-and-white tones, giving a polished, premium feel. The format is vertical. This is a good choice for SUV owners sharing their car, a road-trip or farm-visit post, or a strong, grounded profile picture. A full-body reference photo with the car already behind you works best.
styleNotes: Natural outdoor light on dusty ground gives soft texture, and a monochrome grade adds depth and contrast. In colour, sky blue, black and white stand out against earthy beige terrain. The subject stands centred in front of the vehicle, which fills the background and frames him from behind.
tips: Keep the colour version if your shirt is bright, or ask for black and white for drama.
Ask for sunset lighting to warm the dusty terrain and add long shadows.
Change the terrain to a tarmac road with trees for a cleaner, urban feel.

title: Night Headlight Glare Portrait Between Two SUVs
description: This prompt recreates a cinematic black-and-white night photograph of a young South Asian man standing on a dark, wet asphalt road between two large SUVs. He is shown full length in the centre-right foreground, in side or three-quarter profile looking toward the left, with a relaxed, confident stance and one hand partly in his pocket. He wears an oversized light-grey crewneck sweatshirt, loose dark-grey jeans, black-and-white retro sneakers and dark sunglasses, with natural, slightly messy medium-length hair and light facial hair. Behind him, a white SUV sits on the left and a black SUV on the right, both angled toward the camera with headlights switched on. Those headlights are the main light source, producing bright rim light, controlled lens bloom and glare on the wet road. The background is almost completely black. If you provide a selfie, the prompt uses it as the only identity reference. The vertical 9:16 frame suits stories and reels. This look is ideal for car enthusiasts, a night drive post, or a dramatic, moody profile picture.
styleNotes: Strong white headlights backlight the subject, creating crisp rim light, bloom and reflections on wet tarmac. The palette is pure monochrome with deep blacks and bright highlights. The subject stands right of centre in full length, framed by two angled vehicles that form a V-shape behind him.
tips: Remove visible brand lettering on the vehicles if you prefer a generic automotive look.
Keep colour and add warm amber streetlights for a softer night-city mood.
Ask for light rain falling in the headlight beams for extra atmosphere.

title: Monochrome Smartphone Moment Leaning On Black SUV
description: This prompt creates a black-and-white cinematic portrait based on your uploaded photo, keeping your face, hairstyle and build naturally recognisable. A young man leans casually against a large black SUV, holding a smartphone in both hands and glancing slightly to the side with a calm, confident expression. He wears a plain white graphic T-shirt, dark relaxed-fit jeans, black-and-white slide sandals, dark rectangular sunglasses and a wristwatch, which gives the image an easy, off-duty feel. The SUV is fully detailed with visible headlights, alloy wheels, roof rails, windows and glossy reflections, and a white car is partly visible in the background. The roadside setting includes trees, open sky and faint power lines. The prompt asks for authentic monochrome photography with high contrast, deep blacks, bright highlights, subtle film grain and a 50mm lens look with shallow depth of field. The composition is vertical and full length, from head to sandals. This suits a relaxed lifestyle profile picture, a car owner's post, or a candid-style social image that does not feel overly posed.
styleNotes: Natural daylight converted to high-contrast monochrome gives deep blacks, bright highlights and crisp shadows. The palette is purely black, white and grey, with fine film grain for texture. A full-length vertical frame shows the subject leaning on the SUV, which dominates the background while shallow focus softens the roadside.
tips: Swap slide sandals for white sneakers if you want a smarter, less casual result.
Ask for a natural colour version to show the true shade of your car.
Replace the phone with car keys in hand for a new-vehicle announcement post.

title: Purple Oversized Shirt Side Profile Street Portrait
description: This prompt creates a stylish outdoor portrait of a young man with messy, voluminous hair, captured with a focus on his side profile. He wears an oversized purple shirt with beige jeans, a vertical bar pendant necklace, a black-and-white smartwatch and sunglasses, and one hand touches his hair in a casual, confident pose. The background is a lush, softly blurred setting with an urban feel and dark tones, which keeps the attention on the subject. Cinematic lighting adds dimension to the face and fabric, and the overall finish aims for a sharp, realistic DSLR look. The prompt asks the tool to use your uploaded photo for the face so the likeness stays accurate. This look is easy to wear and works for everyday social posts, a fresh profile picture, a birthday image, or a casual fashion sample for a portfolio. It is particularly suited to people who like bold shirt colours and relaxed streetwear. For the closest result, upload a clear side or three-quarter photo, since the prompt is built around a side-face angle rather than a straight-on view.
styleNotes: Directional cinematic light from one side sculpts the profile and adds sheen to the hair. The palette pairs saturated purple with beige and black against muted green and dark background tones. A close side-angle crop with a strongly blurred background isolates the subject and gives a magazine-style feel.
tips: Change the shirt colour to rust orange or olive green for a different seasonal palette.
Ask for a front-facing angle if your reference photo is taken straight on.
Replace the urban greenery with a city street at dusk for a nighttime variation.

title: Windswept Victorian White Gown On Estate Path
description: This prompt recreates a romantic, cinematic full-length photograph of a woman walking along a curving gravel path through a large green lawn, with an elegant historic stone mansion partly visible on the far left and dense mature trees filling the background. She wears a white, Victorian-inspired gown with a structured corset-style bodice, an off-the-shoulder neckline edged with layered ruffles, voluminous sheer long sleeves with gathered cuffs, delicate hanging ribbons and a very full, tiered skirt with lace-trimmed, translucent layers. Strong wind lifts the sleeves, ribbons and skirt layers toward the right, and her long, straight hair streams in the same direction. Her head is turned sharply to the right in clean side profile, chin slightly raised and gaze far from the camera. The prompt works with two images: a reference image that locks composition, pose and setting, and your own photo for identity, hair colour and length. The result has a period-drama, fairy-tale quality. It suits a pre-wedding concept, a birthday portrait, a fantasy or book-cover style image, or a dramatic profile picture.
styleNotes: Soft, overcast daylight keeps the white gown detailed without blown highlights and gives the scene a quiet, period-film tone. The palette is white and ivory against deep green lawn, dark foliage and grey stone. A full-body diagonal walking pose with fabric flowing right creates strong movement across the frame.
tips: Change the gown colour to pale blush or soft champagne for a warmer romantic look.
Ask for golden-hour sunlight instead of overcast light to add warmth and long shadows.
Reduce the wind strength if you want a calmer, more elegant silhouette.

title: Mango Green Lehenga Top Angle With Glowing Butterflies
description: This prompt creates a close, top-angle portrait of a woman wearing a mango-green embroidered lehenga, with a stylish hairstyle decorated with flower hair ornaments, elegant makeup and a necklace. The camera looks down from above while she glances slightly up toward it, which gives an artistic, flattering angle. The background is filled with glowing mango-green rose petals and is deeply blurred, while glowing green butterflies float in the foreground, softly out of focus, adding depth and a dreamy, magical feel. The overall tone is elegant and colour-coordinated, with the outfit, petals and butterflies all sharing the same fresh green shade. The prompt asks the tool to keep your face exactly as in your uploaded photo and keeps the framing modest. The output is a vertical 9:16 image. This look suits festive occasions such as Mehendi, Haldi, Eid, Diwali or a wedding reception, as well as birthday posts and a colourful profile picture. Using a reference where your face is clearly visible and evenly lit helps the result stay true to you.
styleNotes: Soft frontal light from above keeps the face bright while glowing petals and butterflies add small points of light. The palette is monochromatic mango green with gold jewellery and warm skin tones. A top-angle close crop with heavy background blur and out-of-focus foreground butterflies creates layered depth.
tips: Change mango green to lilac or peach, and match the petals and butterflies to the new shade.
Reduce the number of butterflies for a cleaner, less busy frame.
Ask for eye-level framing if you prefer a more traditional portrait angle.

title: Vintage Scrapbook Collage Of Outdoor Portraits
description: This prompt creates a multi-panel scrapbook-style collage of the same woman, styled like a page from a handmade photo journal. The panels show different poses in the same black outfit and long styled hair: one with her back turned, hand beneath the chin, eyes closed and smiling against trees and plants in natural daylight, and another mid-shot facing forward with one hand on her head, looking sideways in warm sunlight against an artistic, grainy backdrop. Around and between the photos, the prompt adds many collage elements: close-up crops of her face, torn paper edges, vintage textures and small stickers such as cherries, flowers, stamps and handwritten compliment notes. The result feels personal, playful and nostalgic rather than polished. Upload a clear photo of yourself so the face stays consistent across panels. This idea suits a birthday post, a best-friend tribute, a monthly photo dump, an Instagram carousel cover, or a printable keepsake page. It also works for anyone who enjoys aesthetic, journal-style content. Adjust the stickers and notes to include names, dates or inside jokes.
styleNotes: Natural daylight and warm sunlight give soft, slightly grainy images that suit the vintage paper look. The palette is warm and muted, with black clothing, leafy greens, cream paper and small red sticker accents. A layered vertical collage with overlapping panels, torn edges and scattered stickers creates a busy, handmade composition.
tips: Replace the generic compliment notes with names, dates or a short personal message.
Swap the black outfit for a floral dress to make the collage brighter and softer.
Limit the stickers to one theme, like flowers only, for a cleaner page.

title: Pastel Pink Outfit In A Sunny European Old Town
description: This prompt creates a high-resolution fashion photograph of a young adult woman standing confidently in the middle of a charming European-style old-town street on a bright sunny day. She faces the camera slightly left of centre with a bright, natural smile, one hand raised near her neck and shoulder, the other arm relaxed. She has long, straight to slightly wavy chestnut-brown hair with a centre part. Her outfit is soft and feminine: a pastel baby-pink ruched fitted top, an oversized pale-pink knitted cardigan worn loosely off the shoulders, and a high-waisted ivory tiered skirt with ruffled layers, carried with a small mauve handbag. The street is lined with multi-storey buildings with warm earthy facades, sloped terracotta roofs, wooden windows and balconies, a small ornate church tower in the distance and green forested hills behind. The prompt asks to keep your face and body structure exactly as in your reference. This look suits travel-inspired posts, birthday photos, spring or summer outfit content, and a cheerful profile picture.
styleNotes: Bright, clear sunlight gives crisp detail and a cheerful, airy mood with soft shadows. The palette blends baby pink, ivory and mauve with warm terracotta, beige walls and green hills. The subject stands near the centre of a receding street, so the buildings lead the eye toward her and the distant tower.
tips: Swap the pastel pink set for a white sundress if you prefer a simpler summer look.
Change the location to a hill station street in India, such as one with colonial buildings.
Ask for a candid walking pose instead of standing still for a more natural travel shot.

title: Night Drive Flash Portrait In Black Leather Jacket
description: This prompt creates a close-up, flash-lit portrait of a young Indian woman taken inside a car at night. She is in the driver's seat with one hand on the steering wheel, glancing at her phone as if typing a message. She wears a black, voluminous leather jacket, small gold-framed sunglasses, long lashes with a lifted fox-eye effect and glossy lips, and her hair is pulled back into a low, slightly messy bun. Outside the window, streetlights glow in the dark. The key feature is a bright, harsh direct flash, which gives a raw, candid, paparazzi-like look with strong highlights and dark surroundings. The prompt asks to keep your face and features exactly as in your uploaded photo and uses a 3:4 aspect ratio. This style is popular for edgy, fashion-forward social posts, night-out content, a bold profile picture, or a casual 'on the way' story. It works best with a reference where your face is clearly visible and not heavily filtered. You may want to keep the phone pose relaxed so it reads naturally.
styleNotes: Direct on-camera flash creates bright, hard light on the face and jacket with quick falloff into darkness. The palette is mostly black and warm skin tones, with gold frames and small orange streetlight accents. A tight, macro-style close-up inside the car cabin feels candid and intimate.
tips: Replace the phone with a coffee cup for a relaxed late-night drive variation.
Ask for softer flash and visible city bokeh outside if harsh flash feels too strong.
Change the leather jacket to an oversized denim jacket for a lighter casual look.

title: Ivory Saree On A Rooftop Garden With City Skyline
description: This prompt creates a full-body portrait of a young adult woman standing on a spacious rooftop terrace garden that overlooks a modern city skyline on a bright, sunny day. She stands slightly right of centre facing the camera, head gently tilted, shoulders relaxed and gaze direct, with a soft closed-mouth smile. One arm hangs naturally at her side while the other hand rests on her waist in a graceful fashion pose. She wears an elegant ivory saree in a soft, lightweight, slightly sheer fabric with flowing pleats and no heavy embroidery, paired with a simple black sleeveless blouse that creates a clean black-and-ivory contrast. A slim dark wristwatch and small hoop earrings are the only accessories. Her dark hair is smooth and centre-parted in a neat low bun with a few face-framing strands, and her makeup is natural and minimal. The prompt asks to keep your face and body structure exactly as in your reference. This look suits office party wear, a minimalist saree post, Women's Day, a birthday, or a refined profile picture.
styleNotes: Bright midday sunlight with soft shadows keeps the ivory fabric clean and the city sharp. The palette is minimal: ivory, black, greenery and the blue-grey tones of the skyline. A full-body frame with the subject slightly right of centre leaves room for the city view, giving a balanced, airy composition.
tips: Swap the ivory saree for pastel blue or sage while keeping the black blouse contrast.
Ask for sunset light to warm the skyline and give a golden glow to the saree.
Add a statement choker if you want a more festive, less minimal version.

title: Purple Neon Mirror Selfie With Phone Flash
description: This prompt creates a mirror selfie with a Gen Z aesthetic in a room lit by purple LED strip lights along the ceiling. The subject holds a phone with its flash on, producing a bright starburst effect held slightly away from the face, which adds lens flare and an authentic, unplanned feel. She wears a black Y2K-style ruffle top that is not revealing, an open grey zip hoodie and a cross-style costume jewellery necklace, with a wolf-cut hairstyle. Makeup is natural glam with glossy red lips and pink dewy blush, finished with gold geometric hoop earrings. Neon purple dominates the room and the overall colour of the image. The prompt asks to keep your face and hair exactly as in your reference and to make the result look like a natural phone photo rather than a rendered image, in a 9:16 ratio. This style works well for a casual Instagram story, a fun profile picture, a room makeover post, or a friends' photo-dump series. Using a reference taken in a similar indoor setting helps the lighting match.
styleNotes: Purple LED light provides a strong colour cast, while the phone flash adds a bright starburst and lens flare. The palette is neon purple and violet with black and grey clothing and warm gold accents. A typical mirror-selfie composition places the phone near the centre, slightly off the face, with the room glowing behind.
tips: Change the LED colour to pink or cyan to give the room a different mood.
Turn off the phone flash for a softer, moodier neon-only look.
Swap the hoodie for an oversized denim jacket to vary the Y2K styling.

title: Red Classic Two Stroke Bike With Checked Shirt
description: This prompt creates a realistic outdoor portrait of a stylish young man standing beside a classic red Yamaha RX100 motorcycle, a bike loved by many Indian riders for its retro shape. He wears a blue checked shirt with rolled-up sleeves, light khaki or grey cargo pants and sneakers, and he has curly hair, glasses and a confident expression as he leans on the bike with one hand. The background is a row of lush green trees, with soft sunlight filtering through the leaves and creating a gentle cinematic bokeh. The prompt asks for a sharp, natural DSLR look with detailed textures and natural lighting. Upload a clear photo of yourself so the face and build match. This look suits bike enthusiasts, a nostalgic tribute to a first motorcycle, a weekend ride post, or a relaxed, friendly profile picture. It also works well as a gift idea for someone who restores or collects vintage bikes. If you own a different classic bike, you can swap the model name and colour to match your own machine.
styleNotes: Soft, natural sunlight filtering through trees gives gentle highlights on the bike's chrome and fuel tank. The palette combines bright red paint with blue checks, khaki and fresh greens. A medium full-length frame places the subject beside the bike, with a blurred tree line creating warm bokeh behind.
tips: Replace the bike with your own classic motorcycle model and colour.
Swap the checked shirt for a white tee and denim jacket for a retro rider look.
Ask for golden-hour light to add warmth and longer shadows across the road.

title: Divine Blue Hand With Flute Above Young Man
description: This prompt creates a low-angle, dramatic portrait of a young man with sunglasses, wearing a beige patterned shirt and black wide-leg pants. He stands with one hand in his pocket and his head tilted upward. Above him, a divine blue hand adorned with beads and red cloth wraps holds a wooden flute topped with a peacock feather, a respectful visual reference to Lord Krishna. Flowing red fabric ribbons swirl around both the flute and the man, adding strong movement to the frame. The setting is a clean white background with soft light, which keeps attention on the figure, the hand and the ribbons. The low camera angle makes the subject look tall and confident while the flute appears to bless him from above. Upload a clear photo so the face matches yours. This concept suits Janmashtami greetings, devotional social media posts, a spiritual-themed profile picture, or a creative edit for followers who enjoy mythology-inspired art. Keep the depiction respectful; it works best with modest, smart clothing that matches the devotional mood.
styleNotes: Soft, even light on a white background keeps the scene clean and lets colours stand out. The palette is focused: divine blue, red ribbons, natural wood, peacock green and beige clothing. A strong low angle with the flute and hand above the subject creates a vertical, upward-looking composition.
tips: Replace the white background with a sunrise sky for a warmer, more cinematic devotional mood.
Change the outfit to a white kurta for a traditional Janmashtami look.
Ask for gold ribbons instead of red to create a softer, festive palette.

title: Blush Pink Dress Beach Walk At Sunset
description: This prompt creates a romantic point-of-view beach photo, as if the viewer is holding a woman's hand while she leads the way through shallow waves. She wears a flowing blush-pink ruffled dress and walks barefoot, smiling naturally with her hair blowing in the wind. The sun is setting over the sea, giving warm golden-hour light, sparkling water and realistic splashes around her feet. The prompt asks for realistic skin texture and a professional DSLR look with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, producing soft background blur, in a vertical 9:16 frame. It places strong emphasis on keeping her face exactly the same as your uploaded reference. This idea is popular for couples who want a 'follow me' style memory, an anniversary or Valentine's Day post, a honeymoon throwback, or a proposal announcement. It can also be used by anyone who wants a dreamy, travel-style portrait by the sea. For the most natural result, upload a clear, smiling photo, since the expression in the prompt is warm and joyful.
styleNotes: Warm, low golden-hour sunlight backlights the hair and dress and creates sparkles on the water. The palette is blush pink, gold, peach and soft sea blue. A point-of-view composition with an outstretched hand leading into the frame creates intimacy and a strong sense of movement.
tips: Change the dress to white or pale lavender for a different romantic palette.
Ask for an early morning beach with soft blue light instead of sunset.
Include the partner's sleeve or watch on the held hand to personalise the couple shot.

title: Royal Blue Kurta Three Frame Reel Collage
description: This prompt creates a soft, three-frame vertical collage with an airy, feminine Instagram reel feel and a desi touch. The woman wears a flowing royal blue printed kurta set with a matching dupatta, oxidised silver jhumkas and chunky silver bangles, with glowing skin, minimal makeup and silky dark hair moving in the breeze. The top frame is an intimate close-up with hair falling across her cheek and sunlight catching one eye, and the other frames show different relaxed moments in the same outfit and light. Warm cinematic daylight and a slightly soft phone-camera look give the images a casual, natural quality rather than a studio finish. The prompt places heavy emphasis on keeping your face identical to the uploaded photo in every frame, without smoothing or reshaping. The output is 9:16. This collage suits a festival outfit post, a weekend photo dump, a birthday carousel, or a reel cover for fashion or lifestyle content. It works best with a clear, natural reference photo taken in daylight.
styleNotes: Warm natural daylight gives soft highlights and gentle shadows with a slight phone-camera softness. The palette is royal blue and white print with oxidised silver accents and warm skin tones. Three stacked vertical frames mix a tight close-up with wider moments, creating a reel-like rhythm.
tips: Swap royal blue for mustard yellow or bottle green to suit a particular festival.
Ask for a different moment in each frame, such as laughing, walking and sitting.
Replace silver jewellery with gold jhumkas for a more festive look.

title: White Rose And Chair In Windswept Grass Field
description: This prompt creates a cinematic editorial portrait of a man sitting on a simple chair in a vast, wind-swept field of tall green grass. The grass moves like ocean waves and partly hides him, which makes him look small and calm within a wide landscape. He wears a loose white shirt and holds a single white rose, his messy dark hair blowing in the wind as he tilts his head down with a quiet, melancholic expression. The prompt asks for a telephoto look with shallow depth of field, visible film grain and an atmospheric, poetic finish with no text in the frame, in a vertical 9:16 format. Your uploaded photo is used for the face. The mood is reflective and soft rather than dramatic, making it suitable for poetry or quote backgrounds, a breakup or self-reflection post, a music cover, a short film still, or an artistic profile picture. It also pairs well with captions about patience or new beginnings. For the best result, use a reference where your face is visible in three-quarter view, since the head is tilted down.
styleNotes: Soft, overcast-style natural light keeps tones gentle and gives the scene a quiet, filmic mood. The palette is green grass, white shirt and rose, and muted grey sky. A telephoto composition compresses the waving grass around the seated subject, with shallow focus and grain adding atmosphere.
tips: Change the white rose to a red one for a stronger romantic accent in the frame.
Ask for golden-hour light to turn the grass amber and warm the mood.
Replace the chair with sitting on the ground for a more natural, candid feel.

title: Glossy QUEEN Letters With Mini 3D Figures
description: This prompt creates a playful image that mixes a realistic portrait with cute 3D animation. Using your uploaded photo as the identity reference, a woman stands beside oversized glossy white 3D letters spelling 'QUEEN'. Around her are small, charming 3D versions of herself, all dressed in matching black outfits: some sit on top of the letters, others peek out from behind them, and a few strike playful poses. The setting is a minimalist studio with warm, soft lighting, so the shiny letters and the tiny characters stand out clearly. The main figure stays a realistic adult woman while the miniatures carry a high-end animated style, which creates a fun contrast. The composition is cinematic and the format is vertical 9:16, with detailed textures on the letters and outfits. This idea suits birthday posts, Women's Day greetings, a confident profile picture, a self-love caption, or a reel cover. You can change the word to a name, a nickname or another short word that matches the occasion, as long as it fits comfortably across the frame.
styleNotes: Warm, soft studio lighting gives gentle reflections on the glossy letters and even light on the figures. The palette is minimal: white letters, black outfits and a neutral warm backdrop. The main subject stands beside large central letters, with small figures scattered across and around them for a lively composition.
tips: Replace QUEEN with your name or a short word such as BOSS, BRIDE or 25.
Change the outfits to a festive colour like red or gold for a celebration theme.
Ask for pastel pink letters for a softer, birthday-style look.

title: Pink Kurti Portrait With Cartoon Baby Krishna
description: This prompt creates a cheerful, full-length studio portrait of a young South Asian woman sitting cross-legged on a clean, solid light-blue backdrop. She smiles gently at the camera and wears a light pink embroidered kurti with delicate white floral patterns, relaxed white wide-leg trousers and white sneakers. Behind her, a cute black-and-white 2D cartoon of baby Krishna, drawn in clean, bold line art, peeks over her shoulder with a playful wink. He wears a peacock feather and silver bangles, gently pinches her right cheek with one hand and rests his other arm lovingly over her left shoulder. A small solid black doodle heart floats beside her head. Crisp, soft studio lighting gives even shadows. The mix of a realistic photo with simple line illustration creates a warm, affectionate and respectful devotional feel. Upload a clear photo so the face matches yours. This idea suits Janmashtami greetings, a devotional profile picture, a sweet post for family groups, or a creative story for followers who enjoy light-hearted, faith-inspired art.
styleNotes: Soft, even studio light keeps shadows gentle and the light-blue backdrop clean. The palette is pastel: light blue, soft pink and white, with crisp black line art for the illustration. A centred, seated full-length pose leaves space above and beside her for the cartoon and the floating heart.
tips: Change the backdrop to pale yellow and the kurti to white for a different pastel combination.
Ask for the line art in blue or gold instead of black to match festive colours.
Use a pose with hands folded in namaste for a more devotional version.

title: Sky Blue Net Saree Dreamy Movie Poster
description: This prompt creates a cinematic, film-poster style image built around a woman in a sky-blue net saree. Her hair is left open and styled softly, and she wears jhumka earrings decorated with small sky-blue roses. In the lower part of the poster she sits in a full-body, back-facing pose from head to toe, turned slightly toward her earrings, looking elegant and dreamy. Above her, in the sky, a large close-up of the same woman's face appears, softly lit and zoomed in, which gives the classic layered look of a romantic movie poster. The background is clean, the lighting is soft and the mood is cinematic, with no text added. The prompt uses your uploaded photo for the face and sets the frame to a 3:4 ratio. This style suits a birthday post, a Saree Day image, a fan-poster style edit for friends, or a romantic, dreamy profile picture. It is a good choice if you like soft pastels and nostalgic film aesthetics. Use a clear, front-facing reference so the large face in the sky stays recognisable.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused light on both the seated figure and the floating close-up keeps the poster gentle and romantic. The palette is pastel sky blue and white with warm skin tones and small blue floral accents. A two-layer composition places a back-facing full-body figure below a large face in the sky.
tips: Swap sky blue for blush pink and match the roses on the jhumkas to the new colour.
Add a title or your name in elegant script if you want it to read like a real poster.
Change the ratio to 9:16 for stories, giving more space between the two layers.

title: Braided Crown Hair In A Red Flower Garden
description: This prompt creates a portrait of a woman with long, wavy, rich brown hair styled in a braided crown that wraps around the top of her head in a half-up style. The rest of her hair falls in soft, voluminous waves, with gentle face-framing layers or light bangs. She stands in a garden full of red flowers, wearing a red striped dress, holding a single flower in one hand and looking directly at the viewer. The colour scheme is strongly red, with the dress echoing the blooms around her, which creates a cohesive, romantic image. The prompt asks the tool to keep your face exactly as in your uploaded photo without changes. The hairstyle is the main highlight, making this a good reference for anyone exploring braided crown looks for a wedding, a festival or a party. It also suits a spring or garden-themed post, a Valentine's Day image, a birthday portrait or a soft profile picture. If your hair is shorter or darker, you can adjust the hair description so it stays closer to your real look.
styleNotes: Soft garden daylight gives natural highlights on the waves and braid without harsh shadows. The palette is rich red and crimson with brown hair, green leaves and warm skin. A medium portrait with direct eye contact places the subject centrally among flowers, which frame her from the sides and foreground.
tips: Change the hair colour description to black or dark brown to match your own hair.
Swap the red garden for white roses and a pastel dress for a bridal theme.
Ask for a three-quarter angle to show more of the braided crown detail.

title: Wildflower Hill Chair Portrait With Peace Clouds
description: This prompt creates a calm, music-poster style landscape image of a young man sitting relaxed in a wooden chair placed in the middle of a lush green grassy hill dotted with small white and yellow wildflowers. He has a beard and wears a black cap, a dark T-shirt, a brown jacket and dark pants, leaning back with his face turned up toward the bright sky. The sky is a brilliant azure blue with soft white clouds, and across it the word 'Peace' is written in large, elegant, cursive cloud lettering, with a small silhouette of a dove flying near the end of the word. White flowers in the foreground are softly blurred, adding depth. The lighting is bright and cinematic, and the overall mood is peaceful and serene. Upload a clear photo so the face matches yours. This image suits a calm profile picture, a mental-health or mindfulness post, an album or playlist cover, a weekend getaway caption, or a quote background. You can replace the word 'Peace' with a different short word that reflects your mood.
styleNotes: Bright, clear daylight gives saturated colour and crisp detail across the hill and sky. The palette is vivid green, azure blue and white, with brown and black clothing as grounding tones. A centred subject on a hilltop below a wide sky leaves plenty of space for the cloud lettering above.
tips: Replace the word Peace with a short word like Calm, Free or your name.
Change the season to autumn with golden grass for a warmer, nostalgic feel.
Remove the cap and jacket for a lighter, summery version of the same scene.
