title: Bearded Man Relaxing Under Cursive Sky Lettering
description: This prompt shows a bearded young man resting in a simple wooden chair on top of a bright green hill scattered with tiny white and yellow wildflowers. He wears a black cap, dark T-shirt, brown jacket and dark trousers, and leans back with his face lifted toward the sun as if enjoying a quiet moment alone. Above him the sky is a clear, deep blue with soft cumulus clouds, and the word 'Peace' is formed from cursive, smoke-like cloud lettering stretching across the frame, finished with a small dove silhouette at the end. Softly blurred white flowers in the foreground give the photo depth and frame the subject. The style resembles a cinematic music or playlist cover with photorealistic textures. Your uploaded face photo is used for the subject. This version works well as a cover for a calm music playlist, a motivational caption, a weekend detox post, an aesthetic profile picture, or a background for a mindfulness quote. For a more personal touch, change the sky word or add a small date or caption underneath the lettering.
styleNotes: Clear midday sunlight brings out saturated greens and blues with soft shadows under the chair. The palette is grass green, deep sky blue and cloud white, with earthy brown and black clothing. Foreground blur, a centred subject and wide open sky create layered depth and a balanced poster layout.
tips: Change the dove to a flock of birds for a stronger sense of freedom.
Ask for sunset colours in the sky so the cloud lettering glows pink and orange.
Swap the wooden chair for a hammock or picnic blanket for a different relaxed pose.

title: Barefoot Ocean Portrait Holding Tricolour Flag
description: This prompt creates a realistic full-body Independence Day portrait of a young Indian man standing barefoot in shallow ocean water, holding the Indian national flag stretched horizontally in both hands. He wears a slightly loose white linen shirt with rolled-up sleeves and matching white trousers, with a subtle chain necklace, wristwatch and bracelet. His hair is thick, naturally wavy and slightly messy, with a neatly groomed light beard, and he has a warm, relaxed smile. Behind him is a calm sea with soft waves under a bright overcast sky. Elegant typography in the upper background reads '15 AUGUST', 'HAPPY INDEPENDENCE DAY' and 'INDIA'. The prompt asks for accurate flag colours with a clear navy Ashoka Chakra, realistic fabric movement, soft cinematic daylight, shallow depth of field with an 85mm f/1.8 look, and subtle ocean mist, in a vertical 4:5 frame. Your uploaded photo guides the face. This is suited to Independence Day and Republic Day greetings, a patriotic profile picture or a WhatsApp status.
styleNotes: Soft overcast daylight gives even light on the white outfit and keeps the sea calm and silvery. The palette is white and ocean blue-grey, with the saffron, white and green of the flag as the main accent. A centred full-body pose with the flag held across the frame creates a strong horizontal line.
tips: Change the typography to 26 JANUARY to reuse the image for Republic Day.
Ask for sunrise light over the sea for warmer, golden tones.
Swap the white trousers for light denim for a more casual beach look.

title: Tricolour Dupatta Close Up With Drifting Petals
description: This prompt creates an emotional close-up Independence Day portrait of an Indian woman in her mid-twenties. Her wavy hair blows across her face, her eyes are softly closed in a proud, patriotic expression, and one hand rests near her collarbone. She wears a white kurti with a tricolour dupatta, and the background is filled almost entirely with soft folds of tricolour flag fabric and golden bokeh. Petals drift close to her face, adding movement and a gentle, celebratory feel. A '15 August' message in gold script sits in the bottom corner. The prompt asks for HD, realistic photography in a vertical 9:16 frame. Upload a clear photo so the face stays true to you. This image suits Independence Day greetings on WhatsApp and Instagram, a profile picture for the week of 15 August, school or college celebration posts, or a story for office events. Because it is a close-up, it works best with a reference where your face is evenly lit and not covered by sunglasses or heavy filters. You can change the date text for Republic Day.
styleNotes: Soft, warm frontal light with golden bokeh behind gives a glowing, emotional quality. The palette is saffron, white and green with warm gold accents and natural skin tones. A tight close-up with hair and petals in motion fills the frame, with the date text balanced in a lower corner.
tips: Replace '15 August' with '26 January' to reuse the portrait for Republic Day.
Ask for open eyes looking at the camera if you prefer direct eye contact.
Add jasmine or marigold petals instead of generic petals for a more Indian touch.

title: Wet Linen Salute In The Sea With Flag Foreground
description: This prompt creates a cinematic Independence Day portrait of a young Indian man standing barefoot in the ocean and raising his right hand in a crisp, respectful salute. He has voluminous, messy dark wavy hair with a clean taper fade, and wears an oversized white long-sleeved linen shirt, slightly unbuttoned at the neck to show a thin silver chain, with loose white wide-leg linen trousers soaked from the calves down. A silver bracelet and a watch complete the look. His expression is solemn, proud and determined, gaze directed upward and away from the camera. In the immediate foreground, a large Indian national flag sweeps across the frame, heavily out of focus, creating a translucent blur of saffron, white and green that partly covers the lower half of his body, with a hint of the blue Ashoka Chakra. Bold typography reads 'Happy Independence Day India' with mixed colours and handwritten script. Your uploaded photo guides the face. This suits Independence Day and Republic Day posts, a patriotic profile picture and school or college celebrations.
styleNotes: Bright, soft coastal daylight keeps the white linen luminous while the foreground flag adds coloured blur. The palette is white, ocean blue and the tricolour, with grey and green in the typography. A layered composition places the blurred flag in front, the saluting subject in the middle and the sea behind.
tips: Change the salute to holding the flag pole if you prefer a different patriotic gesture.
Ask for dry clothing and a sandy beach instead of standing in water.
Edit the typography to include your name or a short message like Jai Hind.

title: Peacock Feather Flute Blessing In Dramatic Sky
description: This prompt creates an epic devotional-fantasy portrait of a young man with curly hair and sunglasses, wearing a beige patterned shirt and black wide-leg pants. He stands confidently with one hand in his pocket and his head tilted up toward the sky. Above him, a divine blue hand decorated with traditional beads and red cloth wraps holds a wooden flute topped with a peacock feather, a respectful symbol associated with Lord Krishna. Flowing red fabric ribbons swirl around the flute and the man, adding movement and depth. Unlike a plain studio version, this prompt uses a dramatic sky with volumetric sunlight and cinematic lighting, giving the scene a grand, heavenly atmosphere. The camera is placed low, which makes the subject appear tall beneath the divine hand. The prompt asks for realistic facial details and fabric movement with shallow depth of field and a premium social-media editorial look. Upload a clear photo so the face matches yours. This image suits Janmashtami greetings, devotional status updates, spiritual reels or a faith-inspired profile picture.
styleNotes: Volumetric sunlight breaks through dramatic clouds and creates rim light on the subject and ribbons. The palette is sky blue and gold with divine blue skin tone, deep red ribbons and beige clothing. A low-angle vertical composition stacks the subject below the flute and hand for an upward, reverent feel.
tips: Use a white or yellow kurta instead of the patterned shirt for a traditional devotional look.
Ask for sunrise colours in the sky to add warm orange and pink tones.
Add a few floating peacock feathers around the ribbons for extra festive detail.

title: White Chikankari Kurti At India Gate Sunset
description: This prompt creates a patriotic dual-composition poster of a young South Asian woman at India Gate, New Delhi, during golden hour. On the left is a large close-up portrait and on the right a full-body walking pose, both keeping the same identity from your uploaded photo. She has long, silky black hair with a middle parting, soft natural makeup, a tiny black bindi, glossy pink lips and oxidised silver jhumkas, with black sunglasses resting on her head. She wears a white embroidered chikankari kurti with matching leggings and white heels, and a transparent tricolour dupatta trails in the wind. She holds a large Indian national flag on a tall pole. Orange marigolds decorate the foreground, tricolour balloons and festive decorations fill the background, and India Gate stands behind with a large flag flying above it under a warm orange sky. The prompt asks for realistic skin texture, an 85mm f/1.8 look and editorial magazine styling. This suits Independence Day and Republic Day posts, school or college events and a festive profile picture.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour sunlight gives soft highlights on the white kurti and a glowing orange sky. The palette is white, saffron and green with marigold orange and warm stone tones. A split layout pairs a large close-up on the left with a full-body walking figure on the right, linked by India Gate behind.
tips: Change the setting to the Red Fort or your local monument for a personal touch.
Replace the heels with juttis to give the outfit a more traditional finish.
Ask for a single full-body portrait if the dual layout feels too busy.

title: Army Jacket Salute On A Snowy Himalayan Rock
description: This prompt creates a patriotic portrait of a slim young Indian man standing on a rock in the snowy Himalayas. He wears an army-style jacket, black gloves and army pants, holds an Indian flag in his left hand and gives a salute with his right. His hairstyle is neat and stylish and his expression is a soft, charming smile with lips closed. Snow falls gently around him, and in the background an Indian flag waves while a tricolour rocket shoots saffron, white and green smoke into the sky, adding a celebratory touch to the mountain scene. The overall image is picturesque, vibrant and high quality, framed vertically in a 5:7 ratio. The prompt asks to keep your face the same as your uploaded reference photo. This look suits Independence Day, Republic Day or Army Day posts, a tribute to the armed forces, a patriotic profile picture, or a school or college event image. Please note this is a styled, civilian tribute image; avoid adding real rank badges or unit insignia so it does not imitate an official uniform.
styleNotes: Bright, cool mountain daylight reflects off the snow, giving clean, crisp light on the face. The palette combines snow white, icy blue and olive green, with saffron and green smoke as vivid accents. A low, heroic angle places the subject on the rock with mountains and smoke trails rising behind.
tips: Replace the army jacket with a warm white jacket for a civilian patriotic look.
Remove the rocket smoke and keep only falling snow for a calmer image.
Change the ratio to 9:16 for stories, giving more sky above the subject.

title: Sandstone Fort Sunrise Poster In White Kurta
description: This prompt creates a cinematic Independence Day editorial poster of a young Indian woman in a premium white embroidered kurta with a flowing dupatta, standing at a historic Indian sandstone fort during a golden sunrise. Warm rays break through a dramatic sky, birds fly overhead, tricolour confetti floats in a soft wind, and a fully visible Indian flag waves nearby. Her body is turned about 45 degrees while she looks directly at the camera with a natural smile, relaxed posture and graceful hand placement. The poster includes layered typography: a bold gradient '15', a modern 'AUGUST', a script 'Happy', a bold 'INDEPENDENCE DAY', and lines such as 'ONE NATION. ONE DREAM. COUNTLESS HEARTS.', 'PROUD TO BE INDIAN' and 'Jai Hind'. The prompt asks for an 85mm DSLR look, shallow depth of field, cinematic colour grading and a magazine-cover style in a vertical 5:7 ratio, with your uploaded photo guiding the face. This is suited to Independence Day greetings, office or college celebration posts and a festive profile picture.
styleNotes: Golden sunrise light comes in low and warm, lighting the sandstone and adding soft rim light to the white kurta. The palette is sandstone gold, white and soft sky tones with tricolour accents. The subject stands slightly off-centre at a 45-degree turn, with typography layered around her in a magazine-cover layout.
tips: Trim the typography to two or three lines for a cleaner, less crowded poster.
Swap the white kurta for a saffron or green outfit to add more colour.
Replace the fort with your city's landmark for a local touch.

title: Victory Pose With Flag On A Stormy Beach Rock
description: This prompt creates a dramatic Independence Day portrait of a young Indian man standing on a beach rock in shallow seawater. He holds the Indian national flag high above his head with one hand and raises the other in a victory gesture. He wears a crisp white shirt with rolled sleeves, black cargo pants and white sneakers. A giant tricolour flag flies across a stormy, cloudy sky, waves crash around the rocks, the wet beach shines with reflections, and a long sea bridge is visible in the distance, giving the scene a cinematic monsoon atmosphere. The prompt asks you to keep your exact face, hairstyle, beard and skin tone from your uploaded photo. It uses an 85mm lens look, photorealistic textures and HDR detail, framed in a vertical 5:7 ratio. This image works well for Independence Day and Republic Day posts, patriotic WhatsApp statuses, a bold profile picture, or college and office celebration content. Its energetic pose and weather make it stand out from calmer, studio-style patriotic portraits.
styleNotes: Moody, stormy daylight under heavy clouds gives strong contrast, with the white shirt and flag as bright focal points. The palette is slate grey and sea blue with crisp white and vivid tricolour accents. A low angle places the subject high on the rock, with the flag and crashing waves creating dynamic diagonals.
tips: Ask for clearing skies with sunlight breaking through for a hopeful mood.
Swap the white shirt for a saffron kurta to add more colour to the frame.
Remove the sea bridge if you want a more natural, open coastline.

title: Orange Jacket Folded Arms With Giant Tricolour
description: This prompt combines two patriotic poster ideas for a young Indian man. In the first, he stands confidently with folded arms on a wet beach, wearing an orange jacket over a white T-shirt, green cargo pants and blue-white sneakers, so his outfit echoes the national colours. A huge waving Indian flag fills the entire background, with a large Ashoka Chakra visible, under a cinematic cloudy sky, with realistic reflections on the wet sand. Stylish typography reads '15 August Happy Independence Day' at the top left and 'Proud To Be Indian' on the right. The second variation shows him in an orange shirt, white jeans, white sneakers, black sunglasses and a smartwatch, kneeling while holding a large flag in front of the Red Fort at golden sunset, with saffron and green smoke and flying birds. Both versions keep your face the same as your uploaded photo and use a vertical 5:7 ratio. This prompt suits Independence Day greetings, a patriotic profile picture and college or office celebration posts.
styleNotes: Natural daylight on the beach gives realistic reflections, while the sunset variation adds warm golden light and coloured smoke. The palette leans heavily on saffron, white and green with neutral sand and sky. Both compositions centre the subject in front of a large flag or monument, with typography placed in the upper corners.
tips: Use only one of the two scenes in your prompt for more consistent results.
Change the typography position to the bottom if it overlaps your face.
Replace the Red Fort with India Gate or a local landmark for variety.

title: Flag Draped Like A Shawl In Black Studio
description: This prompt creates a luxury studio portrait for women in which the Indian national flag is draped elegantly around both shoulders like a shawl. She wears a white chikankari kurti with full sleeves and handcrafted embroidery, accessorised with a gold wristwatch, glossy black cat-eye sunglasses and oxidised silver jhumka earrings. She stands confidently with her right hand touching the temple of her sunglasses, her left hand holding the flag near her waist, head tilted slightly right and looking at the camera with a soft smile. Long, silky black hair flows with a gentle wind, with a few strands across the forehead. The background is seamless black, and the lighting uses a warm key light, soft fill and a blue-gold rim light around the hair. The prompt asks for an 85mm f/1.8 look, realistic embroidery and flag folds, and a 4:5 portrait ratio suited to Instagram display pictures. Your uploaded face is the only identity reference. This suits Independence Day and Republic Day profile pictures and patriotic stories.
styleNotes: A warm key light with soft fill and a blue-gold rim light separates the subject cleanly from the black background. The palette is white and saffron-green against deep black, with gold and silver accents. A centred, waist-up composition with a slight head tilt suits a profile picture crop.
tips: Remove the extra watermark text in the original prompt if you want a clean image.
Swap the cat-eye sunglasses for none if you prefer your eyes to be visible.
Change the black background to deep navy for a softer contrast.

title: Golden Hour Terrace Of A Sandstone Monument With Flag
description: This prompt creates an epic, patriotic rooftop scene during golden hour. The person stands on the terrace of an old historical Indian monument with Mughal-style sandstone architecture, carved stone railings and weathered textures, overlooking a historic city skyline. Behind them, an enormous Indian national flag on a tall black flagpole waves dramatically in the wind, with accurate colours and a navy Ashoka Chakra with exactly 24 spokes, filling a large part of the background. The prompt is unusually strict about identity: it asks to preserve your face, hairstyle, beard, skin tone, age, body build and even body language exactly as in your uploaded photo, with no face swap and no beautification. The pose is relaxed and confident: leaning on the carved railing with one hand resting on it, the other hand in a trouser pocket, one leg crossed over the other, head turned slightly left and looking into the distance. Your own outfit is kept. This works for Independence Day and Republic Day posts, a patriotic profile picture or a heritage-themed status.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour sunlight lights the sandstone in amber and gives soft rim light to the subject and flag. The palette is warm sandstone, honey gold and soft sky, with the tricolour as the main accent. A relaxed side-leaning pose on the railing, with a massive flag behind, creates depth and a calm, confident mood.
tips: Upload a reference photo already leaning on a railing so the locked pose matches naturally.
Ask for sunrise instead of sunset to get cooler sky tones behind the flag.
Add a light kurta or Nehru jacket if you want to change your outfit.

title: White Kurta With Saffron Dupatta Greeting Portrait
description: This prompt turns your photo into a bright, cheerful outdoor Independence Day portrait. The woman keeps her exact facial identity, smile, hairstyle, skin tone and body proportions from the uploaded image, and is dressed in a simple white kurta with green sleeve accents and a flowing saffron-orange dupatta, so the outfit itself reflects the tricolour. She stands in front of a large, softly blurred Indian national flag and smiles naturally at the camera with her hands gently joined in front, giving a warm, welcoming feel similar to a namaste greeting. Green bangles and minimal jewellery complete the look. The prompt asks for bright daylight, realistic fabric folds, clean facial detail, warm festive colours and soft background blur, framed vertically in 4:5. Compared with more dramatic patriotic prompts, this one is simple and friendly, making it a good choice for school teachers, students, office greetings, family WhatsApp groups and a festive profile picture for the week of 15 August. A clear, smiling daylight photo gives the most natural match.
styleNotes: Bright, even daylight keeps colours fresh and skin natural, with gentle shadows. The palette is white, saffron orange and green with soft blurred flag tones. A centred, waist-up composition with hands joined in front creates a calm, welcoming, symmetrical frame.
tips: Change the dupatta to a three-colour tricolour print for a stronger patriotic theme.
Ask for an outdoor school or office setting instead of a plain flag background.
Reuse the image for Republic Day by keeping the outfit and changing the caption.

title: Tricolour Wrap Candid Smile On Matte Black
description: This prompt creates a realistic, editorial studio portrait of a young South Asian woman gracefully draped in the Indian national flag against a clean matte black background. She looks slightly to her left with a soft, genuine smile, creating a natural, candid expression. One hand rests gently under her chin while the other remains hidden beneath the flag. Long, silky black hair flows in a light breeze, with a few strands crossing her face. She wears a simple, elegant gold wristwatch and minimal makeup, and the prompt asks for natural skin with visible pores, expressive brown eyes and realistic lips. The flag is wrapped around her shoulders with detailed folds and a clearly visible Ashoka Chakra. Lighting uses a soft key light from one side and a subtle rim light, with high contrast and realistic shadows. Camera details point to a full-frame camera with an 85mm f/1.2 lens set at f/1.8. This suits Independence Day and Republic Day profile pictures, Instagram posts and patriotic greetings.
styleNotes: A soft side key light with a subtle rim light creates contrast and shape against pure matte black. The palette is saffron, white and green with warm skin and a touch of gold. A close, slightly angled portrait with hand under chin and shallow focus gives an intimate editorial feel.
tips: Ask her to look straight at the camera if you want a more formal profile image.
Replace the matte black with a soft grey backdrop for a lighter mood.
Add small jhumka earrings to bring a traditional touch to the minimal look.

title: Anarkali Dual Poster With Watercolour Tricolour Splashes
description: This prompt creates a two-part Independence Day poster: a large close-up portrait on the left and a full-body walking pose on the right, both using the same face from your uploaded photo. She wears a white embroidered Anarkali suit with white leggings and white sandals, oxidised silver jhumkas, a small black bindi and sunglasses resting on her head, with a flowing tricolour dupatta draped across her shoulders. In the full-body scene she walks confidently, proudly holding a large Indian flag. India Gate in New Delhi stands in the background at golden-hour sunset with a large flag above it, surrounded by tricolour balloons and marigold decorations, and a pathway covered with orange and white petals leads toward the monument. Artistic watercolour splashes in saffron, white and green frame the edges for a festive poster effect. The prompt asks for warm cinematic sunlight, volumetric light and vibrant tricolour grading in a vertical 4:5 ratio. This suits Independence Day greetings, school or college programmes, and a festive profile image.
styleNotes: Warm sunset light with volumetric rays gives a golden glow on the white Anarkali and the monument. The palette is white, saffron and green, with marigold orange and watercolour accents. A split layout pairs a close-up with a walking figure, framed by painted splashes around the edges.
tips: Remove the watercolour splashes if you want a cleaner, more photographic finish for the portrait.
Swap the Anarkali for a white saree with a tricolour border for a different festive look.
Use only the full-body walking scene if you need a single, simpler image.

title: Dark Charcoal Studio Portrait Holding The Flag
description: This prompt creates a cinematic studio portrait of a person wrapped gracefully in the Indian national flag, holding it close to the chest with one hand and looking directly into the camera with a calm, confident and patriotic expression. It works for any gender, because the prompt keeps your exact face, hairstyle, skin tone and natural look from your uploaded photo. The background is a dark charcoal textured studio wall with a subtle vignette. Lighting follows a soft Rembrandt style, with a small triangle of light on the shadow side of the face, plus a warm golden rim light around the hair. The flag fabric is rendered realistically with a detailed Ashoka Chakra. The prompt asks for natural skin texture, shallow depth of field, an 85mm f/1.8 look, HDR detail and cinematic colour grading in a vertical 4:5 frame. The result is serious and dignified rather than festive. It suits an Independence Day or Republic Day profile picture, a tribute post, or a respectful patriotic message for colleagues and family.
styleNotes: Soft Rembrandt lighting sculpts the face, and a warm golden rim light separates the hair from the dark backdrop. The palette is charcoal and deep shadow with the saffron, white and green of the flag. A centred chest-up composition with direct eye contact and a vignette creates a focused, dignified portrait.
tips: Ask for a slight smile if you want a warmer, less serious expression.
Change the charcoal wall to deep blue for a cooler, modern studio look.
Include a lapel flag pin instead of wrapping for a more formal office version.

title: Glowing Circle Frame Patriotic Display Picture
description: This prompt creates a polished Independence Day display picture in a 4:5 portrait ratio, designed for Instagram and WhatsApp profile photos. The subject is shown in a strict chest-up composition, fully contained inside a perfectly centred glowing circular frame with equal margins on every side. They look into the camera with a soft, confident smile while gently holding a flowing saffron dupatta near the shoulder with one hand. The background is matte black, and inside the circle are flowing tricolour silk waves, a semi-transparent Ashoka Chakra behind the subject, a thin metallic gold ring, minimal golden dotted graphics, a warm orange radial glow and tiny floating golden particles. The prompt asks for symmetrical balance, soft beauty lighting with golden rim light around the hair and shoulders, high-end colour grading and DSLR depth of field, while preserving your exact face from the uploaded image. Because the subject sits neatly inside a circle, it crops cleanly into round profile picture frames on most apps. It suits Independence Day and Republic Day profile updates.
styleNotes: Soft frontal beauty lighting and a golden rim light create a glow that matches the radial orange behind. The palette is matte black, saffron, white and green with metallic gold accents. A perfectly symmetrical chest-up portrait inside a centred circle keeps margins equal for clean circular cropping.
tips: Add your name in gold script below the circle if you want a personalised display picture.
Swap the saffron dupatta for a tricolour stole draped over both shoulders.
Change the outer background from black to deep navy for a softer look.

title: Nehru Jacket Display Picture With Name In Gold Circle
description: This prompt creates a premium Independence Day display picture for men in a 4:5 portrait ratio. The subject appears chest-up inside a centred glowing circular frame on a matte black background, looking at the camera with a soft, confident smile while one hand adjusts a saffron stole or lightly touches the jacket collar. The outfit is a white embroidered kurta with a Nehru jacket in white or deep navy, a flowing saffron silk stole with a green embroidered border, and a small Indian flag lapel pin, with gold-framed butterfly sunglasses and a silver smartwatch. Inside the circle are flowing tricolour silk waves, a soft semi-transparent Ashoka Chakra, a thin gold ring, minimal dotted graphics, a warm orange glow and floating gold particles. Your name appears in large handwritten lettering inside the circle, using a tricolour metallic gradient with a gold outline. The prompt keeps your face exactly as in your uploaded photo and asks for perfect symmetry. It suits Independence Day and Republic Day profile pictures and personal greeting posts.
styleNotes: Soft cinematic face lighting with a golden rim light gives a polished glow against the matte black backdrop. The palette mixes white, navy and saffron with tricolour waves and gold detailing. A perfectly symmetrical chest-up layout inside a circle, with the name below the face, suits round profile crops.
tips: Replace [Your Name] with a short first name so the handwritten lettering stays readable.
Remove the sunglasses so your eyes show clearly in the profile picture.
Choose the navy Nehru jacket for stronger contrast against the white kurta.

title: Overhead Grin On Powder Blue Vintage Car Bonnet
description: This prompt creates a true-to-life photograph taken from directly overhead, looking down at a woman leaning back on the powder-blue bonnet of a vintage car parked on a cobbled old-town lane. Her face, turned straight up to the lens, fills the upper half of the frame while her torso and the bonnet fall away below, with the natural foreshortening of a real overhead camera. She wears clear-frame spectacles lowered halfway down her nose, with one index finger resting on the bridge mid-push and her eyes looking over the frames, and she gives a playful 'caught you' grin with one brow raised. Her other hand lies flat on the bonnet with a gold signet ring. She wears a butter-cream Cuban-collar shirt and stone pleated trousers with layered double gold chains. The prompt replaces the original photo's lighting with bright overcast noon light, giving soft, even illumination and a faint powder-blue bounce off the bonnet. Your uploaded photo guides the face. This suits a playful profile picture, a fashion post or a fun birthday image.
styleNotes: Bright overcast light from above gives soft, even illumination with a gentle shadow under the jaw. The palette is powder blue, butter cream, stone beige and gold against grey cobbles. A strict overhead composition with the face large in the upper half and the bonnet receding below creates strong perspective.
tips: Swap the clear spectacles for sunglasses pushed down for a bolder variation.
Change the car colour to mint green or cherry red to suit your outfit.
Ask for golden-hour light instead of overcast for warmer skin tones.

title: Top Down Playful Glasses Push On Vintage Car
description: This prompt creates a realistic overhead photograph of a man leaning back on the powder-blue bonnet of a vintage car parked on a cobbled old-town street. The camera sits directly above him, so his upturned face fills the top half of the frame while his torso and the car bonnet recede below with natural perspective. He wears clear-frame glasses pushed halfway down his nose, one index finger on the bridge as if pushing them back up, and looks over the frames with a cheeky grin and one raised eyebrow. His other hand rests flat on the bonnet wearing a gold signet ring. The outfit is a butter-cream Cuban-collar shirt with stone-coloured pleated trousers and layered double gold chains that slide slightly toward his collar. The prompt keeps your exact eyes, brows, nose, lips, jawline, beard and hairline, and asks for soft, open overcast noon light with a faint blue bounce from the car. The look is fun and fashion-forward. It suits a quirky profile picture, a style blog post or a birthday image.
styleNotes: Soft, open overcast daylight lights the face evenly, with a gentle shadow beneath the jaw and a pale blue bounce. The palette is powder blue, cream, stone and gold set against grey cobblestones. The overhead viewpoint puts the face large at the top, with the shirt and bonnet tapering down for depth.
tips: Change the Cuban shirt to a printed resort shirt for a holiday mood.
Remove the gold chains if you prefer a cleaner, more minimal styling for the outfit.
Ask for a red vintage car to create stronger contrast with the cream outfit.

title: Misty Emerald Forest Photo Transformation
description: This prompt transforms an existing photo into an ultra-realistic foggy forest scene. Rather than generating a new subject, it reworks your image by adding dense, natural white fog throughout the environment, creating a quiet and mysterious atmosphere. The colour grade is inspired by the forest, using deep emerald, green, dark teal, moss green and earthy brown tones. Trees, foliage and background elements are enhanced to resemble a lush woodland hidden in mist, and soft volumetric light rays filter through the fog to add depth. The prompt also asks for higher clarity and detail, HDR enhancement, balanced contrast and natural colour harmony, so the result looks like a professional DSLR photo taken on a cold, misty morning. It works best with outdoor photos that already include trees, parks or hills. This edit suits nature lovers, travel photos from hill stations such as Coorg or Ooty, moody profile pictures, monsoon-season posts, and backgrounds for quotes or poetry. Portraits remain recognisable because the prompt focuses on the environment rather than the face.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused light scattered through fog lowers contrast, while thin volumetric rays add gentle highlights. The palette is deep emerald, teal and moss green with earthy brown and misty white. Layers of fog create atmospheric perspective, so nearer trees stay crisp and distant ones fade softly.
tips: Reduce fog density to light mist if the subject in your photo starts to disappear.
Add warm golden light rays for a sunrise forest mood instead of cold morning tones.
Use a photo with trees or greenery already in it for the most natural result.

title: Enchanted Woodland Fog Edit With Light Rays
description: This prompt applies an enchanted, misty woodland look to a photo you already have. It fills the scene with soft white fog that drifts between trees and around the subject, making the setting feel hidden and dreamlike. A rich forest colour grade replaces the original tones, built from emerald, deep green, dark teal, moss and warm earthy browns. Background trees and leaves are enhanced so they look denser and more lush, and thin beams of volumetric light break through the haze to create depth and a sense of scale. The prompt also improves sharpness, dynamic range, shadows and highlights so the final image resembles a carefully graded nature photograph rather than a filter. This is a good way to give an everyday garden or park photo a fairy-tale mood. It suits women's portraits in flowing dresses or ethnic wear, pre-wedding and maternity shoots outdoors, monsoon or winter posts, and calm Instagram themes. For best results, start with a photo that is reasonably sharp and taken in natural light.
styleNotes: Fog-diffused daylight creates soft, low-contrast light with gentle beams cutting through the haze. The palette centres on emerald and teal greens with brown bark tones and pale mist. Depth comes from layered fog between foreground, subject and background trees, giving an immersive storybook feel.
tips: Pair the edit with a light-coloured outfit so the subject stands out against the green fog.
Ask for a few fireflies or floating particles for a more magical woodland effect.
Lower the saturation slightly if you want a muted, film-like grade on the forest tones.

title: Moody Teal Forest Fog Effect For Outdoor Photos
description: This prompt gives any outdoor photo a moody, cinematic forest makeover. It adds thick natural fog across the frame, deepens the greens into emerald, teal and moss, and adds earthy brown tones to tree trunks and ground. Vegetation is enhanced to look fuller, and subtle beams of light slip through gaps in the mist, adding depth and drama. The prompt also raises detail and clarity with HDR-style dynamic range, cleaner shadows and controlled highlights, aiming for a realistic photograph from a cold, misty morning rather than a heavy filter. It is particularly useful for men's portraits, bike or trekking photos, road trip shots on ghat roads, and travel pictures from forests, waterfalls or hill stations. The darker, cooler tones give a quiet, introspective mood that works well for profile pictures, wallpaper-style images, music or poetry backgrounds, and monsoon-season posts. Because it edits the environment rather than redrawing the subject, people in the photo stay recognisable. Starting with a well-exposed image in natural light keeps the fog realistic.
styleNotes: Diffused morning light filtered through heavy fog keeps shadows soft, with faint light shafts for drama. The palette leans cool: dark teal, emerald and moss green with brown earth and grey-white mist. Fog layers separate foreground, subject and background, giving strong atmospheric depth.
tips: Try this on trekking or bike trip photos taken on forest roads for a natural fit.
Ask for cooler blue-grey tones if you want a darker, rainy-season mood.
Keep the subject sharp by asking for lighter fog in the foreground.

title: Cold Misty Morning Forest Scene Makeover
description: This prompt turns a regular outdoor picture into the look of a cold, misty morning in a deep forest. It layers dense white fog through the whole environment, recolours the scene in emerald, green, dark teal, moss and earthy brown, and boosts trees and foliage so the location feels like an untouched woodland. Soft volumetric rays of light pass through the mist, and the overall image is sharpened with improved dynamic range, balanced contrast and natural colour harmony. The goal is a realistic, professionally graded DSLR nature photograph rather than an obvious filter. This version is a practical choice for refreshing older travel photos, adding atmosphere to park or campus pictures, or creating calm wallpapers and backgrounds. It also works for group or family photos taken outdoors, since the faces remain unchanged and only the setting is reworked. Use it for winter or monsoon posts, hill station memories, nature-themed profile pictures, or poetry and quote backgrounds. A photo with some greenery already visible will give the most believable fog and lighting.
styleNotes: Cold, diffused morning light passes through fog, softening shadows and lowering contrast across the frame. The palette is forest green and teal with brown earth tones and pale white mist. Layered fog builds atmospheric perspective, making the background recede and the scene feel deeper.
tips: Apply it to group photos outdoors; faces stay the same while the setting changes.
Ask for a light frost on leaves to strengthen the cold morning feeling.
Use a wider landscape photo to make the most of the volumetric light rays.

title: Four Pose Vintage Kurta Collage With Jhumkas
description: This prompt creates a four-frame photo collage of the same Indian woman, styled in a pastel pink embroidered kurta with golden jhumka earrings. Each frame shows a different pose. The top left is a selfie taken while wearing transparent glasses, the top right shows her resting her chin on her hand and looking up, the bottom left is a side profile with one hand touching her hair so the jhumkas are visible, and the bottom right shows her looking down with a gentle smile. The setting is a cozy indoor room with sunlight coming through a window. The colour treatment uses warm vintage yellow and green tones, golden hour light, a touch of soft flash and visible film grain, which gives the set a nostalgic, film camera feel. Skin is kept realistic, and a shallow depth of field keeps attention on the face in every frame. This layout suits Instagram carousel posts, festive or casual ethnic wear updates, and profile collages where you want variety without changing outfits. A clear, front-facing reference photo with good light helps keep the face consistent across all four frames.
styleNotes: Warm golden window light mixed with a soft flash gives gentle highlights and low shadows. The palette blends pastel pink, gold and muted yellow-green vintage tones with fine film grain. The two by two grid gives each pose equal space, and a shallow depth of field keeps the background soft.
tips: Use a well-lit front-facing reference photo so the face stays consistent across all four frames.
Swap the pastel pink kurta for a mustard or sage colour to match the vintage tones.
Ask for a plain cream wall behind her if your room background looks cluttered.

title: Heartbreak Rose Portrait On A Wrecked Red Car
description: This prompt creates a dramatic top-down night photograph of a young man lying across the crushed hood of a damaged red sports car. The camera looks straight down from above, showing the deeply dented metal and a shattered windshield with detailed crack patterns behind him. He wears an oversized light blue knitted sweater with small tears, light washed baggy blue jeans and worn black and white canvas sneakers. His body lies diagonally across the hood, with one arm bent behind his head and the other hand holding a bouquet of deep red roses on his chest. Red petals and broken glass are scattered across the car and the wet street around it. Blue and red neon city lights reflect off the wet metal and glass, while light fog and smoke drift around the front of the vehicle. The mood is melancholic, built around a heartbreak and tragic romance theme in an editorial fashion style. The prompt asks for full facial identity preservation from your uploaded photo. The vertical 9:16 format makes it a fit for reels covers, sad song edits, story posts and moody profile art. A clear, well-lit face photo gives the most accurate result.
styleNotes: Blue and red neon light reflects on wet metal and cracked glass, creating strong colour contrast against the dark night. Light fog adds depth. The overhead camera angle places the body diagonally across the frame, with red roses and petals giving a focal accent of colour.
tips: Upload a clear front-facing photo, since the overhead angle makes facial accuracy harder to keep.
Ask for fewer glass fragments if the scene looks too busy around the face.
Change the sweater to black or white for a stronger contrast with the red car.

title: Purple Floral Anarkali Portrait Against A Sunlit Wall
description: This prompt creates an eye-level outdoor portrait of a young Indian woman standing against a textured white wall in bright sunlight. She wears a purple floral Anarkali suit with a long, flowing skirt and a matching dupatta, both printed with large flower patterns in shades of purple, pink and white. Ornate dangling earrings complete the look, and her dark hair is tied back to keep the earrings and neckline visible. Sunlight falls across the wall and creates shadow patterns on the left side of the frame, while a small patch of green foliage appears at the bottom left. Her expression is joyful and calm, with a slight smile and her gaze directed toward the upper right, which gives the photo a relaxed, candid quality. The composition keeps the background simple so the colours and prints of the outfit stand out. This prompt is a good fit for festive wear posts, Eid, Diwali or wedding guest outfit shares, boutique product shots and ethnic fashion profile pictures. A full-length or three-quarter reference photo works best, since the Anarkali skirt needs room in the frame to show its flow.
styleNotes: Direct daylight produces crisp highlights and soft cast shadows on the white wall. The palette centres on purple, pink and white against clean neutral tones, with a small touch of green. The eye-level framing keeps the figure upright and central, leaving the textured wall as an uncluttered backdrop.
tips: Use a full-length reference photo so the long Anarkali skirt fits fully in the frame.
Ask for a light breeze lifting the dupatta to add gentle movement to the pose.
Swap the purple print for a yellow or green floral suit for haldi or mehendi events.

title: Off Shoulder Blouse Poses In A Pink Oleander Field
description: This prompt creates a soft editorial fashion poster of a young Indian woman in a field of pink oleander flowers. She wears a white off-shoulder fitted blouse with a sheer pink floral scarf draped loosely around her neck and shoulders, along with silver bangles, a layered necklace and drop jhumka earrings. The image shows three poses: standing with her chin tilted up and eyes closed, raising both arms overhead with her fingers in her hair, and sitting on the ground while looking back over her shoulder at the camera. Golden daylight and a warm light green pastel tone give the scene a gentle, airy mood. Pink flowers are blurred in the foreground, and the background melts into creamy bokeh while the face stays sharp. A slight Dutch tilt and a light cinematic haze add an editorial touch. The caption "Blooming where I'm planted" appears at the bottom centre in a thin white serif font. The vertical 4:6 format is designed for Instagram posters, spring or summer posts and nature-themed profile pictures. Swap the caption text for your own line if you prefer.
styleNotes: Soft golden daylight and light haze keep contrast low and skin tones warm. The palette mixes white, blush pink and pale pastel green. Foreground flowers create natural framing, a slight Dutch tilt adds energy, and shallow depth of field turns the background into smooth bokeh.
tips: Replace the caption with your own short line, keeping the thin white serif font.
Ask for a single pose instead of three if you want a cleaner poster layout.
Use a reference photo taken in daylight so skin tones match the warm scene.

title: Moody Two Person Portrait With Black Suit Look
description: This prompt creates a two-person cinematic portrait using two uploaded photos. The first photo is used as the reference face for a young woman, keeping her exact facial features and hair. She wears a black fitted full-sleeve top with small black sunglasses and sits on the left side, leaning back with one hand near her mouth. Her body language is distant and withdrawn, which gives the image an emotional, unspoken tension. The second photo is used for a man styled in a black suit or dark jacket, sitting on a chair and leaning slightly while looking directly at the camera. The contrast between her turned-away posture and his steady gaze creates a story-like frame that suits fan edits, dramatic couple concepts, reel thumbnails and short film style posters. The all-black wardrobe keeps the palette simple and lets expressions carry the mood. For the best result, upload two clear, well-lit photos with visible faces, one for each person, and make sure the first image is the woman's reference. A small Prompt King signature is placed in the left corner of the final image.
styleNotes: Low-key lighting suits the all-black wardrobe, keeping shadows deep and faces clearly lit. The palette is mostly black with natural skin tones. The two subjects sit apart in the frame, her body angled away and his facing the lens, creating visual tension between them.
tips: Upload the woman's photo first, since the prompt treats the first image as her reference.
Use two photos with similar lighting so both faces blend naturally into one scene.
Ask for a dim café or studio backdrop to give the moody scene more context.

title: Withdrawn Pose Duo Portrait In Black Outfits
description: This prompt creates a two-person dramatic portrait from two uploaded photos, built around a young man in a moody, distant pose. The first photo is the reference face for the young man, keeping his exact facial features and hair. He wears a black fitted full-sleeve top and small black sunglasses and sits on the left side, leaning back with one hand near his mouth, looking emotionally withdrawn. The second photo is used for another man styled in a black suit or dark jacket, sitting on a chair and leaning slightly while looking straight at the camera. The difference between the first man's turned-away body language and the second man's direct gaze gives the frame a quiet, story-driven tension, similar to a film still. The black-on-black styling keeps the colours simple, so attention stays on faces and posture. This layout suits fan edits, friendship or brotherhood themed posts, reel covers and dramatic poster concepts. Upload two clear, front-facing photos with good lighting, and place your own photo first so it is used as the main reference. A small Prompt King signature appears in the left corner.
styleNotes: Moody low-key lighting with deep shadows matches the all-black clothing, while faces remain clearly visible. The palette is almost entirely black with natural skin tones. The subjects sit apart, one leaning back and one leaning in, giving the composition a balanced but tense layout.
tips: Place your own photo first so the prompt uses it as the main reference face.
Pick two photos taken at similar angles to keep both faces looking natural together.
Ask for a subtle rim light to separate the black outfits from the background.

title: Night Minimarket Table Candid With Two Friends
description: This prompt creates a realistic night-time candid photo of two men sitting outside a brightly lit Indonesian minimarket. Both faces come from uploaded photos: the first image is the main reference, preserving face shape, hairstyle, skin tone and beard, and the second image is used for the other man, preserving his features and mustache. The storefront has glass windows showing shelves of snacks and drinks, motorcycles are parked along the curb, and red and teal neon reflections fall across the pavement and glass. On a small metal table sit iced coffee, bottled tea, french fries, snacks and a cup of instant noodles. The first man, in a black hoodie, leans back with a hand near his mouth and avoids eye contact. The second man sits opposite, leaning forward with a smile, trying to start a conversation. The style is documentary, shot as a handheld 9:16 smartphone frame with slight motion blur and subtle grain, without HDR or beauty filters. It suits friendship stories, late-night hangout posts, reel covers and slice-of-life edits. Clear, well-lit face photos of both people give the most natural result.
styleNotes: Bright storefront light mixes with red and teal neon reflections on wet-looking pavement, giving a cool night palette with warm interior glow. Slight motion blur and grain mimic a handheld phone. The two men sit across the table, framed by the shop window behind them.
tips: Upload the photo you want as the hoodie-wearing man first, since it is the main reference.
Ask for a local tea stall or bakery front instead of the minimarket for an Indian setting.
Add a little extra light on the faces if your reference photos are taken indoors.

title: Night Minimarket Duo Scene With Black Turtleneck
description: This prompt creates a raw, candid night photo of a young woman and a man sitting at a small metal table outside an Indonesian minimarket. The scene includes glass windows with visible snack shelves, parked motorcycles and red and teal neon reflections on the ground. The table holds iced coffee, bottled tea, fries, snacks and a cup of instant noodles. The first uploaded photo is the woman's reference face, keeping her exact features and hair. She wears a black fitted turtleneck or full-sleeve top with small black sunglasses and sits on the left, leaning back with a hand near her mouth, looking distant and withdrawn. The second uploaded photo is used for a man in a black suit or dark jacket who leans toward her with a serious expression, one hand raised as he talks. The handheld 9:16 smartphone style, slight grain and lack of HDR keep the image looking like an unplanned moment. It suits dramatic couple concepts, story-style reels, short film posters and late-night mood posts. Upload two clear face photos, with the woman's photo first.
styleNotes: Cool neon reflections in red and teal mix with bright white shop light, creating strong night contrast. Fine grain and natural phone perspective keep the look raw. The pair sit on opposite sides of the table, her body angled away while he leans in, framing the conversation.
tips: Upload the woman's photo first so it is used as her reference face.
Ask for a softer expression on the man if you want a less intense mood.
Remove the sunglasses from the woman to show more emotion in her eyes.

title: Burning Rose Forced Perspective Portrait In Red Light
description: This prompt creates a dramatic studio portrait of a young man in a fitted black shirt and matte black sunglasses that reflect fire. He extends one hand toward the camera in a forced perspective pose, holding a burning red rose covered in glowing embers, ash particles and light smoke. Because the hand is close to the lens, it appears large and softly blurred in the foreground while his face stays in sharp focus. His head tilts slightly down and his body is angled, giving the pose a confident, mysterious attitude. The lighting is high contrast red and black, with a neon red rim light tracing his hair, jawline, shoulders and outline. The background is a deep matte black with a soft red gradient glow. The prompt asks for full facial identity preservation from your uploaded photo, keeping face shape, skin tone, proportions and hairstyle the same. The vertical 9:16 format works well for profile pictures, reel covers, attitude posts and Valentine's Day or breakup themed edits. A sharp, front-facing reference photo with even lighting gives the best match.
styleNotes: Strong red rim lighting against a deep black background creates bold contrast and clean edge highlights. The palette is limited to black, red and orange ember tones. Forced perspective places the hand and rose large in the foreground, with shallow depth of field keeping the face sharp.
tips: Use an evenly lit front photo so the red light does not distort your skin tone.
Ask for a white rose with embers if you want a softer colour contrast.
Remove the sunglasses to show your eyes while keeping the fire reflection idea.

title: Royal Blue Saree Boat Portrait On A Lily Lake
description: This prompt creates a wide-angle travel portrait of a young Indian woman sitting inside a rustic black wooden boat in the middle of a large water lily lake. She wears a royal blue silk saree with subtle silver embroidery, a matching blouse, delicate bangles, small earrings and natural makeup, and her long black hair moves in a light breeze. She holds a bunch of fresh purple water lilies and looks away toward the horizon with a gentle smile. Thousands of green lily pads float on clear, reflective blue water around the boat, and large white cumulus clouds fill a deep blue sky. The camera uses a 24mm ultra wide lens from a low position inside the boat, which shows both the subject and the wide landscape in one frame. The colour treatment is vivid and saturated, with strong reflections and natural afternoon sunlight. The 4:5 ratio fits Instagram feed posts, travel and nature content, saree photography and summer holiday memories. Using a reference photo where you are seated makes the boat pose look more natural, and a clear view of your face helps preserve your features.
styleNotes: Bright afternoon sunlight gives crisp shadows and strong reflections on the water. The palette pairs royal blue and azure with emerald lily pads and white clouds. A low, wide-angle viewpoint from inside the boat stretches the lake toward the horizon and places the subject in the foreground.
tips: Use a seated reference photo so the pose inside the boat looks natural.
Reduce the saturation request if you prefer a softer, more natural colour look.
Swap the royal blue saree for pink or yellow to contrast with the green lily pads.

title: Royal Blue Shirt Boat Ride on Lily Lake
description: This prompt creates a wide-angle travel portrait of a young Indian man sitting relaxed inside a rustic black wooden boat in the middle of a vast lake covered with water lilies. He wears a royal blue button-up shirt with rolled sleeves, black jeans, white sneakers and black sunglasses, and he holds a bunch of fresh purple water lilies in one hand while gazing towards the horizon with a confident smile. Thousands of bright green lily pads float on clear, reflective blue water around the boat, and large white cumulus clouds fill a deep blue summer sky. The camera sits low inside the boat with a 24mm wide-angle view, so the bow leads the eye into the scene and the landscape stretches out to the horizon. Natural afternoon sunlight gives crisp shadows and strong reflections on the water, and the colour grading is vivid but still realistic, close to a travel magazine photograph. The result works well as a profile picture, a travel-themed Instagram post, a summer holiday edit or a cover photo for someone who likes nature and outdoor adventure. Upload a clear, front-facing photo so the face reference stays accurate.
styleNotes: Bright midday sunlight with high dynamic range keeps both the sky and the shaded boat interior detailed. The palette is built on deep azure, royal blue, emerald green and white, with purple lilies as a small accent. A low wide-angle composition places the subject in the lower third and lets the clouds and lake fill the rest of the frame.
tips: Swap the royal blue shirt for white linen or a pastel shade if you prefer a softer summer look.
Change the lilies to pink lotus flowers and mention a sunset sky for warmer, golden tones.
Use a 4:5 aspect ratio for Instagram feed posts or 9:16 if you want a Story or Reel cover.

title: Royal Blue Silk Saree on a Lily Pond Boat
description: This prompt shows a young Indian woman seated gracefully in a black wooden boat on a wide lake covered in green lily pads. She wears an elegant royal blue silk saree with subtle silver embroidery and a matching blouse, finished with delicate bangles, small earrings and natural makeup. Her long black hair moves softly in the breeze, and she holds a bunch of purple water lilies while looking towards the horizon with a gentle smile. The water is clear and reflective, and a deep blue sky full of large white cumulus clouds stretches across the top of the frame. The prompt asks for a low perspective from inside the boat with a 24mm wide-angle lens, which gives the scene depth and makes the lake feel endless. Lighting is natural summer afternoon sun with realistic shadows and strong reflections, and the overall mood is calm and dreamy rather than dramatic. It suits a saree day post, a traditional profile photo, a festival greeting or a travel-inspired portrait for someone who loves classic Indian outfits in natural settings. It is designed to be used with a reference photo so the face stays the same.
styleNotes: Even, bright daylight lights the saree fabric and keeps silver embroidery visible without harsh glare. Colours lean on azure sky, royal blue silk, emerald lily pads and white clouds, with purple flowers adding contrast. The boat bow forms a leading line, and the subject sits slightly off-centre against an open horizon.
tips: Replace the royal blue saree with maroon, mustard or bottle green to match a specific festival or occasion.
Add jasmine flowers to the hair for a more traditional South Indian styling.
Ask for golden hour light instead of afternoon sun to get warmer skin tones and softer shadows.

title: Realistic Portrait With Playful 3D Chibi Doodles
description: This creative prompt mixes a realistic photo with cartoon elements. The main subject, taken from your uploaded image, stays fully realistic, while several small 3D chibi versions of the same person appear around her. The miniatures share the same face, hairstyle, outfit and body proportions, and they interact playfully with her or with nearby objects, such as sitting on her shoulder, peeking from behind or waving, without crowding the main figure. On top of the photo, the prompt adds hand-drawn doodle effects: soft white outlines around the subject, sparkles, small hearts, tiny flowers, smiley icons and handwritten words like Life, positivity and travel. The result blends hyper-real photography with soft, colourful illustration, similar to a scrapbook or journal-style edit.
