Open the eyes and look into the camera for a stronger, more direct portrait.
Add a soft crowd in the background if you want more festival context.

title: Upward Gaze Holi Portrait in Golden Backlight
description: This prompt shows a joyful young man in his early twenties looking up towards the sky with a wide, happy smile during Holi. He wears a traditional white cotton kurta-pyjama that acts as a clean canvas for bursts of vivid colour, and his slightly messy dark hair is sprinkled with multicoloured gulal. Fine particles settle on his beard, jawline, eyelashes and skin. Around him, soft clouds of yellow, pink and orange powder drift down like colourful rain, and the background is gently blurred with hints of traditional Indian architecture and celebration. Golden-hour sunlight comes from behind, creating a strong rim light along his shoulders and hair, a glowing halo around his outline, and sun rays passing through floating powder with soft lens flares. The image is shot as if on a 35mm lens, with high-speed photography freezing individual particles and creamy bokeh in the background. The ratio is 9:16. It suits Holi greetings, festive profile pictures, Reels and inspirational posts for men who like dreamy, uplifting festival images.
styleNotes: Golden backlight and lens flare create a glowing halo and warm haze through the powder. The palette is white, sunny yellow, pink and orange. A low, vertical composition frames the upturned face in the upper half, with falling powder filling the space above.
tips: Change the falling powder to blue and purple for a cooler, evening-like palette.
Use a pastel kurta instead of white if you want the clothing to add its own colour.
Ask for a 4:5 crop to make the image fit an Instagram feed post.

title: Brass Pichkari Water Splash Holi Portrait
description: This prompt creates a lively Holi portrait of a young man with a playful, mischievous expression. His face, beard line and hair are dusted with bright pink and turquoise powder, and he holds a traditional vintage brass pichkari, aiming it forward as a strong jet of magenta-coloured water bursts out. He wears a white cotton kurta with slightly rolled sleeves, soaked and splattered with festive colour stains. The background shows a lively Holi celebration in a sunny open courtyard, with soft-focus clouds of powder and frozen water splashes. Bright, direct sunlight creates a shimmering rim light around his hair and shoulders, and every flying droplet catches the light. The camera setup is an 85mm lens at f/1.8 with a shallow depth of field, keeping sharp focus on his eyes and the detailed texture of the brass pichkari. The ratio is 9:16. This is a fun choice for Holi greetings, WhatsApp status updates, Reel covers and festival posts, especially for anyone who enjoys the playful water side of the festival.
styleNotes: Hard sunlight gives crisp highlights on water droplets and the brass surface, with a bright rim around the hair. The palette is magenta, turquoise and pink over white fabric and warm courtyard tones. The pichkari points diagonally across the frame, leading the eye from face to water jet.
tips: Change the water colour to green or yellow to match your favourite Holi shade.
Swap the brass pichkari for a water balloon in hand for a different playful action.
Ask for the courtyard to be a terrace or village lane to match your own celebration.

title: Lavender Lehenga Holi Portrait With Floral Bun
description: This prompt shows a smiling Indian woman celebrating Holi in a pastel lavender and aqua lehenga with intricate embroidery. Colourful gulal is smeared across her face, and her hair is styled in a bun decorated with flowers. She wears a diamond choker and jhumka earrings, which make the look more festive and dressy than a simple white kurta. In the background, a joyful crowd plays with colours, softly blurred so it adds energy without pulling focus from her. Soft natural light and a shallow depth of field give the photo a cinematic, realistic quality. The combination of pastel outfit and bright powder creates a gentle, elegant version of a Holi portrait. It works well for women attending a Holi party or a family celebration who want to look dressed up in their festival photos. It also suits fashion-focused Holi posts, festival greetings and profile pictures. Since the prompt is short, you can easily add details such as the colour of the gulal, the time of day or a specific setting like a haveli or garden.
styleNotes: Soft natural daylight keeps the pastel lehenga and diamonds clear, without harsh glare. The palette is lavender, aqua and silver with multicoloured gulal accents. A medium shot places her in the foreground, with the celebrating crowd softly blurred behind for depth.
tips: Name specific gulal colours, such as pink and yellow, to control the look on the face.
Change the lehenga to mint or peach while keeping the pastel theme.
Mention golden hour light for warmer tones and a softer background glow.

title: Heart Hands Holi Portrait With Henna Details
description: This prompt captures a joyful young woman framing her face with a heart shape made with her hands, her eyes visible through the centre of the gesture. She wears a traditional white kurta heavily splattered with vibrant pigments, and her skin and hair are dusted with fine neon pink, yellow and turquoise powder. Intricate henna designs decorate her hands, adding a cultural detail that shows clearly in the heart pose. The setting is a dynamic Holi scene with thick clouds of multicoloured powder hanging in the air and a soft bokeh background of a festive outdoor courtyard. Bright, warm golden-hour sunlight backlights the powder, creating a shimmering halo, with vivid, high-contrast illumination. The style is high-detail editorial photography, shot with an 85mm lens at f/1.8, with sharp focus on the eyes and hands and a shallow depth of field. It is a cheerful, affectionate image well suited to Holi greetings, Instagram posts and profile pictures, and its heart gesture also makes it a good choice for sharing with friends or family.
styleNotes: Golden backlight creates a shimmering halo through the powder, with front light keeping eyes and henna sharp. The palette is neon pink, yellow and turquoise over white cotton. The heart-shaped hands sit centrally around the eyes, making a natural frame within the frame.
tips: Use a coloured kurta, such as yellow or pink, if you want more colour in the outfit.
Ask for a tighter crop on the hands and eyes for a striking close-up.
Add a friend's hands joining the heart shape for a friendship-themed Holi post.

title: Street Holi Dance Scene With Friends in White
description: This prompt creates a festive group scene of a young Indian girl playing Holi with friends on a lively street. Boys and girls dance together in white traditional outfits that are covered in bright colours, and gulal flies through the air in every direction. The girl is the main subject, with bright smiles and laughter all around her, and the scene has a strong sense of motion and energy. Warm sunlight rays shine through the colour clouds, and the background is softened with bokeh so the main figures remain clear. The prompt asks for realistic details, cinematic lighting, high contrast and a vibrant festival mood, with the face kept the same as the reference image. Unlike single-person portraits, this image shows the shared fun of Holi, making it a good fit for group celebrations, college events, society functions and family gatherings. It suits Holi greetings, festival posters, event invitations and social posts where you want to capture community spirit. Use a clear reference photo of the main subject so her face stays accurate within the crowd.
styleNotes: Warm sunbeams cut through floating powder, creating bright haze and soft highlights. Colours are a mix of white outfits with pink, yellow, green and blue gulal. The main girl sits centre-frame with dancing friends around her, and motion blur on the edges adds energy.
tips: Mention how many friends you want in the scene to keep the composition from getting crowded.
Add dhol players or music in the background for a stronger celebration feel.
Switch to a wider 16:9 frame to show more of the street and dancing group.

title: Pista Saree Holi Laughter With Frozen Droplets
description: This prompt creates a high-speed photograph of a joyful young Indian woman laughing as neon purple and sky-blue Holi powder explodes around her in mid-air. She wears a pista-white saree with a floral border, which is quickly becoming a colourful canvas as the powder settles. Wet fabric details are visible, water droplets are frozen in motion and individual powder particles are sharp. Her expression is candid, with sparkling eyes and natural glowing skin, and slightly damp hair sticks softly to her face, adding to the realism of the moment. Cinematic golden backlighting creates a glowing rim light around the powder, and the background is a soft bokeh blur of a festive crowd with colourful haze. The prompt specifies a DSLR with an 85mm lens, shallow depth of field and a very fast shutter speed, giving a crisp, freeze-frame result. The final image feels like a prize-winning festival capture. It is suited to Holi greetings, festival profile pictures, Instagram Reels and posts for women who like a traditional saree look in their celebration photos.
styleNotes: Golden backlight wraps the powder cloud in a warm glow, while front light keeps the face clear. The palette is pale pista green and white with neon purple and sky-blue powder. The subject is centred, with powder bursting outward to frame her face.
tips: Change the saree to a bright yellow or red for a bolder base colour under the powder.
Use pink and orange powder instead of purple and blue for a warmer feel.
Ask for a slight side profile if you prefer a less direct, more candid angle.

title: Shy Smile White Saree Holi Colour Burst
description: This prompt creates a vertical 4:5 Holi portrait of a young Indian woman captured mid-action as a large burst of yellow, pink, purple, blue and orange powder explodes around her head and shoulders. She tilts her head slightly down and to the side, eyes gently closed, with a shy and joyful smile. One hand is raised near her face as if shielding it, while the other touches her hair near her ear, and her body is angled for a natural, candid pose. A second description in the prompt shows her in a flowing white saree, turning sideways and looking over her shoulder with a soft smile, throwing pink gulal upwards with one hand and holding the pallu with the other, loose hair flying. Cinematic backlight, shallow depth of field and a festive bokeh background tie the scene together. You can choose either pose as the focus. The image is well suited to Holi greetings, festival profile photos and Instagram posts, especially for women who want a graceful, soft-mood celebration portrait in a classic white saree.
styleNotes: Cinematic backlighting gives a glow along the hair and powder edges, with soft fill on the face. The palette is white saree fabric with a full rainbow of powder. A 4:5 vertical frame keeps head and shoulders central, with the burst spreading evenly around her.
tips: Pick one of the two poses described and remove the other for more consistent results.
Add a coloured border to the white saree, such as red or gold, for extra detail.
Use a slower burst with fewer colours, like pink and yellow, for a calmer look.

title: Village Greenery Holi Portrait in Pristine White Saree
description: This prompt creates a high-speed Holi photograph of a woman smiling joyfully as a cloud of neon purple and sky-blue powder bursts around her. She wears a pristine white saree that is quickly turning into a colourful canvas, with water droplets in the air and visible wet fabric details. Her expression is candid, with sparkling eyes full of happiness. What sets this prompt apart is its background: a soft bokeh blur of village greenery, which gives the image a rural, natural feel instead of a crowded city street. Cinematic backlighting adds a glow around her figure, and the image is rendered with detailed skin texture and photorealistic quality. The prompt asks that your face is kept unchanged, so it works with a reference photo. The overall mood is fresh, joyful and simple. This makes it a good choice for women who celebrate Holi in their hometown or village, for family greetings, festival profile pictures, WhatsApp status updates and Instagram posts that celebrate traditional festivals in natural surroundings.
styleNotes: Soft backlight creates a halo through the powder cloud while the green background stays creamy and blurred. The palette is white, neon purple and sky blue against rich leafy greens. A centred medium shot keeps her face in focus with colour spreading to the frame edges.
tips: Add a mud house, banyan tree or fields in the background for a stronger village setting.
Swap the powder colours for natural shades like turmeric yellow and rose pink.
Ask for a 9:16 vertical ratio if you plan to use it as a status or Story.

title: Gender-Neutral High-Speed Holi Colour Portrait
description: This prompt creates a realistic high-speed Holi portrait that can be used for either a man or a woman. It keeps the facial features from your photo natural, with sparkling eyes and a genuine smile. A dramatic explosion of neon pink, blue and yellow gulal bursts around the subject in mid-air, and fine powder particles and water droplets are frozen in sharp motion, giving the image a crisp, action-photography feel. The subject wears a traditional white kurta or saree, which gradually becomes a colourful canvas as the powder lands. Because the prompt is short and open, it adapts easily to different people, ages and outfits, making it a flexible starting point for family members or friends who each want their own festive portrait. The look is bright, cheerful and energetic. It works well for Holi greetings, festival profile pictures, WhatsApp status updates, Instagram posts and printed greeting cards. You can add a background, such as a crowd, courtyard or garden, and a lighting style to make each result feel more personal and specific.
styleNotes: Bright light freezes powder and droplets, making colours look vivid and clean. The palette is white clothing with neon pink, electric blue and sunny yellow. A centred portrait composition keeps the face sharp while the powder burst wraps around the head and shoulders.
tips: State whether you want a kurta or saree so the outfit matches your reference photo.
Add a background such as a temple courtyard or garden to give the image context.
Mention golden hour backlight for a warmer glow around the powder cloud.

title: Neon Pink and Yellow Gulal Freeze-Frame Portrait
description: This prompt makes a realistic high-speed photograph of a joyful Indian man or woman celebrating Holi, keeping your facial features natural with a genuine smile and bright eyes. A dramatic cloud of neon pink, blue and yellow gulal explodes around the subject, with fine powder and water droplets frozen in sharp motion. The subject wears a traditional white kurta or saree that turns into a colourful canvas as the powder lands. The simple structure of the prompt makes it easy to reuse for different family members, and the freeze-frame effect gives the image a professional sports-photography look applied to a festival setting. The final portrait is bright, cheerful and full of energy, with clean white fabric making the colours stand out. It works for Holi greeting cards, festive WhatsApp DPs, Instagram posts and family albums. Because it does not fix a background or lighting style, you can expand it with details such as a sunny rooftop, a blurred crowd or evening fairy lights, or set an aspect ratio for the platform where you plan to share it.
styleNotes: Fast, bright lighting gives crisp edges on every powder particle and droplet. The palette is clean white set against neon pink, yellow and blue. The subject is placed centrally with colour exploding outward, creating a natural frame around the smile.
tips: Add a rooftop or terrace background for a typical home Holi celebration setting.
Mention a specific camera angle, such as slightly low, for a more dynamic portrait.
Use a 1:1 square ratio if you want a clean WhatsApp profile picture.

title: Night Holi Side Profile With Pink Powder and Sunglasses
description: This prompt creates a realistic cinematic Holi night portrait using your photo as the face reference. The subject is shown in side profile, looking upwards and wearing stylish black sunglasses. His right hand is raised above his head, releasing bright pink powder that falls dramatically around him. Neon pink and yellow Holi colours are smeared across his face and beard, and bright splashes of pink and orange powder mark his white kurta shirt. The lighting is intense, moody and low-key, with a dark night-time background dotted with soft red and green bokeh lights, and high contrast that makes the colours glow against the shadows. The result feels more like a film still or music video frame than a typical daytime festival photo. It suits men who celebrate Holi at evening parties or who want a bold, stylish festival portrait with a cool attitude. It works well for Instagram posts, Reel covers, WhatsApp status and profile pictures, especially for anyone who likes darker, dramatic edits over bright and sunny ones.
styleNotes: Low-key lighting picks out the side profile and falling powder against a near-black background. The palette is neon pink and yellow with orange splashes, plus red and green bokeh dots. The side-profile pose leaves negative space in front of the face for the falling powder.
tips: Swap the pink powder for electric blue to create a cooler night-time look.
Replace the bokeh lights with a DJ stage glow for a Holi party atmosphere.
Remove the sunglasses to show the upward gaze more clearly.

title: Smoky Gangster-Style Walk in a Black Suit
description: This prompt creates a cinematic full-body portrait of a young man walking towards the camera through thick, smoky air in a dark, moody setting. He has a light, neatly trimmed beard suited to his age, long swept-back hair, black sunglasses and a sharp jawline, and walks with a confident stride. He wears a black tailored suit with an open-collar shirt, giving a stylish gangster-film look. Dramatic rim lighting from behind outlines his figure, while volumetric fog, high-contrast shadows and desaturated colour grading create the feel of an action movie poster. The framing is centred, with shallow depth of field, film grain and realistic proportions, and the prompt asks for a close match to the uploaded face. The original prompt is titled after a specific upcoming film and copies the style of its promotional look, so it is best adapted into an original poster with your own title text. In that form it suits men who like bold, dark portraits for profile pictures, birthday edits or a personal movie-poster style image.
styleNotes: Strong backlight cuts through dense fog, outlining the suit and hair with a bright edge. Colours are heavily desaturated, close to black, charcoal and grey. A centred, symmetrical composition shows the full body walking forward, with smoke filling the frame around him.
tips: Add your own title and tagline at the bottom to make it an original poster.
Switch the black suit to a dark grey or maroon for a slightly different tone.
Use a 2:3 vertical ratio to get a classic movie poster shape.

title: Back-to-Back Vintage Gunfight Movie Poster
description: This prompt creates a cinematic action poster using your reference photo, keeping your hairstyle, sharp eyebrows, trimmed beard and confident expression. The scene shows two men standing back to back in an intense shootout. One is rugged, with a thick beard, pompadour hairstyle and aviator sunglasses, firing a vintage Thompson gun. The other is a young South Asian man with facial scars firing a compact submachine gun. Flying shell casings and debris fill the air, and the image has high contrast and a gritty action feel. The original prompt places the title of a specific upcoming film in the background and imitates that film's promotional style, so it is best treated as a fan-art idea and adapted with your own title. Because it centres on firearms and violent action, it is suited only to audiences comfortable with that theme. With an original title and less focus on weapons, the back-to-back layout can work as a buddy-film style poster for two friends, a birthday edit or a creative portfolio piece.
styleNotes: High-contrast lighting with muzzle flash highlights creates sharp bright spots against a dark, dusty background. The palette is muted browns, greys and black with orange flashes. A symmetrical back-to-back composition places both figures centrally, giving the poster balance and tension.
tips: Replace the weapons with vintage cameras or umbrellas for a playful, non-violent version.
Use your own film title in bold letters at the top for an original poster.
Put a friend's photo as the second figure for a buddy-style poster.

title: Foggy Cemetery Trench Coat Action Poster
description: This prompt creates a cinematic movie-style poster of a young man with sharp features, a long groomed beard and dark side-faded messy hair, matched to your reference image. He wears dark vintage sunglasses and a long, flowing black trench coat over formal clothing, and is shown in right-side profile firing a vintage submachine gun with muzzle flash and sparks. Shell casings and debris hang frozen in the air. In the blurred background, armed men in 1920s-style flat caps and suits are caught in a shootout inside a foggy gothic cemetery. The colour palette is desaturated and almost white, with dramatic lighting outlining his silhouette against a hazy sky. The original prompt adds the title of a specific upcoming film, its tagline and a release date, which copies that film's promotion, so it should be adapted with your own title and text. As it centres on weapons and violence, it suits mature audiences only. Reworked, the period costume and foggy setting make a strong base for an original noir poster.
styleNotes: Diffused overcast light keeps the scene pale, while muzzle flash adds bright warm points. The palette is washed-out white, grey and black. A side-profile figure dominates the right of the frame, with a busy background shootout softly blurred on the left.
tips: Remove the gun and show him holding a hat or walking cane for a calmer noir portrait.
Write your own film title and date in the fog at the top instead of the original.
Change the cemetery to a rainy 1920s street for a classic noir atmosphere.

title: Palace Balcony Portrait With Taj Mahal and Pigeons
description: This prompt creates a hyper-realistic 9:16 portrait of a woman leaning against a pillar on a palace balcony, with the Taj Mahal visible in the background and many pigeons flying across the sky. She wears a soft white-blue, flowing sheer lehenga with delicate soft pink floral embroidery, bangles on both hands and a necklace. Her hair is combed to one side with a light curl and a small rose tucked in. The framing is vertical, showing the balcony architecture, the pillar and the monument in one view, which gives a royal, romantic travel feel. The prompt asks for the face to stay exactly as in your uploaded photo, so it is designed for personal portraits. The mood is calm and graceful, with the pigeons adding movement and life to the sky. It suits travel lovers, anyone planning or remembering a trip to Agra, women who enjoy pastel ethnic outfits, and those looking for an elegant profile picture, a birthday post or an anniversary-themed portrait in a heritage setting.
styleNotes: Soft daylight gives the white marble a gentle glow and keeps the pastel lehenga clear. The palette is ivory, powder blue and blush pink with a pale sky. The subject leans on a pillar in the foreground, framed by palace arches, with the monument centred behind.
tips: Ask for sunrise light to give the marble a warm pink and orange tint.
Change the lehenga to a deep red or emerald for a more festive look.
Use a 4:5 crop if you want to post the image in the Instagram feed.

title: Navy Saree With Temple Jewellery in a Stone Pavilion
description: This prompt describes a South Indian woman wearing a deep navy blue saree with heavy gold zari work, paired with a backless blouse that gives the traditional look a bold, modern touch. The saree is draped in layers, and the styling uses classic temple-style jewellery: gold necklaces, bangles, jhumkas, armlets and anklets. Her hair is decorated with fresh gajra flowers, a strong cue for South Indian and royal heritage styling. The setting is an ancient stone pavilion or temple corridor bathed in warm natural light, which complements the gold jewellery and rich fabric. The overall feel is graceful and dignified, similar to a bridal or heritage fashion shoot. This prompt suits brides, bridal makeup artists, saree lovers and anyone preparing for a wedding, engagement, reception or traditional function. It also works for festival posts during Pongal, Onam or Ugadi and for traditional-wear profile pictures. You can easily adapt the saree colour and setting to match a particular event or regional style.
styleNotes: Warm natural light falls across carved stone pillars and reflects off gold zari and jewellery. The palette is deep navy, antique gold and warm sandstone. A full or three-quarter figure stands within the corridor, with pillars creating strong leading lines towards her.
tips: Swap navy for maroon, bottle green or mustard to match a wedding colour theme.
Choose a traditional blouse with sleeves if you prefer a more conservative look.
Add oil lamps along the corridor for a festive evening version of the scene.

title: Autumn Park Bench Portrait in Plaid Shacket
description: This prompt creates a realistic lifestyle portrait shot as if on an 85mm lens at f/1.8, giving a creamy, blurred background. A stylish woman, using your uploaded face as reference, sits casually on a wooden park bench. She wears a cosy autumn outfit: an oversized sage green and cream plaid flannel shacket worn open over a fitted white ribbed turtleneck, a long blue denim midi skirt with a front slit and clean white leather sneakers with gum soles. In her right hand she holds a white ceramic mug with steam rising from it, and a structured cognac-brown leather backpack rests on the bench beside her. The park is at peak autumn, with the ground covered in crisp orange and brown maple leaves. Soft, diffused daylight brings out the textures of flannel, denim and leather, and the background shows blurred fall foliage and distant houses. The image feels relaxed and warm. It suits fashion and lifestyle creators, travel posts, winter or autumn-themed profile pictures and anyone who likes cosy, Pinterest-style everyday portraits.
styleNotes: Diffused overcast light gives even skin tones and soft shadows. The palette blends sage green, cream, denim blue and cognac brown with orange leaves. She sits slightly off-centre on the bench, with the backpack balancing the frame and foliage blurring into the background.
tips: Swap the plaid shacket for a mustard or rust sweater for a warmer autumn palette.
Replace the mug with a book or camera to show a hobby you enjoy.
Change the setting to a café terrace for a city version of the same cosy look.

title: Golden Hour Garden Portrait in Tie-Dye Net Frock
description: This prompt creates a realistic half-body portrait of a young Indian woman in a garden at golden hour. She wears a sleeveless net tie-dye frock, and her long, silky brown hair frames a glowing face with soft glam makeup, glossy lips and a sweet smile. Chain earrings and a wristwatch are clearly visible, adding small accessory details to the frame. Warm golden light falls across her and the background is a dreamy blur, giving the picture a soft, romantic feel. The prompt asks to keep your uploaded face and its natural expression, so it is meant for personal portraits rather than generic models. The medium close-up framing focuses on the face and upper body while still showing the colourful frock. It is a simple, flattering setup that suits birthday posts, casual outings, college farewell edits, Instagram profile pictures and everyday social updates. It works best for women who prefer light western outfits and natural garden scenery. You can easily add specific colours for the tie-dye pattern or name particular flowers for the background.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour light gives a soft glow to hair and skin, with gentle shadows. The palette depends on the tie-dye, set against warm greens and amber bokeh. A half-body framing places the face in the upper third with the garden blurred behind.
tips: Name the tie-dye colours, such as pink and blue, so the frock matches your style.
Add flowering trees like bougainvillea in the background for extra colour.
Use a 4:5 vertical crop to keep both face and frock in a feed post.

title: Net Saree Pose Tying Juttis in a Rural Setting
description: This prompt recreates a realistic photo of a young girl in a jade-coloured net saree with mirror work and a matching blouse with puffy sleeves. She wears small earrings, a necklace and bangles, with natural makeup including eyeliner, pink lipstick, eyeshadow and pink nail polish. Her pose is distinctive: she is bending forward to tie a pair of white and blue juttis, which gives the image a candid, in-between-moments feel rather than a stiff posed shot. The setting is an outdoor rural background with trees, adding fresh greenery and natural light. The prompt stresses that the face should match your reference photo exactly and asks for a full image, so the saree, pose and shoes all appear in the frame. This is a good fit for saree day posts, traditional festival photos, wedding guest looks and casual ethnic-wear profile pictures. It suits women who like soft, natural edits with traditional outfits and want something a little different from a standard front-facing pose.
styleNotes: Natural daylight under trees gives soft, dappled light and realistic skin tones. The palette is jade green with sparkling mirror work, white and blue footwear and leafy greens. A full-length frame captures the bending pose, with the saree drape forming a graceful curve.
tips: Change the saree colour to peach or lavender while keeping the mirror work detail.
Ask for a standing pose holding the pallu if bending feels awkward for your photo.
Replace the rural background with a garden or courtyard for a different setting.

title: Emerald Velvet Saree Side Portrait With Oxidised Jhumkas
description: This prompt creates a realistic side-angle portrait of a woman facing the camera, keeping her original face from your reference photo. Her hair is styled in a high messy bun with soft curly strands framing her face. She wears an emerald green and white velvet saree with a blue velvet blouse, and the side angle shows the blouse's deep lace-up butterfly back. Large oxidised silver jhumka earrings and silver bangles complete the look, giving a slightly boho, indo-western twist to the traditional outfit. The background is an elegant white floral setup, and professional studio-style lighting keeps the image clean and detailed. The combination of rich velvet, silver jewellery and a soft white floral backdrop creates a refined, fashion-shoot feel. This prompt suits festive occasions such as Diwali, weddings, receptions and saree day events, as well as fashion posts and traditional profile pictures. It is well suited to women who like statement blouses and oxidised jewellery and want a portrait that highlights both the outfit and the hairstyle.
styleNotes: Soft, professional lighting brings out the sheen of velvet and the texture of oxidised silver. The palette is emerald green, white and royal blue with silver accents. A side-angle composition shows both the face and the blouse back, with white flowers filling the background.
tips: Change the emerald saree to wine or navy velvet for a winter wedding look.
Swap oxidised silver for gold jhumkas if you want a more classic festive style.
Ask for a 4:5 ratio and slightly wider framing to show more of the saree drape.

title: Lilac Lehenga Walk With Sky Close-Up Poster
description: This prompt creates a cinematic, film-poster style image of an Indian girl in a lilac chiffon lehenga with a matching sleeveless blouse. The blouse has shoulder dori ties with pearl latkans, and she wears juttis, jhumka earrings and dark red lipstick. Her hair is braided and decorated with large multicoloured roses, and a net dupatta flows from the back of her head. The main figure is shown full-body from behind, walking away from the camera, which highlights the lehenga, braid and flowing dupatta. In the sky above, a very large close-up of the same girl's smiling face appears, with her eyes looking away, as in a classic Bollywood poster layout. Dramatic lighting and a sharp, clear finish complete the look, with no extra text. This prompt suits women who love ethnic fashion and filmy edits, and it works well for mehendi or sangeet functions, festive posts, birthday edits and creative profile pictures. It is a good option when you want a poster-like image rather than a simple portrait.
styleNotes: Dramatic, warm lighting highlights the flowing dupatta and the face in the sky. The palette is soft lilac, pearl white and dark red with multicoloured rose accents. The walking figure sits in the lower half while the large face fills the upper sky, creating a layered poster composition.
tips: Change the lehenga to mint or peach and keep the roses in the braid for contrast.
Add your name as a film-style title at the bottom for a personal poster.
Turn the walking figure slightly sideways if you want the outfit's front to show.

title: Purple Lahariya Rajasthani Lehenga Close-Up Portrait
description: This prompt creates a realistic close-up portrait of a young woman in a traditional Rajasthani outfit, using your uploaded face. She wears a purple and beige lehenga with silver gota-patti work, and the overall dress is purple with pink lahariya dots, a classic tie-dye pattern from Rajasthan. A purple dupatta is draped over her head, and she wears bangles and large stone-worked dangling earrings made of many strands. description: This prompt creates a playful, upscale couple portrait set inside an elegant café. The man wears a beige blazer and the woman wears a soft pink satin dress, so the outfits feel coordinated in warm, light tones. Warm indoor lighting fills the scene, and the café background is softly blurred with a cinematic depth of field so the couple remains the clear focus. The skin is rendered bright and luminous, and the prompt calls for an 85mm lens look with ultra-realistic detail on fabric and expressions. A strict face-lock instruction asks the model to keep both faces identical to the uploaded reference, preserving features, skin tone and natural details rather than beautifying them. The output is vertical 9:16, good for stories and reels. This style suits couples looking for a refined Chocolate Day photo, a date-night themed post, or a cheerful Valentine's week picture. It also works as an anniversary image for couples who enjoy café dates. Upload a sharp reference photo of both partners for the best match, preferably one where both are smiling naturally.
styleNotes: Warm tungsten-style café lighting gives a cosy glow with soft background bokeh. The palette blends beige, champagne, blush pink and chocolate brown. The couple fills the centre of a vertical frame at medium distance, with shallow depth of field and smooth cinematic grading adding a polished, editorial finish.
tips: Swap the café for a candle-lit dinner table if you want a more formal date-night look.
Change the woman's dress to deep red and the man's blazer to navy for richer contrast.
Ask for a dessert plate with chocolate cake on the table for extra detail.

title: Kneeling Proposal in Fairy-Lit Evening Garden
description: This Propose Day prompt shows a couple from a reference image in a romantic evening garden. The man, keeping his exact facial features and beard, kneels on one knee and holds out a small velvet ring box towards the woman, who stands in front of him reacting with emotion. Warm fairy lights decorate the garden, creating a gentle glow and soft bokeh in the background. The lighting is soft and low, like early evening, so faces are lit warmly while the surroundings fade into darkness and twinkling lights. The prompt asks for an ultra-realistic, cinematic look, so the image resembles a still from a romance film rather than a staged studio photo. This style suits couples celebrating Propose Day on 8 February, people planning a proposal announcement, or anyone who wants to recreate the feel of their own engagement moment. It can also be used for engagement save-the-date visuals or anniversary posts. Because two people are involved, a clear reference image with both faces visible will improve accuracy. Choose outfits in your reference that suit an evening setting, or describe them in the prompt so the final picture feels cohesive with the garden scene and warm lighting.
styleNotes: Soft, low evening light combined with warm fairy-light bokeh creates a glowing, intimate scene. Colours lean towards amber, gold and deep garden greens. The kneeling man and standing woman form a clear diagonal, with the ring box near the centre of the frame drawing the eye between them.
tips: Add a 'She Said Yes' text overlay to turn the image into an engagement announcement.
Replace the garden with a rooftop terrace and city lights for an urban proposal setting.
Describe matching outfit colours, such as white and beige, for a coordinated look.

title: Navy Suit Ring Proposal With Champagne Gown
description: This prompt creates an emotional, high-end proposal scene. A man in a tailored dark blue suit presents a ring, while the woman, dressed in a pastel champagne-coloured gown, reacts with visible emotion and happiness. Both are rendered with bright, smooth, glowing skin in a Korean beauty style, and the prompt emphasises storytelling through their expressions. Warm golden light bathes the couple, and a shallow depth of field blurs the background so that the focus stays on their faces and the ring. The colour grading is cinematic and warm, giving the image a polished, film-still appearance. An 85mm lens look adds natural compression and flattering proportions. The output is set to a vertical frame, which suits phone screens and social media stories. This style is well suited to Propose Day, engagement announcements, anniversary posts or couples who simply want a formal, elegant romantic image. The luxurious outfits make it feel more like a premium photoshoot than a casual snapshot. Upload a reference image showing both partners clearly, and consider describing a location such as a ballroom, garden or terrace to further personalise the background while keeping the warm golden tone.
styleNotes: Warm golden key light gives a soft glow to faces and fabrics. The palette pairs deep navy with champagne, ivory and gold, creating elegant contrast. The couple is framed at medium distance in a vertical crop, with shallow depth of field and warm, cinematic colour grading supporting the emotional storytelling.
tips: Specify a grand staircase or ballroom background for a more formal, luxury setting.
Switch the gown colour to blush pink or ivory to match a bridal-style theme.
Ask for the ring to sparkle with a small highlight so it reads clearly in the frame.

title: Golden Hour Terrace Proposal With Cursive Greeting
description: This detailed Propose Day prompt sets up a classic proposal moment on a garden or terrace decorated with fairy lights. The man kneels on one knee holding an open ring box slightly forward, head tilted up with an emotional yet confident expression. The woman stands close, one hand covering her mouth in surprise and the other extended towards him. He wears a black blazer, white shirt and dark trousers, while she wears an elegant light-coloured flowing dress. Roses are scattered lightly on the ground, and the background is softly blurred with warm bokeh. The words 'Happy Propose Day' appear in elegant cursive within the background lights, kept subtle so they do not overpower the couple. Golden-hour lighting adds gentle highlights to the faces, and the prompt asks for DSLR-style cinematic photography with natural skin and real fabric texture. A strict face-lock section keeps both faces matched to the uploaded reference, and the frame is set to 3:4 vertical. This prompt suits couples marking Propose Day, sharing an engagement, or recreating a proposal for social media. Use a clear photo of both partners for best results, and keep the negative prompt in place to avoid altered faces.
styleNotes: Golden-hour sunlight blends with fairy-light bokeh for a warm, layered glow. The palette mixes black and white tailoring with soft ivory, rose red and amber. A 3:4 vertical frame places the kneeling man low and the standing woman higher, with cursive text floating gently in the softly lit background.
tips: Change the cursive text to your names and engagement date for a save-the-date image.
Swap the black blazer for a cream or beige suit for a lighter summer palette.
Increase the rose petals on the ground if you want a more decorated, dramatic setup.

title: Red Rose Proposal in a Sunlit Flower Garden
description: This prompt creates a realistic, candid proposal scene in an outdoor garden. A young man kneels on one knee and offers a single red rose to a young woman, who smiles shyly with happy tears in her eyes. Blurred flowers fill the background, and soft golden-hour lighting gives the whole scene a warm, natural glow. The image is meant to feel like a real DSLR photograph, with natural skin texture, genuine emotions and cinematic depth of field rather than an overly polished studio look. Colours are vibrant, especially the greens of the garden and the deep red of the rose. The words 'Happy Propose Day' are written in an attractive font within the image, making it ready to share as a greeting. This style suits young couples celebrating Propose Day on 8 February, students and newly dating partners looking for a sweet and simple image, or anyone wanting to send a romantic message. It feels innocent and heartfelt, focusing on emotion over luxury. For the best outcome, use a reference photo of both partners where faces are clearly visible, and keep clothing casual so the scene matches the relaxed garden setting and natural light.
styleNotes: Low golden-hour sun creates warm rim light and soft shadows. The palette is rich garden green with colourful floral bokeh and a single deep red rose as the focal accent. A horizontal-friendly composition places the kneeling boy and standing girl facing each other, with shallow depth of field isolating the couple.
tips: Replace the single rose with a small bouquet for a fuller, more festive look.
Ask for a park bench or fountain in the background for added context.
Move the greeting text to the top of the frame so it doesn't cover the couple.

title: Heart Frame Proposal With Floating Rose Petals
description: This prompt creates a stylised Propose Day composition built around a large glowing heart-shaped frame. A young woman in a patterned sleeveless dress poses gracefully, while a young man in black jeans and a white shirt kneels beside her with a joyful expression. Behind them, the heart frame is filled with red rose petals and decorative text reading 'Happy Propose Day My Love'. Soft pink and red bokeh petals float across the background, giving the image a dreamy, festive atmosphere. The overall look sits between a portrait and a greeting card, making it easy to share directly on social media or messaging apps. The lighting is soft and flattering, and the colours focus on warm pinks and reds that match the Valentine's week theme. This style works well for couples who want a decorative, celebratory image rather than a plain photograph, and for people sending a romantic greeting to a partner. It is also suitable for status updates and story posts during Valentine's week. Upload a reference photo with both faces visible, and consider adjusting the outfit description to match what you and your partner actually wear for a more personal result.
styleNotes: Soft, even front lighting combines with the glowing heart frame as a backlight. The palette centres on blush pink, rose red and white, with black denim adding contrast. A symmetrical composition places the couple in front of the centred heart, while floating petals and bokeh add depth and movement.
tips: Change the text inside the heart to include your partner's name.
Swap the patterned dress for a solid red or white dress for a cleaner look.
Ask for a darker background to make the glowing heart frame stand out more.

title: White Dress in a Crimson Rose Field at Sunset
description: This Rose Day prompt creates a full-body portrait of a young woman standing in a vast field of deep red roses at golden hour. She wears a flowing white dress with ruffled sleeves and holds a large bouquet of crimson roses close to her chest. Her makeup includes bold red lipstick, and she looks directly into the camera with an intense, confident gaze. The prompt mixes deep, soft green tones from surrounding nature with the saturated red of the roses, giving the image a dramatic, painterly feel. HDR detail keeps both the petals and the fabric sharp, while the low sun adds warm highlights and a glow along her hair and shoulders. The white dress acts as a clean contrast against the sea of red flowers, making the subject stand out immediately. This style suits women who want a bold, editorial-looking image for Rose Day on 7 February, Valentine's week posts, or a striking profile picture. It also works as a general spring or floral-themed portrait. Upload a clear, front-facing reference photo, and note that a full-body framing works best when the reference shows your face in good light at a natural angle.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour backlight creates a rim glow around hair and dress. The palette is dominated by deep crimson roses with muted green undertones and a crisp white dress as contrast. A full-body vertical composition centres the subject in the field, with roses filling the foreground and fading into soft depth behind.
tips: Change the dress to soft pink or pale blue for a gentler, less dramatic contrast.
Ask for a lighter lip colour if you prefer a natural, everyday makeup look.
Use a 4:5 crop for social feed posts or 9:16 for a phone wallpaper version.

title: Man in Blue Blazer Offering a Rose Bouquet
description: This prompt creates an outdoor Rose Day portrait of a young man in a lush green garden. He has expressive brown eyes and styled, voluminous dark hair, and he wears a dark blue blazer over a black shirt for a classy, modern look. Smiling softly, he extends his hand towards the camera, offering a bouquet of fresh red roses with green stems and leaves. Because the bouquet is held forward, the viewer feels as though the roses are being offered to them, which makes the image ideal for sending to a partner. The background is filled with natural greenery and softly blurred foliage, creating a warm, dreamy atmosphere with gentle natural light. The look is polished but approachable, sitting between a fashion portrait and a romantic greeting. This style suits men who want a respectful, charming image for Rose Day, Valentine's week, or a birthday greeting for someone special. It also makes a smart, seasonal profile photo. Upload a front-facing reference photo with good lighting so your features are captured accurately, and consider adjusting the blazer colour to suit your own style while keeping the red roses as the main accent.
styleNotes: Soft, natural daylight filtered through foliage gives an even, flattering glow. The palette pairs navy and black clothing with vivid red roses and rich garden greens. The outstretched bouquet sits in the foreground with slight blur, drawing the eye towards the smiling face in sharp focus behind it.
tips: Swap the blue blazer for a cream or grey one for a lighter spring palette.
Add a small greeting card tucked into the bouquet with a personal message.
Ask for a park bench or garden archway behind him for extra scene detail.

title: Rose Day Sweatshirt Look With Floating Petals
description: This prompt creates a casual, trendy Rose Day portrait of a young man with voluminous dark hair and a neatly trimmed beard. He wears round sunglasses and a white sweatshirt printed with bold black text reading 'ROSE DAY', which turns the outfit itself into the greeting. Looking down with a smile, he holds a single red rose delicately in one hand. Red rose petals float gently through the air around him, adding movement and a celebratory feel. The background is soft and light with a dreamy pastel tone, keeping the image airy and bright. The overall look is relaxed and youthful, more like streetwear fashion than a formal romantic portrait, which makes it a good choice for college students and young men who prefer a casual style. It works well for social media stories, messaging app status updates and profile pictures during Valentine's week, and specifically for Rose Day on 7 February. A clear reference photo with your face visible, even with sunglasses, will help keep your features recognisable. You can also personalise the sweatshirt text to make the image feel more unique, such as a name or a short message.
styleNotes: Bright, soft lighting keeps the scene airy with minimal shadows. A pastel background of blush and cream contrasts with the white sweatshirt, black lettering and floating red petals. A medium close-up with the downward glance and centred rose creates a calm, candid composition with gentle movement from the petals.
tips: Replace the sweatshirt text with your partner's initials or a short message.
Remove the sunglasses if you want your eyes to show for a more personal feel.
Change the sweatshirt colour to black with white text for a bolder contrast.

title: Couple on a Mountain Balcony With a Single Rose
description: This prompt creates a calm, scenic Rose Day portrait of a young Indian couple aged around 20 to 21, standing on a balcony with mountains in the background. The young man rests one hand on the railing while holding a rose, and the young woman stands close beside him with her hair flowing in the breeze. Both face the camera with peaceful, loving expressions. Cool natural light gives the image a fresh, mountain-air feel, quite different from the warm golden tones of many Valentine's prompts. The wide cinematic background shows layered hills or peaks, while a shallow depth of field keeps the couple sharp. An eye-level camera angle makes the photo feel natural and relaxed, similar to a holiday snapshot taken by a friend. This style suits couples who enjoy travel and hill-station trips, or who want a quieter, nature-based Rose Day image. It can also double as a honeymoon-style or travel memory picture. Upload a reference photo of both partners with faces clearly visible, and consider describing your own clothing so the final image feels personal while keeping the cool, crisp mountain atmosphere.
styleNotes: Cool, diffused daylight creates a crisp, fresh tone with soft shadows. The palette features misty blues, muted greens and neutral clothing with a small red accent from the rose. An eye-level medium shot frames the couple against a wide mountain backdrop, with shallow depth of field separating them from the scenery.
tips: Add light morning mist over the mountains for a softer, dreamier atmosphere.
Switch to warm sunset light if you prefer golden tones over a cool look.
Ask for woollen shawls or jackets to match a hill-station winter setting.

title: Sunset Beach Proposal Under a Rose Heart Arch
description: This prompt creates a romantic beach proposal scene at sunset in a 2:3 portrait frame. A barefoot man kneels on white sand wearing a black-and-white striped shirt and beige trousers, offering a large bouquet of red roses. The woman, also barefoot, wears a black sleeveless dress with a white tropical leaf print and smiles softly. Behind them stands a heart-shaped arch made of deep red roses, with glowing candles and petals arranged on the sand, along with the words 'Happy Rose Day'. The sky is a soft pastel gradient, and the calm ocean stretches into the background. Cinematic golden light and a shallow depth of field give the image an 85mm DSLR look, and both partners face the camera, so it reads as a posed celebration photo rather than a candid moment. This style is well suited to couples who love beach holidays, those planning a seaside proposal or engagement announcement, and anyone wanting a destination-style Rose Day image. It also works for anniversary posts. Upload a clear reference of both partners for accurate faces, and adjust the outfit details if you want them to match clothes you already own or plan to wear.
styleNotes: Warm golden sunset light mixes with candle glow for soft highlights on faces and sand. The palette blends pastel peach and lavender sky, white sand, deep red roses and monochrome clothing. A 2:3 vertical frame centres the couple under the rose arch, with candles leading the eye from the foreground inward.
tips: Replace the greeting text with 'Will You Marry Me' for a proposal announcement.
Switch outfits to all-white linen for a classic beach-wedding style palette.
Ask for the arch in white roses if you want a softer, more bridal look.

title: Young Couple With Roses in a Sunny Park
description: This prompt creates a cheerful, realistic Rose Day celebration photo of a young couple around 20 years old. The pair stand happily together in an outdoor park, holding a bouquet of red roses and smiling with confidence. Warm sunlight falls across the scene, producing realistic shadows and natural textures on skin, clothing and petals. Cinematic colour grading adds a slightly polished, film-like tone without making the picture look artificial. The words 'Happy Rose Day' glow softly in a romantic font, so the final image works as a greeting as well as a portrait. The frame is set to a vertical 9:16 ratio, suited to phone screens, social media stories and messaging app status, and the prompt asks for close facial matching with the reference photo. This style suits college couples and young partners looking for a simple, bright and friendly image for Rose Day on 7 February or other days of Valentine's week. It feels relaxed and wholesome rather than formal or dramatic. A reference photo of both people standing side by side in daylight will give the most accurate and natural-looking result, especially if both faces are turned towards the camera.
styleNotes: Warm, direct sunlight creates natural shadows and a bright, cheerful tone. Park greens and blue sky contrast with the vivid red bouquet. A vertical 9:16 composition frames the couple from mid-thigh up, side by side, with soft background blur and glowing greeting text placed above their heads.
tips: Ask for a picnic blanket on the grass for a more relaxed date setting.
Change the glowing text colour to gold or white to suit your outfit colours.
Switch to a 4:5 crop for a social media feed post instead of stories.

title: Joyful Hug in a Flower Park With Sun Rays
description: This Hug Day prompt creates a candid, realistic photo of a young man around 20 years old caught in a moment of pure happiness while hugging. The setting is a park filled with flowers, with rays of sunlight streaming through the scene to create a warm, uplifting mood. The prompt emphasises emotional connection, so the expression is genuine and relaxed rather than posed. A DSLR look with high dynamic range keeps detail in both the bright sunlight and shaded areas, and the skin and fabric textures are meant to appear natural and true to life. The text 'Happy Hug Day' floats softly above the subject, turning the photo into a greeting that can be shared directly. This style suits Hug Day on 12 February and Valentine's week posts, and it can be adapted for friendship, siblings or couples, since a hug is meaningful in many relationships. It is cheerful, warm and light-hearted, good for status updates and stories. For best results, upload a clear reference photo, and if you want a second person in the hug, describe them in the prompt so the model includes both people naturally within the frame.
styleNotes: Bright backlit sun rays create a warm halo and gentle lens glow. The palette mixes fresh greens, colourful floral accents and warm skin tones. A medium shot captures the hug at the centre of the frame, with floating greeting text above and soft background bokeh adding a cheerful, airy depth.
tips: Describe a second person, such as a partner or friend, to complete the hug scene.
Change the floating text to 'Best Friends Forever' for a friendship version.
Use golden-hour lighting for a warmer, more romantic tone than midday sun.

title: Pink Silk Dress Portrait Holding Red Roses
description: This Rose Day prompt creates a soft, refined portrait of a young woman holding fresh red roses close to her chest. She wears a luxurious pastel pink silk dress with flowing fabric that catches the light. Her skin has a bright, smooth glass-skin glow, paired with soft rosy makeup, glossy lips and subtle blush. Her long, silky hair is styled in loose waves that frame her face. The overall effect is gentle and elegant, with a dreamy, romantic atmosphere suited to Valentine's week. Cinematic lighting adds natural highlights on the cheeks and hair, while the background stays soft so the roses and dress remain the focus. The look is polished enough for a professional-style portrait but still warm and approachable. This style suits women who want a graceful image for Rose Day on 7 February, a feminine profile picture, or a gift photo for a partner. It is also a good option for birthday portraits with a floral theme. Upload a clear, well-lit reference photo for the most accurate result, and adjust the dress colour if you want it to coordinate with an outfit you already own.
styleNotes: Soft, flattering front light with gentle glow on cheekbones and hair. The palette combines blush pink silk, deep red roses and warm skin tones against a creamy, blurred background. A close-to-medium vertical frame centres the subject with roses held at chest height, creating a calm, balanced composition.
tips: Change the silk dress to lavender or ivory for a different pastel mood.
Add soft falling petals in the background for extra movement and romance.
Ask for a garden backdrop instead of a plain blur for an outdoor version.

title: Blowing a Kiss Inside a Square Rose Frame
description: This prompt creates a studio fashion portrait of a person with long, glossy dark brown wavy hair, posed waist-up inside a square frame made entirely of densely packed deep red roses with a few green leaves. They wear a red dress and lean slightly forward, blowing a kiss with one hand extended towards the camera. Delicate layered gold chain bracelets and small stud earrings add fine detail. The backdrop is a smooth matte red, so the image becomes a rich, tonal study in reds. Soft, even beauty lighting is paired with a gentle rim light on the hair to separate the subject from the background. The composition is tight and centred, with the rose frame filling the foreground and the subject sitting in its opening. Focus is crisp on the hand, hair and roses, while the background falls into soft bokeh. The prompt specifies a 3:2 portrait crop and an 85mm perspective at f/2.8. This style suits Rose Day and Valentine's greetings, beauty-style profile pictures and creative fashion posts. Upload a clear reference photo and consider your outfit choice for a look that matches your style.
styleNotes: Even beauty lighting with a soft hair rim light gives clean, glossy detail. The palette is almost monochrome in crimson and deep red, with warm skin tones and small gold accents. A tight, symmetrical composition frames the subject within the square of roses, with shallow depth of field keeping the extended hand sharp.
tips: Swap the red backdrop for soft pink to lighten the overall colour scheme.
Use white roses for the frame to create a bridal or winter-themed variation.
Replace the blown kiss with a hand holding a single rose for a calmer pose.

title: Rose-Decorated Room Proposal With Heart Wall
description: This prompt creates an indoor Rose Day proposal scene in a room decorated with red roses. A 21-year-old Indian woman wears a pink frock, and a 26-year-old Indian man in a white shirt and black trousers kneels in front of her, proposing with a single red rose. On the wall behind them, a large heart shape made of roses frames the words 'Happy Rose Day'. The image is meant to be realistic, with natural expressions and true-to-life textures. The room setting makes the scene feel personal and intimate, as if the proposal has been planned as a surprise at home. The rose heart on the wall works as a strong visual centrepiece, and the pink and white outfits keep the colours soft against the many red flowers. This style suits young couples celebrating Rose Day or Propose Day, people sharing a proposal story, or anyone wanting a romantic greeting with a homely touch. It is also suitable for anniversary messages. Upload a reference image of both partners with clear faces, and adjust ages or clothing in the prompt to match the two people being shown for a more natural result.
styleNotes: Soft, warm indoor lighting creates a gentle glow across the decorated room. The palette features deep red roses, a blush pink frock and crisp white and black clothing. The kneeling man and standing woman sit in front of the centred rose heart, creating a balanced, symmetrical composition with clear depth.
tips: Add fairy lights around the rose heart for a warmer evening atmosphere.
Change the frock colour to red or white to coordinate with the rose decor.
Replace the wall text with the couple's names for a personalised keepsake.

title: Gentle Rose Portrait of a Young Man in Daylight
description: This prompt creates a quiet, cinematic portrait of a young man holding a single red rose close to his chest with a soft smile. The skin is rendered with a bright glass-skin glow and smooth texture, with radiant highlights on the face. Soft natural daylight lights the scene evenly, and a shallow depth of field turns the pastel background into dreamy bokeh. The prompt specifies an 85mm lens at f/1.8, which gives a flattering perspective and a strong separation between subject and background. Cinematic colour grading and an HDR look create a film-still quality, while the overall mood is peaceful and romantic rather than dramatic. The single rose keeps the composition minimal and focused on expression. This style suits men who want a calm, gentle image for Rose Day on 7 February, Valentine's week stories or a soft-toned profile picture. It is also a good choice for sending a sincere greeting to a partner. Upload a front-facing reference photo with even lighting, and keep clothing simple and light-coloured so the rose and the glowing skin tones remain the visual focus of the portrait.
styleNotes: Soft natural daylight with no harsh shadows creates an even, glowing finish. A pastel background of peach and cream contrasts with a single red rose. A close-up vertical composition centres the face and chest, with f/1.8 depth of field producing smooth, creamy bokeh and warm cinematic grading throughout.
tips: Wear a white or beige shirt in your description to keep the palette light.
Swap the red rose for a pink one for an even softer, pastel-only look.
Add subtle greeting text in the lower corner if you want to share it as a card.

title: Man on Metal Stool Inside a Ring of Fire
description: This prompt creates a high-contrast fine-art editorial portrait of a young man seated low on a minimalist metal stool in an open landscape of wild grass at night. His legs stretch forward with feet planted firmly, and one hand rests between his knees holding thin leather reins, suggesting quiet control. He wears dark layered clothing: a structured jacket, wide-leg trousers, rugged leather boots and dark sunglasses, with his hair loose and natural. His posture is relaxed and slightly slouched, head tilted down, with a calm and introspective expression. A circular ring of fire burns on the ground around him, and directly behind him stands a powerful horse whose body partly overlaps his silhouette, giving off subtle sparks and embers. The fire casts colourful highlights on skin, fabric and metal against a dark cinematic background. A medium-format look with shallow depth of field gives the image a luxury editorial finish. This style suits men who want a bold, artistic portrait for a profile picture, a poster-style post or a creative portfolio piece. Upload a sharp reference photo; a seated or relaxed pose in your reference can help the final pose look natural.
styleNotes: Low, warm firelight from the ring creates dramatic under-lighting and orange rim highlights against a near-black night sky. The palette is charcoal and black with flame orange, amber and ember red. A centred, low-angle composition places the seated man in the circle, with the horse layered behind for depth and scale.
tips: Replace the fire ring with a ring of smoke for a softer, more mysterious mood.
Ask for a white horse behind him to create stronger contrast with the dark scene.
Use a 4:5 crop to keep both the fire ring and the horse's head in frame.

title: Rain-Soaked Man With a Majestic Owl Close Up
description: This prompt creates an artistic, highly detailed portrait of a man with loose, wet hair partly covered by a large owl perched close to his face. Water droplets sparkle on his skin, suggesting recent rain or an emotional moment, and his eyes are wide and expressive with his mouth slightly open. The owl sits so close that its vibrant orange eye seems to mirror the man's gaze, and the fine patterns and textures of its feathers are rendered in detail. The background is softly blurred to emphasise the connection between the man and the bird, creating an ethereal, almost mystical atmosphere. The colour palette is warm, built on earthy browns, ambers and soft golds that echo the owl's plumage and the man's skin tones. The prompt asks the model to keep facial features unchanged from the uploaded image. This style suits men who want a unique, conceptual portrait for a profile picture, a creative social media post or a fantasy-themed art piece. It also works well as a poster or album-cover style image. Upload a clear, close-up reference photo with your face well lit, since the composition is tight and focuses on facial detail.
styleNotes: Soft, warm directional light picks out water droplets and feather texture. The palette is earthy and warm, with browns, ochres, amber and a vivid orange owl eye as the focal accent. A tight close-up places the face and owl side by side, with a heavily blurred background enhancing the intimate, dreamlike mood.
tips: Swap the owl for a falcon or raven for a different mood and colour scheme.
Use cooler blue tones instead of warm earth tones for a rainy-night version.
Ask for a black background to make the water droplets and feathers stand out.

title: All-Black Streetwear Pose With Smoke Shadow Figure
description: This prompt creates a dramatic full-body portrait of a man in an all-black streetwear outfit with a large shadow figure looming behind him. He wears a black oversized hoodie with minimal text, loose black wide-leg pants, dark sneakers and black sunglasses. One hand grips the back of his head, the other rests near his pocket, and his head is down with chin tucked, feet grounded and body leaning slightly forward. Behind him rises a towering shadow creature made entirely of thick black smoke, with long arms, claw-like hands and sharp glowing white eyes. The smoke swirls upward and outward, and the figure subtly mirrors the man's posture, as if representing an inner dark side. The prompt stresses a realistic, cinematic finish rather than a cartoon look, and asks that the face remain fully original without reshaping or beauty filters. The frame is 3:4. This style suits men who like dark, moody aesthetics for profile pictures, gaming or music-themed posts, and conceptual art about inner struggle. Upload a sharp, natural reference photo; a full-body or three-quarter image will help the model render a consistent outfit and pose.
styleNotes: Low-key lighting with a soft top light separates the figure from the smoke. The palette is nearly monochrome: deep blacks, smoky greys and the stark white glow of the creature's eyes. A 3:4 vertical frame places the man centrally, with the shadow figure towering above and smoke spiralling outward to fill the top of the frame.
tips: Change the shadow figure's eye glow to red or blue for a different mood.
Swap the black hoodie for a white one to create strong contrast with the smoke.
Add light fog at ground level to blend the man and the shadow more naturally.

title: Monochrome Portrait With Divine Mahadev Silhouette
description: This prompt creates a cinematic black-and-white portrait combined with a respectful spiritual element. A man sits on a small wooden stool with his head slightly bowed in a calm, introspective pose. He wears a dark oversized jacket, loose rugged pants and black leather boots, and his facial structure, skin tone, beard, eyes and expression are kept exactly as in the uploaded photo. Emerging from behind his left shoulder is a subtle, semi-transparent silhouette of Lord Mahadev (Shiva), formed from sacred smoke and cosmic energy. The divine figure has a blue-grey tone, a closed third eye in meditation, long matted jata hair with the Ganga suggested as flowing light, and minimal jewellery. A soft divine glow surrounds the figure, creating a peaceful yet powerful presence that contrasts with the grounded human pose. The image is ultra-realistic with cinematic depth. title: Indian Miniature Art Wallpaper on Maroon Mandala Background

title: Red Lit Profile Portrait With Mullet and Chains
description: A hyper-realistic, cinematic close-up profile of a stylish young man from your uploaded photo. He has dark, messy hair styled in a modern mullet, a sparse goatee and thick-rimmed rectangular black sunglasses, and he looks slightly downward with a moody, introspective expression. Accessories add edge: a dangling silver earring, a thick silver link chain and a longer, thinner chain with a cross pendant. He wears a dark, textured black jacket that blends into the shadows. The defining feature is intense, saturated monochrome red lighting. A strong red backlight creates a silhouette and rim light along his profile and curls, while the background glows a solid deep crimson. High-contrast chiaroscuro shadows hide parts of his face in mystery while highlighting hair texture and jewellery. The style is a music video and high-fashion editorial look with volumetric lighting and deep shadows. It suits a striking profile picture, an album or single cover, a music producer's or DJ's social media banner, or a moody reel thumbnail. Swapping the red for another single colour quickly changes the atmosphere while keeping the composition intact.
styleNotes: A strong red backlight and rim light outline the profile, with deep chiaroscuro shadows on the face. The palette is almost entirely crimson and black, with silver jewellery as the only neutral highlight. A tight side-profile close-up places the face against a glowing solid background, with volumetric haze adding depth.
tips: Change the red light to deep blue or purple for a different music video mood.
Remove the sunglasses if you want the eyes visible in the profile.
Use a square crop for an album cover or 9:16 for a vertical reel thumbnail.

title: Black Suit Over Kurta Pyjama in a Desert Setting
description: This prompt describes a charismatic young man with dark, slicked-back hair and gold-rimmed aviator sunglasses, wearing a stylish black suit jacket layered over a black traditional tunic in the shalwar kameez style. He has a slight smirk and a confident expression, and gestures outward with open palms, a relaxed 'what did you expect' pose. He stands in dusty desert or mountainous terrain, with a white vintage off-road vehicle parked to his left. The overall look blends traditional South Asian clothing with sharp tailoring and a film-character swagger, making the image feel like a still from a gritty drama. The prompt text is cut short and contains some typos, so expanding the lighting, time of day and camera angle will help produce consistent results. It suits men looking for a confident, playful profile picture, a reel cover with a dramatic dialogue theme, a styling reference for wearing a blazer over ethnic wear, or a birthday post with attitude. Adding golden-hour light or blowing dust can make the desert setting more cinematic.
styleNotes: The prompt does not specify lighting, so harsh desert daylight or warm golden-hour light both suit the dusty setting. The palette is black clothing and gold aviators against sandy beige terrain and a white vehicle. A medium-full composition places the figure centre-right, with the vehicle to his left balancing the frame.
tips: Add 'golden hour, dust in the air, low camera angle' for a more cinematic finish.
Change the black tunic to white for stronger contrast with the dark jacket.
Fix the cut-off phrase about the gesture so the pose is described clearly.

title: Alpine Winter Portrait Seated on Snowy Rocks
description: A hyper-realistic cinematic winter portrait of a young man from your reference image, with face, hairstyle and expression kept identical. He sits on rugged snow-covered rocks in a vast alpine landscape surrounded by deep winter forests and distant icy mountains. His outfit is layered for cold weather: a grey denim jacket over a black shirt, black cargo pants, winter boots and a patterned scarf blowing in the breeze, finished with sunglasses that add a modern travel look. The shot is styled as a premium editorial with a slightly low, upward angle that gives a heroic presence. Shallow depth of field keeps him razor-sharp while the snowy mountains fade into soft atmospheric haze. Lighting is clean, cool and diffused like real alpine winter light, and a subtle blue-grey colour grade enhances the cold, elegant mood. Textures of jacket, scarf, rocks and snow are rendered in fine detail. It suits winter travel posts from Kashmir, Himachal, Ladakh or abroad, a seasonal profile picture, menswear styling for cold trips, or an adventure brand mood board.
styleNotes: Cool, diffused alpine light produces soft shadows and clean highlights on snow and fabric. A blue-grey grade gives a crisp, elegant cold palette with grey denim, black clothing and a patterned scarf for texture. A low upward angle frames the seated subject against hazy mountains, adding scale and depth.
tips: Swap the grey denim jacket for a puffer jacket in mustard for a bold colour accent.
Add light falling snow to make the winter atmosphere more dynamic.
Use a 16:9 landscape frame to show more of the mountains behind him.

title: Close Up Street Style Portrait With Silver Chain
description: This prompt creates a hyper-realistic cinematic close-up of a young man, using the face from your selfie with the same hairstyle and natural expression. He wears a clean black crew-neck T-shirt with a minimal silver chain, a polished, modern street-style look. The scene is outdoors in soft daylight, where warm highlights trace the contours of his face and subtle rim light touches his hair, creating a high-end editorial glow. Cinematic colour grading balances warm golden tones with cool shadows, and skin texture stays natural and detailed. The composition is a sharp close-up taken slightly from the side, with shallow depth of field blurring softly lit urban elements in muted tones behind him so the face remains the focus. Fabric texture and reflections on the chain are rendered clearly. The overall feel is modern, emotional and atmospheric, suitable for social media storytelling. It suits a clean profile picture for Instagram or dating apps, a portfolio image for models and actors, a personal brand headshot with a relaxed vibe, or a reel cover. Minimal styling makes it easy to adapt to any wardrobe.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused daylight with gentle rim light on the hair gives a natural editorial glow. Warm golden highlights are balanced by cool shadows in the grade. A tight close-up from a slight side angle keeps eyes and jawline sharp while muted urban backgrounds dissolve into smooth bokeh.
tips: Change the black T-shirt to white or olive for a lighter, fresher look.
Swap the urban background for a beach or park while keeping the same lighting.
Use a 4:5 crop for Instagram posts or 1:1 for profile pictures.

title: Monarch Butterfly at a Boho Wooden Window
description: A gentle, hyper-realistic portrait of a young man with the same face and hairstyle as your reference photo, leaning out of an open wooden window. He holds a delicate monarch butterfly on his fingertip and looks at it with a calm, thoughtful expression. He wears a soft peach-orange button-down shirt with natural folds, a colour that echoes the butterfly's wings. The window is decorated with macramé curtains and hanging planters filled with trailing ivy, and behind him is a cosy boho interior with woven textures. Warm natural light and a golden-hour glow fill the scene, while soft focus and clean warm tones give it a dreamy, cinematic mood. This prompt offers a softer alternative to the many dramatic men's portraits, focusing on calm and nature rather than attitude. It suits a peaceful profile picture, a mental wellness or mindfulness post, a spring greeting, or a lifestyle blog image about slow living. The butterfly can be swapped for a small bird or flower, and the shirt colour can be adjusted to match while keeping the warm window setting.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour window light gives a soft glow on the face and fabric with gentle shadows. The palette is peach, orange and warm wood with green ivy and cream macramé. A medium close-up frames the subject within the window, with the butterfly at the fingertip forming a small, bright focal point.
tips: Change the butterfly to a small sparrow or a single flower for a different nature detail.
Swap the peach shirt for white linen to keep the palette light and airy.
Use a 4:5 frame so the window, plants and butterfly all fit comfortably.

title: Night Walk With a Glowing Neon Rose Girl
description: A surreal, melancholic night scene in which a young man in dark casual clothes and white sneakers walks along a dimly lit path. Beside him appears a golden, glowing neon-style illustration of a girl holding a bouquet of bright red roses, and the two hold hands in the middle of the road. The neon figure emits a soft light that contrasts with the dark, blurred background of distant city lights. The mood is calm and wistful, blending reality and imagination, as though the girl is a memory or a daydream walking with him. The prompt contains some typos, so tidying the wording will help the model render both figures consistently. It suits romantic or heartbreak themed posts, a song or poetry visual, Valentine's Day content, a long-distance relationship message, or a reel cover for an emotional edit.
