The glowing outline style can also represent a friend, a parent or a pet, making it adaptable for remembrance or tribute content. Keeping the man photorealistic and the girl illustrated is what gives the image its distinctive dreamlike contrast.
styleNotes: Low, dim street lighting keeps the man in soft shadow while the neon figure provides a warm golden glow. The palette is dark navy and black, with glowing gold lines and bright red roses as accents. A side-by-side composition on the road leads the eye into blurred city lights in the distance.
tips: Change the neon colour to soft blue or pink to shift the emotional tone.
Replace the roses with a balloon or umbrella to suit a different story.
Correct the typos in the prompt so both figures render more reliably.

title: Royal Jodhpuri Achkan With Multicolour Safa
description: This prompt creates a realistic portrait of an Indian man, matching your uploaded photo, dressed in regal Rajasthani wedding attire. He wears a white Jodhpuri achkan with golden buttons and a pink pocket square, and a traditional Rajputi safa wrapped in bright shades of pink, orange, yellow and cream. Gold and black sunglasses add a contemporary twist to the classic outfit. The background is softly blurred golden light, giving the image a warm, celebratory and traditional wedding atmosphere without distracting details. The result looks like a groom or wedding guest portrait from a heritage celebration in Rajasthan. It suits grooms planning their look, brothers and friends dressing for a baraat, sangeet or reception, Rajasthan Day or Teej greetings, and anyone wanting a royal-themed profile picture. Tailors and ethnic wear brands can use it to visualise a white achkan paired with a multicolour safa before a fitting. Because the setting is simple, the outfit stays the clear subject, and you can easily change colours, add a sehra, or include a sword or brooch for a fuller groom look.
styleNotes: Warm, golden background light creates a soft glow and gentle separation around the subject. The palette is crisp white and gold from the achkan, with vibrant pink, orange and yellow in the safa. A medium, centred portrait composition keeps the turban and buttons in frame against a softly blurred golden background.
tips: Change the achkan to ivory or pastel blue and match the pocket square to the safa.
Add a kalgi brooch and pearl mala to the turban for a groom's look.
Use a 4:5 crop to keep the full safa and achkan buttons visible.

title: Floral Bride Arriving on a Flower Decked Scooter
description: A fun, photorealistic bridal entry concept featuring an Indian bride, using your reference image, sitting elegantly on a scooter heavily decorated with matching flowers. She wears an exquisite floral lehenga in yellow and white, with a floral top and a full skirt made of artificial flowers, along with heavy necklace and earrings. She adds a playful touch with sunglasses, and her hair is tied in a neat bun. The background suggests an outdoor wedding with floral decorations and guests in traditional attire, setting the scene of a lively Indian wedding celebration. This concept captures the trend of quirky, joyful bridal entries that break from tradition while still feeling festive. It suits mehendi or haldi day entries, a bridal shower invitation, a wedding photographer's creative portfolio idea, or a fun bride-to-be announcement on social media. Floral jewellery and outfit designers can also use it to visualise a complete flower-based bridal look. The yellow and white palette fits daytime ceremonies especially well, and the scooter can be swapped for a decorated cycle, vintage car or swing for a different entry style.
styleNotes: Bright outdoor daylight keeps the yellow and white flowers fresh and vivid with soft shadows. The palette is sunny yellow, white and green with gold jewellery and dark sunglasses as accents. A full-body side or three-quarter composition shows both the bride and the decorated scooter, with guests blurred behind.
tips: Change the flowers to pink and white for a softer mehendi-day colour scheme.
Swap the scooter for a decorated bicycle or vintage car for a different bridal entry.
Add a few cheering bridesmaids around the scooter for a livelier wedding scene.

title: Marker Doodle Portrait on Lined Notebook Paper
description: This structured prompt turns your photo into a hand-drawn colour sketch on lined notebook paper. The subject is shown waist-up with arms crossed, keeping curly hair, slight stubble and a warm smile from your face reference. He wears a black button-up shirt with a visible collar and rolled sleeves, drawn with confident ink outlines, crosshatched shading and energetic red and yellow marker strokes that form a neon-like outline around the figure. The page has pale blue ruled lines and a left margin, and the figure sits in the middle-right of the page. Around him, handwritten red marker speech bubbles and boxes read 'SOCIAL MEDIA', 'CAMERA', 'EDITING', 'STRATEGIES', 'BUSINESS' and 'SHOOT', with arrows pointing toward him, small stars, lightning bolts and chat icons scattered across the sheet. A yellow-highlighted box at upper left asks 'WHAT NEXT?'. Visible paper grain, smudges, marker bleed and faint pencil construction lines keep it lively and slightly messy. It is ideal for content creators, marketers and photographers who want a playful profile image, a YouTube thumbnail, a course cover or a services poster.
styleNotes: Flat illustrative highlights replace realistic lighting, with form suggested by crosshatching and marker strokes. The palette is black ink, red and yellow markers and pale blue ruled lines on off-white paper. The figure sits middle-right, balanced by doodles, speech bubbles and a highlighted question box at upper left.
tips: Replace the bubble words with your own skills, such as 'DESIGN', 'CODING' or 'TEACHING'.
Change the marker accents to blue and green for a calmer, cooler doodle style.
Use 16:9 for a YouTube thumbnail or 1:1 for a profile picture version.

title: Misty Teal Landscape Walk With Year Countdown
description: A cinematic new year poster featuring the man from your uploaded photo walking confidently across a soft, blurred foreground. He wears sunglasses, a white and blue button-down shirt and blue cargo pants, and carries a black backpack in his left hand. The background is a misty, ethereal landscape in muted teal, blue and light grey. A large, bold, slightly distressed teal '2026' text overlay dominates the frame, with smaller '365/DAYS' text beneath it, and the camera angle is set from the left side for a three-quarter walking view. The prompt also places a name line at the top and in the corner, which you can replace with your own name or handle. Soft lighting and high detail give it a travel film poster finish. It suits new year greetings, a goal-setting post, a travel plan reveal, a creator's yearly vlog intro, or a motivational WhatsApp status. The fixed layout makes it easy to create a matching series by changing only the text, for example monthly or quarterly posters tracking progress through the year.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused light in a foggy landscape keeps contrast gentle and skin tones natural. The palette is cool teal, misty blue and light grey with a white-and-blue shirt and black backpack. A left-angle view captures the subject mid-stride, with bold stacked typography behind creating a clear poster hierarchy.
tips: Replace the name text at the top with your own name or social handle.
Change '365/DAYS' to a monthly label to create a matching poster series.
Swap the misty landscape for a coastal road to give the walk a travel feel.

title: Tai Ahom Muga Silk Attire With Riha and Jonbiri
description: This richly detailed prompt recreates traditional Tai Ahom attire of Assam in a sunlit portrait, keeping your face exactly as in the uploaded image. The main fabric is Muga silk or a similar rich silk with a natural pale golden lustre typical of Assamese handlooms. The mekhela, a long wrap-around skirt, is mostly golden with heavy red zari motifs such as Konia or Goach buta in the lower part, golden floral motifs above, and a broad golden border at the hem. The long-sleeved blouse has a small standing collar, a contrasting red placket running from neck to chest in a wrap-over style, and decorative red cuffs. A pale gold silk riha shawl woven with a red dragon motif is draped over the left shoulder, edged with a golden border and red florals. Jewellery includes a gold bead choker with red and green stones, a longer Jonbiri crescent or Lokaparo pigeon pendant, and traditional Keru or Jhalak earrings. It suits Me-Dam-Me-Phi and Bihu greetings, Ahom cultural events, heritage photo projects, and anyone exploring the textile traditions of Northeast India.
styleNotes: Warm natural sunlight brings out the soft sheen of the golden silk and the sparkle of red and green stones. The palette is pale gold and honey tones with deep red motifs and small green accents. A medium portrait composition shows the riha drape, collar and jewellery clearly against a soft background.
tips: Change the riha motif from a dragon to floral buta for a lighter, everyday traditional look.
Ask for a namghar or rural Assam backdrop to strengthen the cultural setting.
Use a 3:4 vertical crop so the full mekhela border and riha drape are visible.

title: Rani Pink Tassar Mekhela With Japi in Green Hills
description: A captivating outdoor portrait of a young Assamese woman, using your uploaded image, dressed in a vibrant rani pink pure tassar silk mekhela sador. The garment features a heavy traditional Assamese woven border with red and black geometric patterns running along the lower edge of the mekhela. She pairs it with a fitted black full-sleeve blouse with a V neckline, keeping accessories minimal with small earrings and thin gold bangles. Her long, straight dark hair flows down her back, and she holds a decorative japi, the traditional Assamese conical hat, in red and black that matches the border. Her joyful, slightly averted gaze suggests a natural, candid moment. The setting is a rural landscape with soft-focus rolling green hills and foliage, lit by warm, diffused late-afternoon light that brings out the silk's texture. The medium close-up framing with shallow depth of field keeps the outfit and expression sharp. It suits Bihu celebrations, Assam Day posts, cultural programmes, a vibrant profile picture, or showcasing tassar silk for a handloom brand.
styleNotes: Warm, diffused golden-hour light gives soft modelling on the face and a gentle sheen on the tassar silk. The palette is bright rani pink with red and black geometric accents against fresh green hills. A medium close-up places the subject and the japi in the foreground with a softly blurred landscape behind.
tips: Switch the black blouse to red to tie in more closely with the border pattern.
Ask for the japi to be worn on the head for a classic Bihu dancer look.
Use a 4:5 crop to keep the hat, border and expression balanced in frame.

title: White Saree With Red Border and Plumeria Flower
description: A candid, sunlit portrait of a young woman, based on your uploaded image, with long, dark wavy hair cascading over one shoulder. She looks down softly at a white plumeria, also called frangipani, held delicately in her right hand. She wears a traditional white saree with a deep red border, white embroidery along the border and small red woven motifs, a style associated with Bengali and Assamese weaves. A gold choker and a simple gold bangle on her right wrist complete the look. She sits on a stone platform beneath a large, textured tree trunk on the left, and in the blurred background stands a traditional building with white and red accents, suggesting a temple courtyard or old home. Warm golden late-afternoon light casts a soft glow on her face, and the mood is serene, contemplative and graceful. Professional portrait framing with shallow depth of field keeps the focus on her and the flower. It suits Durga Puja and Pohela Boishakh greetings, Bihu posts, a calm traditional profile picture, or a heritage-themed photography series.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour light from the side gives a soft glow on skin and a gentle shine on the gold choker. The palette is white and deep red with warm stone, bark brown and soft green. A seated medium composition uses the tree trunk as a natural frame on the left, with background architecture blurred.
tips: Change the white plumeria to a red hibiscus to echo the saree border colour.
Add a red bindi and sindoor-inspired styling for a Durga Puja look.
Use a 3:4 vertical crop to include more of the tree trunk and courtyard.

title: Lavender Chiffon Saree Under a Bougainvillea Vine
description: A half-body close-up portrait of a young woman, keeping the exact face from your uploaded image, posing outdoors in natural daylight. She smiles gently with her head slightly tilted and one hand gracefully touching her dark, wavy hair. She wears a floral chiffon saree in pastel purple, with soft pink makeup that complements the outfit. She stands beneath the overhang of a flowering vine covered in clusters of lavender and purple bougainvillea, which perfectly echoes the colour of her saree. The background is a soft-focus blur of green grass and trees, suggesting a park or garden on a sunny day. The overall aesthetic is elegant, natural and fresh, showcasing traditional fashion in a relaxed outdoor setting. This prompt suits spring and summer posts, a birthday or anniversary photo, a soft feminine profile picture, or a lookbook image for chiffon and georgette sarees. Because the flowers and saree share one colour family, the image feels calm and harmonious, and it is a simple template to follow when choosing a shoot location to match an outfit.
styleNotes: Bright natural daylight filtered through the vine gives soft, flattering light with a few dappled highlights. The palette is pastel lavender and purple with fresh green and soft pink makeup. A half-body composition frames the subject under the flower canopy, with blossoms in the upper frame and a blurred garden behind.
tips: Swap the lavender saree for blush pink and ask for pink bougainvillea to match.
Add small pearl earrings for a subtle, elegant accent in the close-up.
Use a 4:5 crop so both the flower canopy and smile stay inside the frame.

title: Burning Plank Hero Shot in a Ruined City
description: A dramatic, hyper-realistic 9:16 portrait based on your uploaded image, keeping the same face and hairstyle. A young man stands calmly on a large scorched rock in a post-apocalyptic urban wasteland. He wears a crisp black shirt, ripped blue jeans, white sneakers and reflective sunglasses, and his expression is stoic as he holds a burning wooden plank, with flames flickering near his hand. Behind him, collapsed buildings are engulfed in massive fireballs and thick black smoke rising into the sky. The image has the feel of an action film poster where the hero stands unshaken amid chaos. The prompt text ends abruptly mid-sentence, so adding details such as the sky colour, lighting direction and camera angle will help you get consistent results. It suits action movie fans wanting a bold profile picture, a reel cover for dramatic edits, a gaming channel thumbnail, or a birthday post with cinematic energy. The scene is clearly fictional and stylised, so it works best as poster art. Replacing the burning plank with a torch or lantern gives a slightly calmer variation.
styleNotes: Fire provides strong warm backlight and orange glow on one side, with smoke creating dark, moody contrast. The palette is black and denim blue clothing with fiery orange, ember red and charcoal grey. A vertical 9:16, slightly low-angle composition places the figure on the rock with destruction filling the background.
tips: Complete the cut-off sentence by describing the sky, such as 'a dark orange sky'.
Replace the burning plank with a lantern for a calmer, survival-themed version.
Change the ripped jeans to cargo pants for a more rugged action outfit.

title: Royal Armchair Birthday Poster in White Ethnic Shirt
description: This prompt creates a movie-poster style birthday portrait of a young man seated confidently on a royal armchair. He wears a richly textured modern Indian ethnic shirt in white, paired with black trousers, giving a clean contrast that reads well even at small sizes. The setting resembles a grand palace interior with ornate columns, gold accents and a warm beige or maroon wall, so the whole frame feels formal and celebratory. Lighting is studio quality, with a warm golden glow on the subject and soft directional shadows that add depth to the face and fabric. Across the bottom, large silver or gold block letters spell out HAPPY BIRTHDAY, followed by a big stylised name line, and a date sits in the top left corner in a decorative font. The composition keeps attention on the seated pose and confident expression, much like a film release banner. It works well as a birthday status image, a WhatsApp or Instagram post announcing the day, or a printed poster for a home celebration. Because the name and date are placeholders, the same layout can be reused for friends, brothers or cousins by editing only the text and uploading a different face photo.
styleNotes: Warm golden key light falls from the front with soft directional shadows, keeping the white shirt bright without losing texture. The palette is ivory, black, gold and deep maroon. The subject sits centred in the upper two-thirds, while the bold title text anchors the lower third and the date balances the top left corner, giving a symmetrical poster layout.
tips: Replace the placeholder name and the May 15 date with the real birthday details before generating.
Swap the white shirt for a maroon or navy kurta if you want the outfit to blend with the wall.
Use a 4:5 ratio for Instagram feed posts or 9:16 for stories and WhatsApp status.

title: Rustic Desert Boss Birthday Scene With Gold Chains
description: This prompt produces a gritty, film-inspired birthday image of a man lounging in a worn armchair in a dusty outdoor setting. He wears a dark red patterned shirt layered with gold chains, bracelets and round sunglasses, and leans back with one leg crossed while talking on a phone, giving a relaxed but commanding attitude. Behind him stand several rugged men in casual shirts and lungis, watching silently, which adds the feel of a mass-entertainer movie still. The warm, hazy desert-like surroundings fade softly into the background so the seated figure remains the clear focus. At the bottom, large gold embossed lettering reads HAPPY BIRTHDAY, and a stylish date appears in the top left corner, turning the scene into a ready-made celebration poster. The mood is bold and playful rather than formal, making it a good fit for friends who enjoy action-film styling, birthday status updates, group chat wishes or a fun banner at a party. The face is taken from the uploaded photo, so the person keeps their own features while stepping into a dramatic, larger-than-life role.
styleNotes: Warm, dusty sunlight with a slight haze gives the frame an earthy, sun-baked look. The palette leans on rust, deep red, brown and gold, with the gold text echoing the jewellery. The armchair sits centre frame, the standing figures form a loose line behind, and shallow depth softens the background to separate the main subject.
tips: Change the Aug 15 date in the top corner to the actual birthday before generating the image.
Replace the phone call pose with a raised tea glass or folded arms for a different attitude.
Try a green or black printed shirt if the red feels too close to the background tones.

title: Rani Pink Net Saree Poster With Rose and Gajra
description: This vertical 9:16 prompt shows a young woman seated in a rani pink net saree with a yellow blouse, yellow bangles and pink juttis. Her hair is tied back and decorated with a fresh gajra and a yellow rose, and she lifts a rose close to her nose with a soft, graceful expression. The face is matched to the uploaded photo and rendered with a smooth, glowing finish. Behind her, a large zoomed-in version of her own face appears in the sky in black and white, styled like a vintage Bollywood film poster with dramatic lighting. This double-image layout gives the picture a cinematic, nostalgic feel while keeping the colourful saree in the foreground as the main point of interest. The result suits festive posts during Diwali, Varamahalakshmi or wedding season, a traditional profile photo, or a poster-style image for a birthday wish. The contrast between the bright pink and yellow outfit and the monochrome background face makes it stand out in a social media feed, and the full-body pose shows the drape and accessories clearly.
styleNotes: Soft frontal light keeps the face luminous, while the background portrait uses high-contrast black and white with dramatic shadows. The palette pairs rani pink and marigold yellow against grey tones. The seated figure fills the lower half in full length, and the oversized face occupies the upper sky area, creating a layered poster composition.
tips: Swap the rani pink saree for a parrot green or royal blue one while keeping the yellow accents.
Replace the rose with a small diya or flower basket for a festival-themed version.
Keep the 9:16 ratio for stories, or crop to 4:5 if you only want the seated figure.

title: Black and White Sunglasses Portrait With City Reflection
description: This prompt creates a dramatic black and white close-up of a man looking confidently upward into a dark void. Strong side lighting carves out the contours of his face and beard, leaving deep shadows on the opposite side. He wears round reflective sunglasses, and the lenses mirror a towering city skyline, adding a story element to an otherwise minimal frame. The background is plain black, so there is nothing to compete with the face and the reflection. The prompt asks to keep the exact facial structure and hair texture from the uploaded photo, so the person stays recognisable while the styling becomes moody and editorial. This kind of image works well as a profile picture for WhatsApp, Instagram or LinkedIn when someone wants a striking but simple look, and it also suits album covers, personal branding or a minimalist poster. Because it is monochrome, it pairs easily with any feed style. Men with beards or defined jawlines get the most from the side lighting, although the setup also suits clean-shaven faces.
styleNotes: A single hard light from the side creates high contrast with deep shadow on the far cheek. The palette is strictly monochrome, from pure black to bright highlights on skin and lenses. The face is framed tightly, tilted upward, with the reflective sunglasses as the visual centre and generous negative space above the head.
tips: Replace the city skyline reflection with mountains, ocean waves or a sunset for a different story.
Use a square 1:1 crop if the image is meant purely as a profile picture.
Add a faint blue or amber tint for a duotone look instead of strict black and white.

title: Snowy Viaduct Train Door Winter Adventure Portrait
description: This prompt places a stylish young man leaning out of the door of a vintage red and gold train as it crosses a snowy viaduct. He wears sunglasses, a black jacket, a white t-shirt and beige cargo pants, and stretches his arms out with a wide smile, giving a carefree travel feel. Heavy snow falls around him, with snow-covered mountains and a small European village visible in the distance. Dramatic lighting and high detail make the scene look like a still from a winter travel film. The uploaded face is preserved, so the result reads as a personal holiday photo rather than a stock image. This style is a good choice for travel enthusiasts, people sharing a dream-destination post, birthday wishes with an adventure theme, or a year-end recap on Instagram. The red train against the white landscape gives a strong colour contrast, which helps the image stand out in a feed. It also works as a desktop wallpaper or a cover image for a travel blog or vlog channel.
styleNotes: Cool, diffused winter light is balanced by brighter highlights on the subject. The palette is snowy white and soft grey, broken by the vintage red and gold of the train and the beige of the trousers. The man fills the doorway in the left or centre frame, while the viaduct curves into the background to add depth.
tips: Swap the black jacket for a mustard or olive puffer to stand out more against the snow.
Change the setting to autumn hills or a monsoon green valley for a different season.
Use a 16:9 landscape ratio for wallpapers or YouTube thumbnails, and 4:5 for Instagram.

title: Cozy Lamplit Winter Night Profile in Knit Beanie
description: This cinematic prompt shows a young woman in side profile on a winter night, hugging herself to keep warm. She wears a chunky knit beanie, a long fringed scarf, a wool coat and patterned mittens, creating a cosy, layered outfit. Warm lamplight falls from the left, while cool blue moonlight fills the rest of the scene and a delicate rim light outlines her hair. Snowflakes drift through the air, her breath is visible in the cold, and snow-laden branches frame the shot. A shallow depth of field turns the background into soft bokeh, while fine detail is kept in the knit textures. A light atmospheric haze gives the final image a calm, fine-art editorial feel. This prompt suits a winter profile photo, a Christmas or New Year post, a moody Instagram story, or a cover for a playlist or blog. It works best with a clear side-facing reference photo so the profile looks natural, and it appeals to anyone who likes quiet, reflective imagery rather than bright, busy scenes.
styleNotes: Warm tungsten lamplight from the left contrasts with cool blue ambient moonlight, with a fine rim light separating hair from the background. The palette mixes amber, navy and soft white. The subject sits in profile slightly off centre, framed by blurred snowy branches, with heavy bokeh behind and a light haze for depth.
tips: Change the beanie and scarf colours to burgundy or mustard for a warmer overall palette.
Replace the lamplight with fairy lights or a shop window glow for a city street version.
A 4:5 portrait crop keeps the profile and branches balanced for Instagram feeds.

title: Alpine Ridge Portrait in White Faux Fur Coat
description: This photorealistic chest-up portrait shows a young woman standing on a snowy alpine ridge under a clear blue sky. She wears a white shaggy faux-fur coat, and her long hair is lifted by the wind. Light freckles, soft natural makeup and luminous skin give her a fresh, outdoorsy look, and she gazes slightly past the camera rather than straight into it. Behind her, snow-covered mountains are softly out of focus, and falling snowflakes sparkle as they catch the backlight. Bright winter sunlight creates a soft rim on her hair and fur, while the overall palette stays cool and clean with icy blues and whites against warm skin tones. The prompt specifies an 85mm portrait look with a wide aperture, which gives a natural beauty-editorial feel and keeps the focus on the face and fur texture. It suits a winter profile picture, ski-trip memories, travel posts or a seasonal greeting. The prompt asks for no text in the image, which makes it easy to add your own caption or wish later.
styleNotes: Bright backlit sunlight produces a glowing rim on hair and fur, with gentle fill on the face. The palette is icy blue, crisp white and warm skin tones. The framing is a tight chest-up crop with the subject slightly off centre, shallow depth of field, and blurred peaks filling the background.
tips: Change the white coat to a camel or blush pink faux fur for more colour contrast.
Add a knitted headband or earmuffs if you want a more playful winter styling.
Ask for golden hour light instead of midday sun for a warmer, softer mood.

title: Snowy Forest Moment With a White Reindeer
description: This winter lifestyle prompt captures a tender moment between a young woman and a white reindeer in a snowy clearing. She squats in fresh snow and reaches toward the reindeer's muzzle, or blows it a kiss, while the animal's large branched antlers fill the upper part of the frame. She wears a white faux-fur cropped jacket with a hood, white leggings and beige fur-trimmed boots, with her hair in a high ponytail. Gentle snow falls throughout the scene, and a dark conifer forest sits softly blurred in the background. The composition is a tight two-subject side profile, with the reindeer on the left facing right and the woman on the right facing left, so their faces meet in the middle. Soft overcast daylight keeps the whites clean and the shadows gentle. The result feels playful and warm despite the cold setting, making it suitable for Christmas greetings, winter holiday posts, nature-lover profiles or a calendar-style image. It works best with a clear side or three-quarter face reference.
styleNotes: Soft overcast daylight gives even exposure with minimal harsh shadows. The palette blends cool snowy whites with warm browns from the boots, antlers and fur trim. A balanced two-subject side-profile composition places faces at the centre, with antlers rising above and a blurred dark forest giving contrast behind.
tips: Swap the white outfit for a red or emerald coat to make the subject pop against the snow.
Replace the reindeer with a husky or a horse for a different animal companion.
Use a 3:2 landscape crop to show more forest and the full antlers.

title: Frosty Double Exposure Winter Poster of a Bearded Man
description: This prompt creates a cinematic winter poster of a man with messy, slightly long black hair and a trimmed beard. He stands calmly in a cold, snowy environment, looking down, wearing a light grey winter jacket with the sleeves slightly rolled up and one hand in his pocket. His face and hair carry a frosty dusting, as though snow has settled on him. The background is bright white with soft blue-grey shadows, giving a peaceful, chilly tone. A double exposure effect blends his torso with a snowy forest pathway, where a smaller version of him is seen running between the trees, adding a story and a sense of memory to the image. The final composition is detailed and realistic, similar to a film or music album poster. It suits a winter-themed profile picture, a cover image for a story or song, a reflective quote post, or a personal brand banner. Men with beards and longer hair match the reference look most closely, but the styling adapts to other hairstyles as well.
styleNotes: Soft, high-key light keeps the background almost white, with cool blue-grey shadows shaping the jacket and face. The palette is grey, white and pale blue. The man occupies the centre as a half-body figure, and the double exposure forest path is set inside his torso, leading the eye toward the small running figure.
tips: Replace the forest path with a city street or mountain road inside the double exposure.
Change the grey jacket to black for a stronger silhouette against the white background.
Add a short title or quote in thin lettering at the bottom for a poster finish.

title: Black Long Coat Portrait in Gentle Falling Snow
description: This prompt creates a cinematic winter photoshoot of a man standing in falling snow while keeping his exact facial features from the reference photo. Close-up framing highlights natural skin tones with a gentle baby-pink blush and warm, flushed cheeks, as if he has been standing in the cold for a while. He wears a cosy black long coat over a black top, giving a sleek, all-dark outfit that contrasts strongly with the white snowflakes. The overall effect is calm and stylish, similar to a winter fashion editorial or a scene from a romantic film. Because the outfit is simple and monochrome, the attention stays on the face, the expression and the texture of the snow. This prompt is a good pick for a winter profile picture, a Christmas or New Year post, or a quiet mood shot for Instagram. It suits men who prefer minimal, classic styling rather than bright colours, and the close-up composition works well for both square and vertical crops on any social platform.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused winter daylight keeps the skin tones gentle, with a slight pink warmth on the cheeks. The palette is dominated by black clothing against white and pale grey snow. Close-up and half-body framing centre the face, with falling flakes in both foreground and background to create depth.
tips: Add a camel or grey scarf to bring a touch of colour to the all-black outfit.
Ask for night-time street lamps behind him for a moodier evening version.
Use a 1:1 square crop for profile photos and 9:16 for stories.

title: Three Panel Winter Mountain Story With Campfire
description: This prompt builds a three-panel vertical portrait series of a man in a snowy mountain landscape, telling a short winter story from top to bottom. The top panel is a side-profile shot at sunset, with the man in a black winter jacket, snow falling and a frozen lake with mountains behind him. The middle panel is a front-facing close-up with sunglasses, a black scarf and coat, warm sunset tones and snow-covered trees softly blurred in the background. The bottom panel shows him seated by a campfire on a frozen lake during blue hour, now in a green fur-hood parka and gloves, warming his hands with a dense pine forest behind. Soft cinematic lighting and a warm-cool contrast tie the three frames together, while detailed snow textures keep it realistic. The format suits Instagram stories, a winter trip recap, a travel reel cover or a personal photo dump. Because each panel uses a different angle, the series feels like a mini film, and it is a good option for anyone wanting more than a single portrait from one prompt.
styleNotes: Warm sunset light in the top two panels shifts to cool blue-hour tones with campfire glow in the bottom panel. The palette moves from orange and gold to deep blue and green. Panels stack vertically in a 9:16 layout, alternating profile, close-up and seated wide shots for visual rhythm.
tips: Change the green parka to red or orange so the bottom panel stands out more.
Replace the campfire with a parked car and headlights for a road-trip version.
Keep each panel equal height so the series crops cleanly for stories.

title: Snowy Forest Cottage Portrait in White Knit Sweater
description: This prompt creates a realistic winter portrait of a young woman with very long brown hair in loose beach waves. She wears a chunky white knitted oversized turtleneck sweater, black leggings and a long dark green cotton scarf, finished with silver crescent earrings. Her makeup is natural, with neutral tones, rosy cheeks and peachy lips, giving a soft, approachable look. She is turned slightly to the left with both hands held in front of her, and her head turns toward the viewer. The background is an evergreen forest with snow covering the ground and a wooden cottage in the distance, smoke rising from its chimney and snow resting on its roof. Natural sunset light falls on her skin, adding warmth to the cold setting. The scene feels calm and homely, ideal for winter holiday posts, Christmas greetings, a cosy profile picture or a seasonal lifestyle blog image. The uploaded photo provides the face, so the result looks personal while keeping the styling of a winter catalogue shoot.
styleNotes: Low sunset light adds a warm glow on skin and sweater while the snowy forest stays cool. The palette pairs creamy white and forest green with brown hair and soft orange light. The subject sits in the foreground at three-quarter angle, with the smoking cottage placed small in the background for depth.
tips: Swap the green scarf for a red or mustard one to add a festive accent.
Change sunset light to soft morning light for a brighter, airier mood.
Ask for a mug of hot chocolate in her hands to strengthen the cosy theme.

title: Fur Trimmed Coat Portrait Holding Fresh Snow
description: This prompt creates an elegant winter portrait of a young woman holding a handful of snow while looking off to the side. She wears a coat with a fur-trimmed collar, and soft natural light brings out the rich texture of the fur and fabric. The setting is a clean, open snowy landscape with very little clutter, giving the image a refined, high-aesthetic feel. The prompt places special emphasis on realistic snowfall, asking for fine, small, natural flakes falling gently through the air rather than oversized or cartoon-like shapes, so the scene looks like a real winter day. The calm side glance and simple background make it suitable for a winter profile picture, a minimalist Instagram post, a seasonal greeting card or a fashion-inspired mood board. It works well for anyone who prefers understated styling over heavy props. Because the composition is uncluttered, it is also easy to add a caption or short quote in the empty space beside her without covering the subject.
styleNotes: Soft, even natural daylight highlights fur texture without harsh shadows. The palette is mostly white and pale grey, with the coat providing a neutral brown, beige or black accent. The subject is framed at half body, slightly off centre, gazing out of frame, with clean negative space and fine snowfall throughout.
tips: Change the coat colour to deep red or emerald for a stronger focal point.
Ask for a light blue hour tone to make the scene feel colder and quieter.
Remove the watermark line in the prompt if you prefer a clean image without text.

title: Smoky Urban Alley Walk in Skull Graphic Tee
description: This prompt shows a young man walking confidently through a gritty urban alley filled with atmospheric smoke, with the face matched exactly to an uploaded selfie. Warm firelight in the background casts a soft orange glow, while cooler street light balances the scene and creates a dramatic, high-contrast mood. He wears an oversized black graphic t-shirt with a bold skull print and stylised text, loose black cargo pants with realistic pockets, straps and stitching, and dark accessories that suit a streetwear look. The camera captures him mid-stride, giving the image energy and a sense of movement, much like a still from an action film or a music video. This prompt suits young men who like streetwear and bold attitude shots, and it works for Instagram posts, reel covers, gaming profile pictures or a poster for a rap or dance video. The smoke and fire elements add depth without crowding the subject, and the dark outfit keeps the focus on the face and posture.
styleNotes: Warm orange firelight from behind provides a glowing rim, balanced by cool blue ambient street light on the front. The palette is black, charcoal, orange and steel blue. The subject walks toward the camera in the centre, with smoke layers and alley walls receding behind to create depth.
tips: Swap the skull graphic for a plain tee or your own logo for a cleaner look.
Replace the fire glow with neon signs for a night-city version.
Use 9:16 vertical framing to show the full stride for reels and stories.

title: Mid Air Black Suit Action Film Still
description: This prompt creates a high-energy action scene of a man in a black luxury suit caught in mid-air, using the uploaded photo for his face. His body is nearly horizontal, one arm extended upward holding a handgun while his legs deliver a powerful kick toward another figure. Several other men in matching black suits surround him, blurred in the background to suggest speed and chaos. The camera sits at a dynamic mid-level angle, framing the moment like a close-up from a big-budget spy film. The prompt references a cinema camera look with shallow depth of field and motion blur on the background figures, which makes the main subject crisp and dramatic. The mood is adrenaline-filled, like a frozen second in slow motion. This style is suited to action film fans, poster-style profile images, gaming thumbnails or a fun edit for friends. It is intended as fictional cinematic art, and the dark suit styling keeps the image sleek rather than gory.
styleNotes: Directional cinematic lighting sculpts the suit and face, with contrast between the sharp subject and motion-blurred figures. The palette is black, charcoal and muted neutrals with cool highlights. The horizontal body creates a strong diagonal across the frame, drawing the eye from the raised arm to the kicking leg.
tips: Replace the handgun with a closed umbrella or empty hand for a softer martial-arts version.
Change the black suits to navy or white for a different colour story.
Use 16:9 widescreen framing to emphasise the cinematic film-still feel.

title: Giant Statue Under Construction Near Mysore Palace
description: This prompt imagines a giant, realistic statue being built near Mysore Palace in Karnataka. The statue is surrounded by scaffolding, with workers welding steel frames and sparks visible around the structure, giving a sense of scale and ongoing work. Behind it, the illuminated domes and arches of Mysore Palace glow against the sky, forming a grand backdrop that instantly places the scene in Mysuru. The contrast between the industrial scaffolding and the ornate palace architecture makes the image interesting to look at and easy to recognise. The prompt does not fix who or what the statue depicts, so users can describe their own subject, such as their own likeness, a family elder, a mascot or a symbolic figure. This works well for Dasara season posts, Karnataka Rajyotsava content, local pride pages, creative edits for friends or a playful birthday surprise showing someone honoured with a monument. It is also useful for creators who want a recognisable Mysuru landmark in their artwork without needing a real photograph of the palace.
styleNotes: Evening lighting with the palace illuminated in warm gold contrasts with the cooler sky and bright welding sparks. The palette includes deep blue, warm amber and steel grey. The statue rises in the foreground, framed by scaffolding lines, while the palace spreads horizontally behind it to show scale.
tips: Describe the statue clearly, for example a seated figure or your own likeness, for better results.
Ask for Dasara lighting with the full palace lit up for a festival version.
Use a tall 9:16 frame to emphasise the statue's height above the scaffolding.

title: Black Overcoat and Beige Sweater in Natural Snowfall
description: This prompt creates a realistic winter portrait of a man holding snow in his hands while looking to the side, with his exact face and features taken from the uploaded photo. He wears a black wool overcoat layered over a beige high-neck sweater, a clean and stylish combination that suits a smart winter look. Small snowflakes rest on the coat and sweater, adding texture and realism. The prompt specifies natural snowfall with fine, true-to-life flakes falling gently, avoiding oversized or cartoon shapes. Soft natural light brings out the textures of the wool and knit, and the background is a clean, elegant snowy landscape that keeps the focus on the person. The overall mood is calm, refined and cinematic, similar to a winter menswear campaign. It suits a winter profile picture, a seasonal Instagram post, a LinkedIn-friendly casual portrait or a Christmas greeting. Men who prefer classic, minimal fashion will find this style a good match, and it adapts easily to different hairstyles and beard types.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused daylight keeps the textures of wool and knit visible without harsh shadows. The palette is black, beige and snowy white, a classic neutral trio. The half-body framing places the subject slightly off centre with hands raised holding snow, gaze directed out of frame, and a clean background.
tips: Swap the beige sweater for grey or burgundy to change the colour accent.
Add a plaid scarf for a more layered, classic winter outfit.
Try a 4:5 crop so the cupped hands and face both fit comfortably.

title: Protective Hero Pose in Black Denim Outfit
description: This prompt creates a cinematic half-body portrait of a young Indian man standing protectively in front of a young woman, using the uploaded selfie for an identical face and hairstyle. He wears a black oversized t-shirt under a black denim jacket, black baggy jeans, round black sunglasses and a black thread tied on his wrist. His shoulders are squared and his posture is strong and still, with a focused expression as he stares toward a blurred villain ahead. Behind him, the woman holds his arm tightly; she wears a light blue denim jacket over a white frock, and half of her face is visible beside his shoulder, showing a mix of fear and trust. The scene borrows from South Indian mass-action films, where the hero shields someone just before a confrontation. It is a good fit for film fans, couple edits, reel covers or a poster-style status image. The all-black outfit makes the man the clear focal point, while the woman's lighter clothing adds contrast.
styleNotes: Moody cinematic light with a strong key on the hero's face and softer fill on the woman behind. The palette pairs all-black clothing with light denim blue and muted background tones. The hero stands centre in half body, the woman is partly hidden over his shoulder, and the blurred villain frames the foreground.
tips: Replace the blurred villain with rain or a crowd for a less confrontational scene.
Change the woman's outfit to a saree or kurta for a traditional film look.
Use 4:5 or 9:16 framing to keep both faces large in the frame.

title: Action Confrontation Hero Stopping a Villain Strike
description: This prompt shows a young Indian man in a tense confrontation, catching a villain's wrist mid-strike and freezing the attack. The face and hairstyle come from the uploaded selfie. He wears a black oversized t-shirt layered with a black denim jacket, black baggy jeans, round black sunglasses and a thin black thread on his wrist. His posture is angled with controlled power, arm muscles visibly tense, and his expression is sharp and fearless. The villain in front is motion-blurred to add cinematic depth, while a young woman stands behind the hero, half hidden behind his shoulder and holding on to him. The whole frame resembles a dramatic still from a regional action film, focused on the moment just before a fight. This prompt suits movie fans, people creating fun hero edits for friends, reel thumbnails or a poster for a short film project. It pairs naturally with the companion protective pose prompt if you want a two-image set telling a short story.
styleNotes: Hard directional light picks out the hero's face and tense forearm, while background shadows stay deep. The palette is black and charcoal with soft skin tones and pale accents from the woman's outfit. The diagonal line of the gripping arm leads the eye across the frame toward the blurred villain.
tips: Change the sunglasses to none if you want the eyes and expression fully visible.
Add rain or dust particles for extra drama around the frozen strike.
Use a wide 16:9 frame to show more of the villain and setting.

title: Street Photographer Portrait by a Wrought Iron Gate
description: This prompt creates a cinematic street portrait of a young male photographer with curly dark hair and a beard. He wears a light grey oversized t-shirt and dark pants and holds a black mirrorless camera fitted with a telephoto lens. He leans casually against a textured stone pillar in front of an ornate, vintage wrought-iron gate, which gives the frame an old-world architectural backdrop. The colour palette is moody and desaturated, with natural light and a shallow depth of field that softly blurs the gate and keeps the face and camera sharp. The result looks like an editorial profile of a creative professional. This prompt is a good choice for photographers, videographers and content creators who want a profile picture or portfolio cover that reflects their work, and it also suits a LinkedIn banner, an about-me page or a personal brand post. The relaxed lean and the camera prop make the image feel candid rather than staged, while the muted tones keep it timeless.
styleNotes: Soft natural daylight with gentle shadows suits the desaturated, film-like grade. The palette is grey, charcoal, stone beige and black. The subject leans against the pillar on one side of the frame, with the ornate gate pattern softly blurred behind, and the camera held at chest height as a secondary focus.
tips: Swap the grey tee for a denim shirt or jacket for a slightly warmer palette.
Replace the iron gate with a heritage street or market background.
Use a 4:5 crop to keep the camera and face prominent for Instagram.

title: Korean Romance Style Three Frame Snow Portrait
description: This prompt creates a 9:16 vertical composite divided into three stacked frames, showing the same man in a winter snow scene with the face kept identical to the reference photo. The atmosphere is emotional and calm, inspired by Korean romance dramas. The top frame is a tight macro close-up around the eyes, with snowflakes clinging to the lashes and cheek. The middle and lower frames step back to show more of the snowy setting and his expression, building a quiet story across the panels. The soft, slightly dramatic mood makes the series feel like a scene from a film where a character waits in the snow. This style suits Instagram stories, reel covers, winter-themed posts, or anyone who enjoys K-drama aesthetics. The macro detail in the first frame gives the series a striking opening, while the wider frames provide context. Because the layout is already vertical, it fits mobile screens without cropping and works well as a phone wallpaper as well.
styleNotes: Soft, cool winter light with gentle highlights on snowflakes and skin. The palette is pale blue, white and muted neutrals with warm skin tones. Three equal vertical frames move from macro eye detail to wider shots, creating a narrative flow from top to bottom.
tips: Change the outfit colour, such as a camel coat, to add warmth across all three frames.
Ask for gentle golden street lights in the bottom frame for an evening feel.
Fix the pronouns in the prompt to match the subject for more consistent results.

title: Rajasthani Red Velvet Jodhpuri Suit With Safa
description: This prompt creates a regal Rajasthani portrait of a man wearing a red and black safa turban, a red velvet Jodhpuri suit and white formal trousers. He wears a gold kada on his right wrist, gold rings on his fingers and two thin gold chains around his neck, giving a traditional royal look. He stands inside a white palace with a bright, almost glowing white background, which makes the red outfit stand out strongly. The prompt includes a placeholder for a name written at the top of the image, so the result can double as a personalised poster. This style suits weddings, sangeet and reception invitations, Rajasthan-themed events, Diwali greetings, Teej or Gangaur posts, or a proud cultural profile picture. It also works well for grooms who want a pre-wedding poster or for anyone celebrating Rajput heritage. The clean white palace setting keeps the attention on the outfit and jewellery without busy distractions, making the image easy to print or share.
styleNotes: Bright, high-key lighting makes the white palace background glow while keeping the red velvet rich and saturated. The palette is red, black, white and gold. The man stands centred in a full or three-quarter length pose, with the name text placed across the top as a poster header.
tips: Replace the Your Name placeholder with the real name or a wedding date.
Try a mustard or pink leheriya safa for a lighter, daytime wedding look.
Swap the white palace for a Jaipur fort courtyard at sunset for warmer tones.

title: Velvet Couch Nightclub Lounge in Green Suit
description: This prompt creates a cinematic portrait of a man relaxing in a luxurious nightclub lounge, with his face and hairstyle taken from the reference photo. He sits on a velvet couch with one arm resting over the backrest and the other holding a glass, dressed in a fitted green tailored suit. Around him, other partygoers smile and laugh, while paper money drifts through golden, smoky air, giving the scene an over-the-top movie feel. The camera is placed at eye level with cinematic depth and dim golden lighting that warms the whole frame. The style borrows from flashy party scenes in films and music videos. Because it centres on nightlife, drinking and money-throwing imagery, it suits adult users who want a playful, larger-than-life edit rather than an everyday profile picture. It can be used for a fun birthday edit among friends or a party invitation, but many people may prefer a toned-down version with a plain lounge setting and a simple drink.
styleNotes: Dim golden lighting with smoky haze creates a warm, glowing atmosphere. The palette mixes emerald green, deep velvet red or brown and gold. The man sits centred on the couch at eye level, with surrounding figures and floating notes softly blurred to keep focus on him.
tips: Remove the money and surrounding figures for a cleaner, classy lounge portrait.
Change the green suit to midnight blue or black for a formal evening look.
Replace the glass with a phone or a coffee cup for an everyday version.

title: Golden Hour Rim Light Portrait in Checked Shirt
description: This prompt creates a realistic portrait of a young Indian man with messy, voluminous hair, using the reference image for his face. He wears a casual checked shirt with an open collar, black rectangular sunglasses and a small earring. Dramatic golden hour light comes from the top left, producing a warm rim light, cinematic flare and soft bokeh in the background. His skin tone stays warm and natural, and the background is blurred, dark and moody, with small sunlight leaks adding texture. The prompt calls for a vintage cinematic photography style, an 85mm lens look at f/1.4, and sharp focus on the hair and jawline. The result looks like a candid film still or a lifestyle editorial. It suits a profile picture for Instagram or dating apps, a casual LinkedIn alternative, or a cover photo for a personal blog. Men with textured or wavy hair will get the most out of the rim light, which highlights each strand against the dark background.
styleNotes: Warm golden hour light from the top left creates a glowing rim on hair and shoulders, with lens flare and soft bokeh. The palette is amber, brown and deep shadow tones. Tight head-and-shoulders framing with shallow depth of field puts the jawline and hair in sharp focus.
tips: Swap the checked shirt for a plain white linen shirt for a cleaner look.
Remove the sunglasses if you want the eyes visible for a profile photo.
Use a square crop for profile pictures and 4:5 for feed posts.

title: Rural Action Scene in White Shirt and Jeans
description: This prompt creates an intense, movie-style action scene in a rural setting. A confident man in a white shirt with rolled-up sleeves, blue jeans, a necklace and a wristwatch stands in the foreground, his expression serious and focused. He plants one foot firmly on a defeated opponent lying on the ground, while dust rises around them to add drama. Several onlookers stand in the background, slightly blurred, with sunlight filtering through trees and a rustic hut behind them. The dynamic camera angle and cinematic lighting make it feel like a key moment from a mass-action regional film. This style is designed for fans of action cinema who want a playful hero edit of themselves, a reel cover, a poster for a short film or a fun image to share with friends. The white shirt keeps the hero bright against the earthy background, making him the clear focus even in a busy frame. It is fictional film-style art rather than a realistic depiction.
styleNotes: Warm sunlight filters through trees, lighting the dust and creating a hazy glow around the hero. The palette is earthy brown, green, dusty gold and crisp white. A low, dynamic angle makes the hero tower in the foreground, with onlookers and the hut softly blurred behind.
tips: Replace the defeated opponent with a raised stick or folded arms for a calmer pose.
Change the white shirt to black for a darker, moodier look.
A 16:9 widescreen frame suits YouTube thumbnails and film-poster edits.

title: Snowy Forest Torii Gate Triptych in Cream Coat
description: This prompt creates a realistic three-frame winter story in 9:16 format, keeping the uploaded face consistent across all panels. The top frame shows a side profile of a young woman in a long cream trench coat and an intricately patterned silk scarf, standing in a quiet snowy forest with her breath faintly visible and soft golden light peeking through the trees. The middle frame pulls back to show her walking toward a traditional Japanese torii gate, set within deep snow and framed by tall bare trees that form a natural arch. The bottom frame is an intimate close-up of her face looking upward, adding emotion to the sequence. The serene, cinematic mood draws on Japanese winter travel imagery. This series suits Instagram stories, travel dream boards, winter photo dumps or a reel cover. It works best for those who enjoy calm, minimal aesthetics, and the cream coat keeps the palette soft and elegant against the snow.
styleNotes: Soft golden hour light filters through bare trees, balancing cool snowy shadows with warm highlights. The palette is cream, white, soft gold and the red-orange of the torii gate. Three stacked frames move from profile to wide establishing shot to close-up, forming a narrative arc.
tips: Swap the cream coat for a burgundy one for stronger contrast with the snow.
Replace the torii gate with a mountain temple or wooden bridge for variety.
Ask for gentle snowfall in all frames to keep the series visually connected.

title: Diamond Cutout Collage Birthday Portrait in Blue Shirt
description: This prompt creates a collage-style birthday image of a man, with his face taken from the uploaded image. At the centre is a full-body portrait of him standing in a light blue shirt and white sneakers, looking thoughtful. Above this sits a larger, thick diamond-shaped cutout showing him in a white jacket and sunglasses with arms folded. Below and on either side of the central figure are two smaller diamond-shaped cutouts with additional poses, creating a layered magazine-style layout. The combination of multiple looks in one frame makes it feel like a fashion lookbook or a celebratory feature page. This prompt suits birthday wishes, status updates, a birthday reel cover or a printed collage for a party wall. It is a good choice when you want to show several sides of a person, such as casual and formal, in one image. Adding a birthday text line and name to the empty areas can make it a complete greeting poster.
styleNotes: Bright, even studio-style lighting keeps all cutouts consistent. The palette is light blue, white and soft neutrals, with thick borders around the diamond frames for definition. The full-body figure anchors the centre, a large diamond sits above, and two smaller diamonds balance the lower sides symmetrically.
tips: Add a Happy Birthday line and name in the empty space near the bottom.
Use different outfits in each diamond, such as ethnic wear, for more variety.
Keep a 4:5 or 9:16 ratio so the stacked layout fits without cropping.

title: White Sofa Birthday With Velvet Cake and Fairy Lights
description: This prompt creates a realistic birthday celebration photo of a young man seated on a warm white sofa. He wears a stylish white casual shirt, black formal trousers and white shoes, and holds a white velvet birthday cake with lit candles. His face comes from the attached photo. The background features an arch of white and gold balloons, warm fairy lights and a Happy Birthday banner, creating a festive party atmosphere. Soft, warm lighting fills the scene, giving the skin a natural glow and keeping the white tones from looking harsh. The overall look is clean and classy, similar to a professional home birthday photoshoot. This prompt suits birthday status images, Instagram posts on the day, thank-you posts after a celebration, or a printed photo for an album. It works well for anyone who prefers a neat, elegant party look over bright, colourful decorations. The white and gold theme also matches many real party setups, making the result feel believable.
styleNotes: Soft, warm light from the front with gentle fill, plus small glowing points from fairy lights and candles. The palette is white, black and soft gold. The seated subject sits centred with the cake held at chest level, framed by the balloon arch curving overhead and the banner behind.
tips: Change the balloon colours to blue and silver or red and gold for a different theme.
Add the age as number candles on the cake for a more personal touch.
Swap the white shirt for a pastel kurta for a festive ethnic look.

title: Black Suit Birthday Shoot With Gold Balloons and Cake
description: This prompt creates a cinematic birthday photoshoot of a man in a black suit worn with a black shirt, the jacket button left open, matching trousers and a belt with a bold buckle. He holds a black birthday cake decorated with candles and the number 26, while gold Happy Birthday balloons fill the background. The face comes from the uploaded picture. The all-black outfit paired with gold accents gives a sleek, luxurious look that differs from typical bright birthday photos. High detail and a cinematic finish make the image feel like a premium studio shoot. This prompt suits men who want a stylish, mature birthday image for Instagram, WhatsApp status, a thank-you post or a framed print. Because the colour scheme is limited to black and gold, the photo looks polished and coordinated. Changing the cake number to the correct age makes it personal, and the dark theme also suits evening parties or milestone birthdays such as 25 or 30.
styleNotes: Cinematic studio lighting with soft highlights on the suit and warm reflections from the gold balloons. The palette is strictly black and metallic gold. The subject stands or sits centred with the cake at chest height, balloons arranged behind and around for a framed composition.
tips: Change the 26 on the cake to the correct age before generating.
Swap the black cake for a white or gold cake for more contrast with the suit.
Add a dim spotlight from above for a more dramatic evening mood.

title: White Satin Suit Birthday Pose With Balloon Arch
description: This prompt creates a realistic birthday portrait of a young boy or young man sitting gracefully with one leg crossed over the other, dressed in a stylish white satin suit. He has short, dark, wavy fringe hair and holds a white birthday cake with lit candles. The background features an arch of white and gold balloons, fairy lights and a Happy Birthday banner, creating a festive setting. Soft, warm lighting fills the frame, and the prompt calls for a 55mm lens look, which gives natural proportions and a pleasant background blur. A small name plate appears in the scene as well. The satin suit adds a gentle sheen, making the outfit look elegant without being flashy. This prompt suits teen and young adult birthdays, Instagram and WhatsApp posts, family albums and printed photos. It also works for milestone birthdays such as an 18th, where a polished look is often preferred. The coordinated white and gold theme makes the image look neat and classy.
styleNotes: Soft, warm frontal light with gentle sheen on the satin suit and small sparkles from fairy lights. The palette is white, ivory and soft gold. The seated cross-legged pose sits centred, with the cake held in front and the balloon arch framing the head and shoulders.
tips: Replace the name plate text with the birthday person's name.
Swap the white satin suit for a powder blue or champagne one for variety.
Use number candles on the cake to show the age clearly.

title: Chocolate Drip Cake Birthday With Neon Sign
description: This prompt creates a vibrant birthday photoshoot of a young man with his face and hairstyle matched to the reference. He wears a black t-shirt, black pants, a golden watch and a chain, and smiles while holding a glass beside a two-tier chocolate cake decorated with a golden drip, chocolates, popcorn and candles. The background has a white, gold and silver balloon arch with a glowing neon Happy Birthday sign, and colourful confetti falls through the air. Bright, high-fashion cinematic lighting with sharp contrast gives the photo a lively party energy. The all-black outfit stands out against the light balloon arch, while the gold accents tie the clothing and decorations together. This prompt suits birthday posts, Instagram reels covers, WhatsApp status images or a thank-you post after a party. It is a good choice for anyone wanting a fun, energetic celebration image rather than a formal portrait. The prompt mentions a branded t-shirt, but a plain black tee works equally well.
styleNotes: Bright, high-contrast fashion lighting with a glowing neon accent behind. The palette is black, gold, silver and white with multicolour confetti. The subject stands beside the cake in a medium shot, balloon arch framing the background and confetti layered in front for depth.
tips: Replace the branded tee with a plain black or printed shirt of your choice.
Change the neon sign text to include the person's name or age.
Swap the glass for a party popper or sparkler for a more playful pose.

title: Beige Suit Birthday With Silver Foil Number Balloons
description: This prompt creates a stylish birthday portrait of a young man in a light beige suit, white t-shirt, white sneakers and eyeglasses, seated in a thoughtful pose. The face comes from the uploaded image. Giant silver foil balloons spelling a number, set to 29 in the prompt, sit in the foreground. The background is a vibrant orange-red wall lit with intense light and decorated with smaller silver foil letters reading HAPPY BIRTHDAY, along with stars and hearts. Silver confetti is scattered on the floor. The warm, saturated wall contrasts with the cool metallic balloons, creating a bold, modern look. Dramatic studio lighting gives it the feel of a fashion magazine birthday shoot. This prompt suits milestone birthdays, Instagram posts, status images and printed photos. It is a good choice for people who wear glasses and want a smart-casual look, and the beige suit keeps the outfit light so it does not clash with the bright backdrop. Change the number balloons to match the right age.
styleNotes: Intense, warm studio light floods the orange-red wall while silver foil reflects bright highlights. The palette is orange-red, beige, white and metallic silver. The seated subject sits centre, with large number balloons in the foreground creating depth and the letter balloons arranged across the wall behind.
tips: Change the 29 balloons to the correct age before generating.
Swap the orange-red wall for teal or navy for a cooler colour scheme.
Remove the eyeglasses from the prompt if the person does not wear them.

title: Spotlit Birthday Portrait in Royal Blue Blazer
description: This prompt creates a full-body glamorous birthday photoshoot with a flash-lit, dramatic look. The backdrop is a plain neutral wall lit by a round spotlight that casts a sharp circle of light, and the wall is decorated with Happy Birthday letter balloons plus red, blue and green balloons scattered around. A young man stands slightly smiling, firmly holding a strawberry and chocolate cake topped with lit number candles reading 28. He wears a bright royal blue blazer over a dark hunter green shirt, a dark brown belt, black jeans and dark brown shoes, an unusual colour combination that photographs well. The round spotlight frames him like a stage performer, making the image feel like a celebrity birthday shoot. This prompt suits birthday status images, Instagram posts, family photo albums or a party invite. The colourful balloons keep the mood fun while the blazer keeps it smart. Changing the candle numbers to the correct age makes the photo personal.
styleNotes: A round spotlight with on-camera flash creates sharp, dramatic light and a defined circle on the wall. The palette is royal blue, hunter green and brown against a neutral wall with red, blue and green balloons. The full-body figure stands centred inside the spotlight circle.
tips: Change the 28 candles to the correct age and pick a cake flavour you like.
Swap the royal blue blazer for maroon or black for a different contrast.
Use a 4:5 crop to keep the spotlight circle and full body in frame.

title: Floor Seated Birthday Shoot With Silver Star Balloons
description: This prompt creates a birthday studio photoshoot of a young man sitting casually on the floor in front of silver HAPPY BIRTHDAY letter balloons and star balloons. His face and hairstyle match the reference, and the prompt even lets you specify height for natural proportions. He wears a cream or beige suit with a plain white tee and white sneakers, a relaxed yet smart look. Large metallic silver number balloons, set to 24 in the prompt, sit in front of him, and the floor is decorated with shiny confetti and extra balloons. Cinematic bright high-fashion lighting with sharp contrast gives the image a fun, polished party vibe. The relaxed floor pose makes it feel more personal and candid than a standing portrait. This prompt suits milestone and regular birthdays alike, for Instagram posts, WhatsApp status, reel covers and printed photos. The light outfit and silver decorations keep the overall look clean and bright, which suits daytime parties and simple home setups.
styleNotes: Bright, high-key fashion lighting with crisp contrast and metallic reflections on balloons. The palette is cream, white and silver. The subject sits low in the centre of the frame, framed by number balloons in front and letter and star balloons behind, with confetti scattered across the floor.
tips: Change the 24 balloons to the correct age before generating.
Swap silver balloons for rose gold or gold for a warmer palette.
Use a slightly high camera angle to show more confetti on the floor.

title: Golden Brushstroke Birthday Poster in Formal Suit
description: This prompt creates a classy birthday poster for a young man, combining two images of him in one design. A large faded portrait in a formal suit sits in the background, while in front he appears full-length, walking confidently in a suit. The background uses a golden gradient with a paintbrush texture and soft red and white edges, giving a premium, modern feel. Bold text reads Happy BIRTHDAY with a small cake icon, alongside a signature-style name and a date. The prompt asks for the face and cap from the uploaded photo to be kept exactly. This layout is typical of birthday banners shared by friends and fan groups, and it works for WhatsApp status, Instagram posts, printed flex banners or a framed gift. Because the name and date are placeholders, it is easy to reuse for any friend or family member. The gold palette keeps the poster formal and celebratory, suitable for both young adults and older relatives.
styleNotes: Soft, even lighting on the walking figure with a faded, low-contrast background portrait. The palette is gold gradient with red and white brushstroke edges and dark suit tones. The faded portrait fills the upper background, the walking figure stands in front, and the text block sits to one side.
tips: Replace Your Name and 15 November with the real name and birthday.
Change the gold gradient to silver or royal blue for a different mood.
Remove the cap from the prompt if the reference photo shows no cap.

title: Black Velvet Suit Birthday Portrait in Studio Light
description: This prompt creates a full-body 9:16 vertical birthday portrait of a well-groomed man in his thirties, using the attached photo for the exact face. He has thick black hair styled in a modern textured quiff with faded sides and a light stubble beard. His fair skin is lit by natural, flattering studio light. He wears a tailored slim-fit black velvet suit jacket with a crisp white shirt left slightly open at the collar for a relaxed birthday feel, paired with slim black trousers and polished shoes. The prompt includes specific age and height details, which help the image keep realistic proportions. The overall look is refined and mature, more suited to a milestone birthday than a casual party. This prompt works well for men celebrating their thirties who want a polished portrait for Instagram, WhatsApp status, a LinkedIn-appropriate celebration post or a framed print. Adding birthday decorations or text can turn it into a full poster.
styleNotes: Natural, flattering studio light with soft shadows and a subtle sheen on the velvet. The palette is black velvet, crisp white and neutral background tones. A full-length vertical composition centres the subject, leaving space above and below for optional birthday text.
tips: Update the age and height values to match the person in the photo.
Swap black velvet for emerald or wine velvet for a richer colour.
Add a balloon backdrop or cake prop if you want a clearer birthday theme.

title: Red Monochrome Studio Portrait With Number Candles
description: This prompt creates a cinematic studio birthday portrait in side profile, with the man facing left, eyes closed and a calm, serene expression. The face comes from the attached photo. His dark hair is styled in a modern, textured, slightly wavy cut with volume on top and faded sides. In his right hand he holds two lit candles shaped as numbers, set to 34 in the prompt, positioned in front of his face so the flames glow near his profile. He wears an elegant black suit jacket and a crisp white shirt slightly open at the collar. The entire scene is bathed in a moody, monochrome red palette, with a single sharp spotlight creating dramatic contrast. The result feels artistic and introspective rather than party-like, making it a distinctive option for a milestone birthday. It suits Instagram posts, profile pictures on the day, or a framed art print. Men who want a mature, minimal birthday image will find this style a good fit.
styleNotes: A single sharp spotlight with deep red ambient tones creates strong contrast and glowing candle highlights. The palette is monochrome red, black and white. The side profile faces left, with the number candles held in the foreground near the face and dark negative space around.
tips: Change the number candles to the correct age before generating.
Try deep blue or emerald instead of red for a different monochrome mood.
Use a square crop to make the profile and candles the clear focus.

title: Lantern Lit Night Meadow Among White Wildflowers
description: This prompt creates a cinematic night portrait of a man sitting in a meadow full of white wildflowers, using the attached image for his face. He wears a loose white shirt with a few buttons undone and holds a warmly lit lantern, which is the only light source in the scene. The lantern illuminates his face and the nearby flowers, while the rest of the frame falls into darkness, creating a dramatic and mysterious mood. His expression is calm and curious. The prompt calls for a wider framing with the camera placed further away, so the figure appears within the landscape rather than as a close-up. The atmosphere is dreamy and poetic, similar to a scene from a romantic or fantasy film. This style suits people who enjoy moody, artistic photos, and it works for Instagram posts, music or poetry covers, profile pictures with a story feel, or a phone wallpaper. The white shirt and white flowers catch the lantern light beautifully against the dark night.
styleNotes: A single warm lantern acts as the only light, creating a pool of amber glow surrounded by deep darkness. The palette is warm gold, white and near black. The figure sits in the middle distance, surrounded by flowers, with darkness occupying much of the frame for a cinematic feel.
tips: Add faint fireflies or stars in the sky for extra magic.
Swap the white shirt for a cream kurta for an Indian countryside look.
Use a 16:9 frame to show more of the meadow and darkness.

title: Three Panel Dusk Beach Story in White Shirt
description: This prompt creates a three-panel split image of a young man with dark, messy hair in a white button-down shirt on a beach at dusk. The top panel shows him from behind, looking out over the dark ocean. The middle panel is a side profile with him holding a small bouquet of white flowers and looking down. The bottom panel is a detailed close-up of his face with an intense gaze and wind-blown hair. Cinematic deep blue and teal tones run through all three frames, with dramatic lighting that adds emotion. The face and expression from the reference are kept unchanged. The sequence suggests a quiet romantic story, such as waiting for someone or remembering a moment, which makes it popular for reflective posts. It suits Instagram stories, reel covers, emotional caption posts or a phone wallpaper. The blue-teal grade keeps the panels consistent and gives the series a polished, film-like look.
styleNotes: Low dusk light with dramatic highlights and a cool blue-teal grade throughout. The palette is deep blue, teal and white. Three stacked panels move from a back view to profile to close-up, giving a narrative progression and drawing the viewer closer with each frame.
tips: Swap the white flowers for a letter or a single red rose for a different story.
Try warm sunset tones instead of blue-teal for a more hopeful mood.
Keep panels equal in height for clean 9:16 story crops.

title: Orange Halo Profile Portrait With Aviator Sunglasses
description: This prompt creates a cinematic profile portrait of a young man in a plain black jacket and aviator sunglasses, with his face matched to the reference picture. He has thick, voluminous, well-styled black hair and a neatly trimmed beard, and his head tilts slightly upward with a calm, confident expression. The lighting setup places a dramatic orange spotlight behind his head, creating a circular halo-like glow that outlines his profile against a pure black background. The simplicity of the black jacket and background makes the orange light the main design element, giving the image a bold, graphic quality. This style resembles a film poster or album cover and suits people who want a striking profile picture, a personal brand image, a YouTube channel icon or a poster-style post. It works particularly well for men with defined beards and full hairstyles, since the backlight highlights hair volume and facial outline. The minimal design also leaves room for text if needed.
styleNotes: A strong orange backlight forms a circular halo behind the head, with minimal front fill to keep the profile sculpted. The palette is vivid orange, black and warm skin tones. The side profile is centred on the halo, tilted upward, with pure black negative space around it.
tips: Change the orange halo to red, blue or white for a different mood.
Remove the sunglasses for a cleaner profile that shows the eyes.
Use a 1:1 crop for profile pictures and channel icons.

title: White Dhoti Portrait With a Lion at His Back
description: This prompt creates a bold portrait of a young man with intense eyes, seated in a wooden chair with his right leg crossed over the left and one hand raised near his forehead in a thoughtful pose. He wears a white shirt, a white dhoti with a border and black leather sandals, a traditional South Indian look.
