He sits at a wooden table against a dark background, and behind him stands a lion with a confident gaze, symbolising strength and attitude. The face comes from the reference image. The combination of simple traditional clothing and a powerful animal creates a striking contrast, similar to a mass-entertainer film poster. This prompt suits men who want an attitude-filled profile picture, a festival or Pongal and Sankranti post in traditional wear, a birthday status image or a reel cover. The white outfit glows against the dark backdrop, making the subject stand out, while the lion adds drama without crowding the frame.
styleNotes: Low-key lighting picks out the white clothing and the lion's mane against a dark background. The palette is white, warm wood brown, golden tan and near black. The man sits in the foreground slightly off centre, with the lion standing behind his shoulder to create a layered composition.
tips: Replace the lion with a tiger or a horse for a different symbol of strength.
Change the white shirt to black for a darker, more dramatic look.
Add a title line at the bottom to turn it into a poster.

title: Dark Green Candid Portrait With Canon Camera
description: This prompt creates a cinematic dark green portrait of a stylish young man with a slightly messy dark hairstyle, using the uploaded photo for a full face match. He wears a loose black and white gradient shirt and white cargo pants and holds a Canon camera, giving him the look of a creative photographer. He smiles while looking thoughtfully off camera or toward it, captured in a candid, high-key outdoor style. The frame is bordered by a branch of vivid flowers and blurred foliage, adding colour and depth around him. The overall green tone gives the image a calm, nature-inspired mood. This style suits photographers, creators and anyone who wants a casual but polished profile picture for Instagram, a portfolio cover or a YouTube channel banner. The camera prop tells viewers something about the person's interests, while the soft greenery keeps the image fresh. It works well with a clear front-facing reference photo.
styleNotes: Bright high-key outdoor light with a dark green colour grade and soft bokeh. The palette is deep green, black, white and touches of vivid flower colour. The subject stands in the middle ground, framed by a flowering branch in one corner and blurred leaves in the foreground.
tips: Swap the gradient shirt for a solid olive or rust shirt to match the greenery.
Replace the Canon camera with a sketchbook or guitar to reflect your own hobby.
Use a 4:5 crop to keep the floral frame visible on Instagram.

title: All White Outfit on Red Motorbike Among Blossoms
description: This prompt creates a full-body shot of a 24-year-old young man seated on a customised red MT15 motorcycle, looking straight at the camera with his hands resting on the bike. He wears an all-white outfit: an oversized white denim jacket, a white t-shirt, white denim pants and white sneakers, with normal dark hair and a sharp jawline. The scene is set on an outdoor road surrounded by greenery and lots of red and pink blossoms, which add colour around the bright outfit and the red bike. The prompt specifies height for realistic proportions and asks to keep the face from the reference photo unchanged. The result looks like a lifestyle photoshoot for bike enthusiasts. It suits motorcycle lovers who want a profile picture, a WhatsApp status, a reel cover or a birthday post with their favourite bike. The red bike against the white clothes and green background creates strong, cheerful contrast that stands out in a social feed.
styleNotes: Bright natural daylight keeps the white outfit clean and the red paint glossy. The palette is crisp white, bright red, green and pink blossoms. The bike and rider fill the frame in full length, angled slightly, with the flowering roadside softly blurred behind.
tips: Change the bike colour to matte black or blue to suit your own bike.
Swap the all-white outfit for denim blue or black for a different look.
Use 16:9 framing to show the full bike and more of the road.

title: Couple Mirror Selfie in Striped Shirt
description: This prompt creates a casual mirror selfie of a young man with dark, styled hair smiling while holding a black smartphone. He wears a striped shirt and has his arm around a young woman with long dark hair, whose back is turned to the camera so only her hair and shoulder are visible. The background is dark with a few blurred lights, suggesting an evening out or a night at home. The image looks like a natural snapshot rather than a staged shoot, which makes it popular for relationship posts. Because the woman's face is hidden, the prompt works well for people who want to share a couple moment while keeping their partner's identity private. It suits Instagram stories, anniversary posts, Valentine's Day content or a soft-launch relationship post. Only the man's face needs a reference photo, making it simple to generate. The dark, blurred background keeps the attention on the smile and the closeness between the two.
styleNotes: Low ambient indoor light with soft glow on faces and blurred light points behind. The palette is dark neutrals with the striped shirt and the black phone as accents. The mirror selfie framing places the man centre, holding the phone at chest height, with the woman's back occupying one side.
tips: Change the striped shirt to a solid colour or a jacket for a different style.
Add warm fairy lights in the background for a cosier, festive feel.
Use a 9:16 crop for stories so the full mirror frame fits.

title: Blue Ballpoint Pen Swirl Line Portrait Drawing
description: This prompt converts a photo into a detailed portrait drawn in blue ballpoint pen. Intricate, swirling, thread-like lines form the hair and flow across parts of the face, partially covering it while still blending into realistic facial features. The lines are dense and flowing, appearing chaotic at first glance but carefully controlled. Only shades of deep indigo blue are used on a clean white background, with subtle gradients adding depth and volume. The result looks like a piece of hand-drawn art rather than a photo filter, making it suitable for art lovers and creatives. It works well as a unique profile picture, a printed gift for a friend, a poster for a room, or a cover image for a portfolio or blog. Because it is monochrome and minimal, it fits almost any feed style. The prompt is designed to follow the style of a reference image, so supplying a clear, well-lit portrait photo helps the lines map neatly onto the face.
styleNotes: Even, flat lighting suits the drawn style, with depth created through line density rather than shadows. The palette is deep indigo and blue on clean white. The face sits centred, with swirling hair lines spreading outward and partly crossing the features, leaving white space around the edges.
tips: Change the ink colour to black or red for a different pen-drawing effect.
Reduce how much the lines cover the face if you want features more visible.
Use a square 1:1 crop for profile pictures or print framing.

title: Black Gold Throne With a Crowned White Tiger
description: This prompt creates a futuristic editorial portrait of a male model, keeping the face exactly from the uploaded image. He wears an oversized black sweatshirt and sweatpants with white sneakers and black round-lens sunglasses, and sits elegantly on a black and gold throne. In front of him lies a giant white tiger wearing a crown on its head, adding a playful sense of royalty. The backdrop is a soft white pastel studio set, and cinematic lighting gives the scene a fashion magazine feel. His posture is relaxed, with his head slightly tilted. The mix of streetwear and a regal throne creates an interesting contrast, while the white tiger brings drama and luxury. This prompt suits men who want a bold, artistic profile picture, a birthday post with a royal theme, an Instagram fashion post or a reel cover. The light backdrop keeps the black outfit and gold throne crisp, so the image reads clearly even at small sizes.
styleNotes: Soft, cinematic studio light with gentle shadows and clean highlights on the gold throne. The palette is black, gold and white pastel. The throne sits centred with the model seated upright, and the tiger stretches horizontally across the foreground to anchor the lower frame.
tips: Swap the white tiger for a black panther for a darker, moodier version.
Change the streetwear to a black sherwani for a royal ethnic look.
Use a 4:5 crop so both the crown on the tiger and the face stay visible.

title: Playful Ink Sketch Cartoon Caricature on White
description: This prompt turns a photo into a funny sketch cartoon, drawn digitally with expressive ink-style outlines and exaggerated yet recognisable facial features. Vivid digital colours are applied with subtle shading and light hatching, and the background is clean white with a few gestural marks suggesting movement. The style feels lively, energetic and hand-drawn, similar to comic pen-and-ink art, with a playful caricature tone. The prompt asks for the face to stay accurate to the reference image so the person remains easy to recognise despite the exaggeration. A painted signature is integrated in the bottom-left corner. This style is a good fit for fun profile pictures, birthday caricatures, office farewell cards, stickers, mug or t-shirt prints, and social media posts where you want humour rather than realism. It works with most clear face photos, including group-friendly headshots, and the white background makes it easy to cut out and reuse the cartoon elsewhere.
styleNotes: Flat, even lighting suits the illustration, with depth from ink shading and hatching. The palette is vivid digital colour against clean white. The head and shoulders are centred and slightly enlarged, with gestural motion lines around them and a signature placed in the bottom-left corner.
tips: Change the white background to a solid pastel colour for a sticker-style look.
Ask for a hobby prop, such as a cricket bat or guitar, to personalise the caricature.
Remove the signature line if you plan to print it as a gift.

title: Red and Gold Action Thriller Movie Poster Design
description: This prompt creates a regional action-thriller film poster featuring a stylish man with a rugged beard, dark hair and gold-rimmed red sunglasses, using the reference image for the face. His large side-profile face dominates the upper half, lit with dramatic red and gold tones. In the lower half, the same man sits confidently in a luxurious red convertible car, dressed in black with red sunglasses. The background is a deep red gradient fading into black, with soft golden light reflections, giving a dark, fiery and bold mood. Glowing golden text announces a worldwide release date, and a metallic title appears in the centre with decorative detail. As written, the prompt copies the title and star billing of a real upcoming film, so it is best adapted with your own title and name before use. With those changes it suits birthday posters, short film promotions, reel covers or a playful edit for film fans who enjoy dramatic poster designs.
styleNotes: Dramatic red and gold key lighting on the profile and soft golden reflections around the car. The palette is deep red, black and metallic gold. The large profile fills the upper half, the car scene sits in the lower half, and the title and release text frame the top and centre.
tips: Replace the film title and star billing with your own name or project title.
Change the red convertible to a black SUV or bike for a different hero entry.
Use a 2:3 poster ratio if you plan to print the design.

title: Low Angle Portrait Before a Stone Shiva Statue
description: This prompt creates a low-angle portrait of a young man with a serene expression, wearing a flowing white traditional Indian outfit, looking upward and slightly to the side. Behind him, filling much of the frame, is a massive dark grey stone statue of Lord Shiva's head gazing toward the sky, with a crescent moon resting in his hair and an orange sacred thread across the chest. The sky is a clear, vibrant blue, giving the image a bright and peaceful feel. The low camera angle makes the statue appear towering and powerful, while the person in white looks small and devotional beside it. The image is respectful and spiritual, suitable for Maha Shivaratri, Shravan month, Karthika Masam, Monday devotional posts or a calm profile picture. The prompt includes a placeholder for describing your photo, so you can adjust clothing and expression. The combination of white clothing, grey stone and blue sky creates a clean, balanced palette that works well on any device.
styleNotes: Bright, natural daylight highlights the stone texture and the folds of the white fabric. The palette is clear sky blue, dark grey stone, white and a touch of saffron orange. A low camera angle places the person in the lower foreground with the statue rising behind to dominate the frame.
tips: Replace the white outfit with a saffron kurta or rudraksha mala for a devotional touch.
Ask for a sunrise sky instead of blue daylight for warmer tones.
Use a vertical 9:16 frame to emphasise the statue's height.

title: Sky Blue Shirt Portrait in Tall Green Grass
description: This prompt creates a dreamy low-angle close-up portrait of a young man standing in a field of tall green grass, with his face and hairstyle kept unchanged from the reference. He wears a sky blue shirt with the top button undone, and the grass rises high enough to cover his chest, framing him naturally. The background is heavily blurred in soft greens, giving a calm, cinematic tone. He looks confidently to the side with his arms crossed, and the image keeps realistic DSLR-style textures in the skin, fabric and grass blades. The overall aesthetic is peaceful and fresh, ideal for a nature-inspired profile picture. This prompt suits Instagram posts, monsoon-season content, casual LinkedIn-style photos or dating profiles where a relaxed outdoor look is preferred. The sky blue shirt contrasts gently with the greenery without clashing, and the grass in the foreground adds depth. It works best with a clear front or three-quarter reference photo.
styleNotes: Soft natural daylight with gentle highlights on the face and shirt. The palette is sky blue and layered greens. A low-angle close-up places the face in the upper frame, with tall grass covering the lower chest and heavy blur behind for depth.
tips: Swap the sky blue shirt for white or mustard for a different contrast with the grass.
Ask for golden hour backlight to make the grass tips glow.
Use a 4:5 crop to keep the grass framing and face balanced.

title: Silver White 3D Name Logo Portrait in White Cap
description: This prompt creates a digital illustration of a smiling young man, around 24 years old, dressed entirely in white with a white cap and shirt, set against a light background. His image blends into a large 3D script font spelling a name, rendered in soft silver-white with a thin golden outline. The prompt uses a Your Name placeholder, so you can insert any name before generating. The overall theme is clean, bright and elegant, designed to look like a premium personal logo or profile badge. Because the person and the lettering merge into one design, the result works well as a channel icon, a profile picture, a business card graphic or a personal brand mark for creators, freelancers and small business owners. It also makes a thoughtful birthday gift graphic for a friend. The all-white palette keeps the design versatile, so it sits nicely on light or dark app backgrounds. A clear, front-facing photo with a smile gives the best result for this style.
styleNotes: Soft, even illustration lighting with gentle highlights on the 3D lettering and a subtle golden edge. The palette is white, silver and thin gold accents on a light background. The portrait sits above or beside the large script name, with both elements overlapping to form a single logo-like composition.
tips: Replace Your Name with your own name, brand or channel handle before generating.
Swap the white theme for black and gold if you want a darker logo.
Use a 1:1 square ratio for profile icons and channel avatars.

title: Fan Birthday Moment With a Cricket Star
description: This prompt creates a realistic birthday scene in which a young man from the uploaded photo poses beside a famous Indian cricketer, who rests a hand on his shoulder while holding a cake knife. Both stand in a relaxed pose, and the young man smiles confidently. The prompt also references a franchise cricket jersey and an airline sponsor logo. styleNotes: Bright, soft high-key studio lighting with minimal shadows and a glowing finish. The palette is pure white, soft cream and small gold accents. A medium close-up centres the child among cloud-like fluff, with wings spreading behind her shoulders and a seamless white backdrop.
tips: Change the wings to pastel pink or blue for a light colour accent.
Add a small number balloon for monthly or first birthday milestones.
Use a 1:1 square crop for photo albums and profile pictures.

title: Rembrandt Lit King Portrait With Gold Filigree Crown
description: This prompt creates a cinematic portrait of a young man as a majestic king, with his face, black hair and beard taken from the uploaded photo. He has a pensive, thoughtful expression that suggests wisdom and experience. He wears a massive, intricate gold filigree crown and dark regal robes with gold embroidery. Dramatic side lighting in a Rembrandt style creates deep shadows and warm golden tones, while an opulent palace interior sits softly out of focus in the background. The prompt focuses on sharp detail in the eyes and hyper-realistic texture in the crown and fabric, giving the image the feel of a historical film still or a classical painting. A name line can be added in a professional font. This prompt suits men who want a regal profile picture, a birthday poster with a royal theme, fantasy-inspired content or a character portrait for gaming and storytelling. It works best with a reference photo that shows the face clearly from the front or three-quarter angle.
styleNotes: Rembrandt-style side lighting creates a triangle of light on the shadowed cheek, with deep shadows and warm highlights. The palette is rich gold, deep brown, black and burgundy. A close portrait frames the head and shoulders, crown at the top of the frame, palace bokeh behind.
tips: Replace the name line with your own name or remove it entirely.
Change the robes to deep red or royal blue for a different royal palette.
Use a 4:5 crop to keep the full crown and shoulders in frame.

title: Big Head 3D Caricature on Bold Colour Background
description: This prompt creates a highly stylised 3D caricature with an oversized head, expressive facial features and playful exaggeration. The character is rendered in a smooth, polished style with clean materials and soft ambient lighting, similar to animated film characters or collectible figurines. A bold, solid colour background emphasises the character's charm and makes it pop on screen. The prompt includes a placeholder for the character, so you can describe yourself, a friend or a family member, or use an uploaded photo as the reference. This style suits fun profile pictures, birthday greetings, office farewell cards, stickers, gaming avatars, YouTube channel icons and printed gifts like mugs or keychains. Because it focuses on personality rather than realism, it is a light-hearted option that works for all ages. Choosing a background colour that contrasts with the person's clothing helps the figure stand out, and adding a favourite prop or outfit makes the caricature more personal.
styleNotes: Soft ambient lighting with smooth highlights and gentle shadows on the 3D surfaces. The palette is driven by one bold solid background colour paired with the character's clothing. The oversized head sits centred, body smaller below, leaving clean space around the figure for a sticker-like look.
tips: Replace the character placeholder with a short description of the person and their outfit.
Add a hobby prop, such as a guitar or cricket bat, to personalise it.
Pick a background colour that contrasts with the clothing for better pop.

title: Striped Tee Portrait at an Ornate Domed Temple
description: This prompt creates a realistic portrait of a young woman, using the reference image for her face, posing confidently in front of a grand, ornate temple entrance with domed architecture. She has messy, voluminous, stylish hair and wears a white and black striped full-sleeve loose t-shirt with light blue baggy jeans, one hand in her pocket and a natural smile. Warm sunlight falls on her, and the background has a creamy DSLR bokeh effect with intricate pillars, golden decor and vibrant colours softly blurred. The mix of casual modern clothing and traditional architecture gives the image a travel-diary feel. This prompt suits young women who want a casual travel photo, a profile picture, a college trip memory or an Instagram post from a heritage visit. The striped top adds visual interest without competing with the detailed backdrop. If you plan to use it at a place of worship, consider changing the outfit to a kurta or saree for a more traditional look.
styleNotes: Warm sunlight with soft highlights on hair and a creamy, blurred background. The palette is black and white stripes, denim blue, gold and warm stone tones. The subject stands in the foreground at three-quarter length, with the temple entrance and pillars blurred behind for depth.
tips: Swap the striped tee for a kurta or saree for a traditional temple visit look.
Ask for evening lamp light for a warmer, festive atmosphere.
Use a 4:5 crop to balance the subject and the domed entrance.

title: Stadium Selfie With a Star Cricketer
description: This prompt creates a cinematic selfie of a young man, keeping his exact face and hairstyle, standing beside a famous Indian cricketer inside a packed stadium during a live match. Both smile naturally at the camera with faces close together, as if posing for a real fan selfie. The background shows bright stadium floodlights, a cheering crowd waving Indian flags and a slightly blurred audience for depth. Because the image places the user next to a real, identifiable sports star in a believable setting, it can easily be mistaken for a genuine photo and uses that person's likeness without consent. It is best kept as a private fan keepsake. For a version that is fine to share, swap the cricketer for a fictional teammate or a friend, or show the user alone taking a selfie in the stands with the floodlights and flags behind. That still captures the energy of a live match day and suits sports fan posts and match-day status updates.
styleNotes: Bright stadium floodlights from above with natural fill on the faces and a softly blurred crowd. The palette is cricket blue, tricolour flag accents and warm floodlight whites. Two faces sit close together in selfie framing in the foreground, with the crowd filling the background.
tips: Replace the real cricketer with a friend or fictional player for a shareable selfie.
Show the user alone in the stands with flags for a solo match-day post.
Use a 9:16 frame for stories to include more of the crowd.

title: Maroon Gradient Shirt Portrait Framed by Bougainvillea
description: This prompt creates a cinematic dark green portrait of a stylish young man with a slightly messy dark hairstyle and a confident smile, using the uploaded photo for a full face match. He wears a loose black and maroon gradient shirt with white loose trousers and holds a Canon camera, giving him the look of a creative photographer. He looks thoughtfully off camera in a candid, high-key outdoor style. The composition is framed by a branch of red, pink, yellow and dark bougainvillea flowers in the upper left corner, with heavily blurred green leaves in the extreme foreground. A shallow depth of field produces soft bokeh, adding a dreamy quality. The overall green tone keeps the image calm, while the flowers bring bright spots of colour. This prompt suits photographers, creators and young men who want a polished but natural profile picture, Instagram post or portfolio cover. It pairs well with the similar black and white gradient shirt version for a matching set.
styleNotes: Bright high-key outdoor light with a dark green grade and soft bokeh. The palette is deep green, maroon, black, white and multicoloured bougainvillea. The subject stands slightly off centre, bougainvillea in the upper left corner, and blurred leaves in the near foreground frame the shot.
tips: Change the maroon gradient to navy or olive for a different shirt colour.
Replace the camera with a book or coffee cup for an everyday version.
Keep the bougainvillea framing and use a 4:5 crop for Instagram.

title: Worm's Eye View Portrait Under a Sunlit Canopy
description: This prompt creates a cinematic low-angle portrait of a young man looking up, his face softly lit by a bright, overexposed sun directly above his head. The face is taken accurately from the uploaded image. The background is an intense turquoise-blue sky framed by the dark green and lime-green leaves of an overhead tree canopy. The worm's-eye perspective makes the man appear in the foreground while the sun and sky become the central element above him. Strong lens flare and light rays stream through the leaves, creating a high-contrast, ethereal and vibrant atmosphere. The prompt calls for an 85mm lens look at f/1.4 with cinematic lighting, keeping the face clear and sharp. This style suits people who want an uplifting, artistic profile picture, a summer or nature-themed post, a motivational quote background or a cover for music and poetry. The unusual camera angle makes it stand out from typical eye-level portraits.
styleNotes: A bright overhead sun creates strong flare, light rays and glowing highlights on the upturned face. The palette is turquoise blue, lime and deep green, with warm sunlit skin tones. A worm's-eye view places the face in the lower foreground, with canopy and sun filling the upper frame.
tips: Change the tree canopy to coconut palms for a coastal or tropical feel.
Reduce the lens flare if you want the face details sharper and clearer.
Use a square 1:1 crop to centre the sun directly above the head.

title: Photographer Portrait in Maroon Gradient Shirt With Camera
description: This prompt turns your uploaded photo into a candid outdoor portrait of a young man holding a Canon camera, as if he has just paused between shots. He has slightly dark, messy hair and wears a loose black-to-maroon gradient half-sleeve shirt with white relaxed trousers. Instead of looking at the lens, he gazes thoughtfully off to the side with a gentle smile, which gives the picture an unposed, documentary feel. The frame is edged with a branch of bright red, pink, yellow and dark leaves or blossoms, creating a natural border in the foreground. The overall grade leans toward deep green, while the lighting stays bright and high-key so the face remains clear and evenly lit. The camera prop makes this a natural fit for photographers, content creators and travel bloggers who want a profile picture that shows what they do. It also works for a portfolio cover, an Instagram highlight image or a World Photography Day post. Because the prompt asks for a close face match, a well-lit, front-facing reference photo will give the most faithful result. A small Prompt King signature sits in the lower left corner and can be removed if you prefer a clean image.
styleNotes: Bright, high-key daylight keeps skin tones clean against an overall deep green colour grade. The maroon and black gradient shirt adds warmth, while the red, pink and yellow foreground branch creates a colourful natural frame. Composition places the subject slightly off-centre with an off-camera gaze, giving a candid, story-like feel with soft background separation.
tips: Replace the Canon camera with a mirrorless camera or film camera to match the gear you actually use.
Swap the gradient shirt for a denim or linen shirt if you want a more casual travel look.
Change the foreground branch to cherry blossoms or autumn leaves to suit the season of your post.

title: Kneeling Birthday Portrait With Cake and Golden Balloons
description: This birthday prompt creates a close-up of a young man kneeling in a decorated celebration space while holding a small cake with lit candles. Golden balloons surround him, and behind him a glowing neon sign spells out a birthday greeting with a name. Arrangements of red and white flowers fill the background, and a light haze of smoke softens the scene so the neon and candle glow stand out. The kneeling pose and the cake held close to the chest give the image a warm, personal feeling, as if the subject is about to make a wish. Framing is tight enough to keep the face prominent while still showing the balloons and sign. The prompt suits personal birthday posts, WhatsApp status updates, party invitations and thank-you messages after a celebration. Friends can also use it to make a surprise greeting for someone else, as long as they have permission to use that person's photo. The original prompt includes a specific first name on the neon sign; replace it with your own name or the birthday person's name before generating. A small Prompt King signature appears in the lower left corner and can be edited out.
styleNotes: Warm candlelight and the pink-white glow of the neon sign set a festive, intimate mood. Gold balloons and red-white florals form a rich celebratory palette, softened by a faint smoke effect. The tight close-up composition centres the kneeling subject and cake, with background decorations softly blurred to keep focus on the face.
tips: Change the neon text to your own name and age, for example 'Happy 25th Birthday Arjun'.
Swap golden balloons for silver, rose-gold or pastel balloons to match your party theme.
Use a 9:16 aspect ratio if you plan to share the image as a story or status.

title: Kerala Kasavu Style Studio Portrait for Young Girls
description: This children's prompt creates a studio portrait of a young girl dressed in a Kerala Kasavu-inspired outfit. She wears a deep emerald green sleeveless top with gold zari embroidery around the neckline and a flowing cream skirt in soft cotton silk with a subtle woven pattern, the classic Kasavu colour pairing. Her hair is gathered into a neat high bun, and a delicate gold choker and bracelet complete the traditional look. Strong backlighting forms a bright halo around her head and shoulders, while the front of her face stays softly lit as she smiles gently at the camera. The medium close-up framing captures both her expression and the details of the embroidery. This prompt is a good choice for Onam greetings, Vishu wishes, school cultural day photos, Kerala Piravi posts and family albums. Parents can also use it as a keepsake portrait or a birthday image with a traditional theme. Use a clear, well-lit photo of the child facing the camera for the closest likeness, and always ensure you have the right to edit the photo. The prompt adds a dynamic pose instruction, which you can simplify if you prefer a calm, seated portrait.
styleNotes: Luminous backlighting creates a halo effect, with soft frontal fill keeping the face bright. The palette pairs emerald green and gold zari with creamy white, reflecting traditional Kerala attire. A dark or neutral studio background makes the colours stand out, and medium close-up framing balances facial expression with garment detail.
tips: Add a small jasmine string around the bun for a more festive Onam look.
Swap the emerald top for maroon or mustard while keeping the cream Kasavu skirt.
Ask for a pookalam floral carpet in the foreground to make it an Onam greeting image.

title: Rajyotsava Rally Crowd Portrait With Waving Leader Pose
description: This prompt places a young man at the centre of a large crowd during a Kannada Rajyotsava rally in Karnataka. He smiles and waves with one hand while holding a flag in the other, dressed in a crisp white shirt with a bright yellow and red scarf draped around his neck. People around him raise smartphones to photograph him, which gives the scene the energy of a public event where he is the focus of attention. Warm natural daylight lights the scene, and a shallow depth of field keeps him sharp while the crowd and background softly blur. The prompt references a temple setting, adding a sense of place and local identity. It suits Karnataka Rajyotsava greetings on November 1, community event posters, local association posts and festival profile pictures. You can use a generic flag or the plain yellow and red Karnataka flag rather than any specific organisation's symbol. Because the crowd scene is busy, a clear front-facing reference photo helps the subject stand out. The image works well in a vertical format for social media stories and in a horizontal format for banners.
styleNotes: Warm, natural daylight with soft shadows gives an authentic event feel. Yellow and red from the scarf and flag stand out against the white shirt and the varied colours of the crowd. Shallow depth of field isolates the subject in the foreground, while raised phones in the background add depth and lively motion.
tips: Use the plain yellow-over-red Karnataka flag instead of a party flag for a neutral festival image.
Add a 'Happy Kannada Rajyotsava' banner in the background for a ready-made greeting.
Switch to a 16:9 frame to fit a Facebook cover or event banner.

title: White Lungi Outfit Waving Flag Before Historic Temple
description: This is a short, simple prompt for a festival-themed portrait of a young man in traditional South Indian attire. He wears a white shirt and white lungi, stands outdoors facing the camera, and waves a yellow and red flag in front of a historic temple. The white outfit keeps attention on the face and the bright flag, while the temple architecture gives the picture a strong cultural setting. Because the original wording is brief, the result depends on your image tool's defaults, so it is worth adding details such as time of day, expression and camera angle. The prompt is well suited to Kannada Rajyotsava wishes, Karnataka-themed posts, village festival photos and cultural pride profile pictures. It can also serve as a base for a family or friend group photo if you describe additional people beside the main subject. For the best likeness, upload a clear photo with even lighting and your face fully visible. A realistic style is requested, so the image should resemble a natural outdoor photograph rather than an illustration. This version is a good starting point if you want to customise heavily, since it leaves room for your own additions.
styleNotes: Outdoor daylight and a white outfit create a clean, bright base. The yellow and red flag is the main colour accent, set against warm stone tones of the temple. A straightforward front-facing composition with the subject centred and the temple behind gives a classic, easy-to-read festival portrait.
tips: Add 'golden hour sunlight' and 'gentle smile' to give the image warmer, friendlier lighting.
Mention a gold-bordered lungi and a shoulder towel for a more detailed traditional outfit.
Specify a low camera angle so the temple tower rises dramatically behind you.

title: Gold Border Lungi Portrait With Temple and Palm Trees
description: This detailed festival prompt shows a young man in a traditional South Indian white shirt and a white lungi with a golden border, standing outdoors in front of a historic temple. He looks straight at the camera with a pleasant smile while waving a yellow and red flag. Palm trees frame the temple architecture behind him, and a clear blue sky adds a fresh, open feel. The lighting is natural sunlight with warm tones, making skin, fabric and stone look vibrant and realistic. Compared with shorter flag prompts, this version specifies the setting, expression and colour mood, so results tend to be more consistent. It is a strong choice for Kannada Rajyotsava greetings, Karnataka cultural posts, Ugadi wishes and traditional-day photos at college or work. The gold-bordered lungi also makes it suitable for wedding-season or temple-visit themed profile pictures if you remove the flag. Use a reference photo where your face is clearly visible and evenly lit. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner; delete that line if you want a clean picture for printing or framing.
styleNotes: Natural sunlight with warm tones gives the scene a vibrant, crisp look. White and gold clothing contrasts with the yellow-red flag, green palms and blue sky. A centred, front-facing composition places the temple directly behind the subject, with palm trees adding vertical framing on both sides.
tips: Remove the flag and add folded hands for a temple-visit portrait.
Change the clear sky to a sunset sky for warmer orange and pink tones.
Add a silk shoulder angavastram in matching gold border for a festive wedding-guest look.

title: Rajyotsava Street Celebration Holding a Framed Tribute Photo
description: This prompt depicts a man standing proudly in the middle of a festive Karnataka Rajyotsava street celebration, holding a framed photograph high above his head with both hands. The original version is built around a tribute to a well-known Kannada film actor, using a second reference image for the face inside the frame, with realistic glass reflections on the photo. Around him, people carry plain yellow and red Karnataka flags, and more flags line the street in the background, giving a sense of crowds and community pride. Bright daylight lights the scene, and the subject's face is meant to match the uploaded reference closely. The image is suited to Rajyotsava tributes, fan club remembrance posts and community celebration albums. Because it depends on the likeness of a real public figure, it is best used for personal, non-commercial tribute purposes, and you may prefer to replace the framed photo with a family elder, a teacher or a map of Karnataka. The multi-reference structure means you need clear images for each person in the scene. Expect a busy, emotional composition centred on the raised frame.
styleNotes: Bright daylight gives the street scene crisp detail and lively colour. Yellow and red flags dominate the palette, with the framed photo creating a focal point above the subject's head. The centred composition uses the raised arms to lead the eye upward, while the crowd forms a softly blurred, festive background.
tips: Replace the framed photo with a Karnataka map or the Bhuvaneshwari image for a neutral tribute.
Use a 4:5 frame so the raised frame and face both fit comfortably.
Add marigold garlands on the frame for a more traditional tribute feel.

title: Running With a Giant Karnataka Flag in Street Rally
description: This action prompt captures a young man running at the front of a festive street rally, holding a large plain yellow-over-red Karnataka flag. The flag ripples in the wind and glows in bright afternoon sunlight, adding strong motion to the frame. Behind him, a group of young men join the run, smiling and cheering, while crowds on both sides of the street wave smaller flags and clap. The prompt uses a vertical 9:16 aspect ratio, which makes it ready for Instagram Reels covers, WhatsApp status updates and YouTube Shorts thumbnails. The face is requested to match the uploaded reference closely, so a clear, front-facing photo works best. The image suits Kannada Rajyotsava on November 1, college fest promotions, cultural pride posts and community run events. Because the scene includes motion and many people, results can vary; generating a few versions and picking the sharpest face is a practical approach. The mood is energetic and celebratory rather than formal, making it a good contrast to standing portrait prompts in the same theme. A motion-capture feel is described, so expect some blur in the flag and background figures.
styleNotes: Bright afternoon sun creates high contrast and glowing highlights on the flag fabric. The yellow and red flag dominates the upper frame, balanced by colourful crowds on either side. The vertical 9:16 composition uses a leading line down the street, with the runner in sharp focus and slight motion blur behind.
tips: Change the time to golden hour for warmer light and longer shadows on the street.
Add a festive arch with 'Kannada Rajyotsava' text over the street for a greeting card version.
Ask for a lower camera angle to make the flag appear larger and more dramatic.

title: Motorbike Rajyotsava Rally With Yellow Scarf and Sunglasses
description: This prompt shows a man of around 25 riding a motorbike proudly through Karnataka streets during a Rajyotsava rally. He wears sunglasses, and a bright yellow scarf trails behind him in the wind, adding movement and colour to the scene. The prompt places strong emphasis on keeping the face identical to the uploaded reference, while adjusting the pose and head angle to look natural for a riding posture. Other riders, flags and onlookers create a festive street atmosphere around him. The cinematic framing makes it feel like a still from a film rather than a casual snapshot. It is well suited to Kannada Rajyotsava greetings, bike club rally posts, college event promotion and profile pictures for riders who enjoy festival rides. Because the face requirement is strict, choose a reference photo that shows your face at a slight angle similar to the riding pose for better results. You can keep the motorbike generic or describe your own bike's colour and style. For safety-conscious posts, adding a helmet held at the side or worn open-face is an easy change.
styleNotes: Cinematic daylight with warm highlights brings out the yellow scarf and flags. The palette mixes yellow and red festival colours with the metallic tones of the bike and grey street. A three-quarter front angle follows the rider, with motion in the scarf and a softly blurred crowd giving depth and speed.
tips: Describe your own bike's colour and style so the image looks like your real ride.
Add an open-face helmet for a safer, more realistic riding look.
Include a small group of riders behind you to show a club or friends' rally.

title: Pink Shirt Portrait Against Bougainvillea Flower Wall
description: This romantic floral prompt creates a portrait of a man with dark, messy hair wearing a pink button-up shirt and a soft smile. He stands in front of a wall completely covered in bright pink bougainvillea flowers, so the shirt and background blend into a coordinated pink palette. The mood is serene and gentle, and the framing focuses on the face and upper body, making it easy to use as a profile photo. The prompt asks for a close face match with the uploaded image, so a clear, evenly lit reference works best. This style suits dating app profiles, Valentine's Day posts, birthday photos, and summer social media updates. It is also a pleasant option for anyone who wants a soft, approachable portrait rather than a dramatic or edgy look. Since bougainvillea is common in South Indian gardens and streets, the setting feels familiar and natural. You can easily adjust the shirt colour to contrast with the flowers if you prefer more separation between subject and background. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner and can be removed by deleting that line.
styleNotes: Soft, even daylight keeps the look gentle and flattering. The palette is dominated by layered pinks, from the shirt to the bougainvillea, with dark hair and green leaves adding contrast. A centred chest-up composition places the subject directly in front of the flower wall, filling the frame with colour.
tips: Switch the shirt to white or light blue to make you stand out from the pink flowers.
Use a 4:5 crop for an Instagram feed post or 1:1 for profile photos.
Change bougainvillea to white jasmine or purple flowers for a different colour mood.

title: Red-Lit Power Portrait With Gold Chains and Cash
description: This bold prompt produces a cinematic portrait of a bearded South Asian man posing with confidence against a backdrop of stacked US dollar bills. He wears red-tinted sunglasses and a vibrant red shirt with gold and animal-print details, layered with gold chains, a watch and bracelets. His hand is raised and his expression is a confident smirk. The camera is set at a low angle, which makes him appear larger and more commanding, and dramatic red lighting washes over the whole scene. The overall mood signals wealth, status and swagger, similar to a music video still or a rap album cover. The prompt suits creators making entertainment posts, motivational or hustle-themed content, music covers and party invitations with a flashy theme. It is clearly stylised, so it works best for fun or creative uses rather than formal profiles. Keep the face reference clear and well lit so the beard and features carry through. If you want something less flashy, the money backdrop can be swapped for a luxury interior or a city skyline at night.
styleNotes: Saturated red lighting dominates, casting a moody glow across skin, shirt and background. Gold jewellery adds warm metallic highlights against the deep red and the green tones of the cash. A low-angle composition with the subject filling the frame and the raised hand in the foreground creates a powerful, commanding perspective.
tips: Replace the cash stacks with a neon city skyline for a less flashy version.
Change red lighting to blue or purple for a cooler nightclub atmosphere.
Use a 1:1 square frame if you want it as a music cover or album art.

title: Baby Sitting in Flower Garden Natural Light Portrait
description: This children's prompt creates a gentle portrait of a seven-month-old baby sitting on soft green grass in a natural flower garden. Colourful blooms surround the baby, and a soft, innocent smile is the centre of the image. Natural daylight brings out fine details such as tiny hair strands, skin texture and bright, sparkling eyes, while the background of flowers and greenery is softly blurred for depth. The prompt asks for the baby's face to stay exactly the same as the uploaded reference, so choose a clear, well-lit photo where the baby is looking toward the camera. This style is ideal for monthly milestone posts, baby albums, half-birthday celebrations, naming ceremony invitations and gifts for grandparents. It can also be printed as a framed keepsake or used on a calendar. The scene is calm and wholesome, with nothing distracting from the baby's expression. Because babies change quickly, many parents use this prompt each month with updated photos to create a matching series. Always use photos of your own child or with the parents' permission, and keep the realistic style so the result looks like a real garden photoshoot.
styleNotes: Soft natural daylight gives even, flattering light on the baby's skin. The palette blends fresh green grass with a mix of bright floral colours. A low, eye-level camera angle at the baby's height, centred composition and creamy background blur create an intimate, heartwarming portrait.
tips: Add a small sign reading '7 Months' beside the baby to make a milestone photo.
Change the outfit to a pastel romper or traditional dress for festivals.
Ask for a floral headband or tiny hat to add a playful detail.

title: Golden Hour Sunset Portrait in Dark Puffer Jacket
description: This prompt creates a cinematic portrait of a young man with voluminous, styled hair and sunglasses, looking upward as the warm light of a golden hour sunset falls across his face. He wears a dark puffer jacket and a simple necklace, giving the image a modern streetwear feel. The background shows city buildings blurred into soft shapes, which keeps attention on the dramatic light on his face and hair. The upward gaze adds a hopeful, thoughtful mood, as if he is looking toward the sky at the end of the day. This style works well for profile photos, winter travel posts, motivational quotes overlays and personal brand images for creators. The puffer jacket makes it a natural choice for cooler months or trips to hill stations and colder cities. The original prompt text ends abruptly, so you may want to add a final mood phrase such as 'intense and reflective atmosphere' for better results. A clear face reference will help, and side lighting in your original photo can improve how the sunset glow looks. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner.
styleNotes: Strong warm golden-hour light hits the face from one side, creating glowing highlights and deep shadows. Amber and orange tones contrast with the dark jacket and muted city background. A close, slightly low-angle composition with an upward gaze and heavy background blur produces a cinematic, aspirational feel.
tips: Add 'intense, reflective mood' at the end since the original sentence is cut off.
Swap the puffer jacket for a denim jacket or hoodie for warmer climates.
Replace the city background with mountains or a beach for travel posts.

title: Drone View Fashion Editorial Lying Among Wild Roses
description: This fashion editorial prompt is shot from a drone angle looking down through wild roses and other flowering plants. Blurred stems and petals frame the lens, giving the composition an artistic, layered look. A man lies relaxed on the ground, wearing a large purple-red sweater and white trousers, and holds a bouquet of fresh daisies in his hand. Flowers sway around him in the surrounding field, and the combination of romantic softness with bold modern fashion gives the image a magazine-cover quality. The overhead perspective is unusual for personal portraits, so the result stands out in a social feed. This prompt suits fashion and lifestyle creators, spring or Valentine's posts, album covers and anyone who wants a creative portrait that does not look like a standard headshot. Because the face is viewed from above, a reference photo taken from a similar angle or straight on with good light will help keep the likeness. The prompt mentions a Vogue-style editorial, so expect soft styling and an artful finish rather than a casual snapshot. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused daylight and blurred foreground petals create a dreamy, editorial look. The palette mixes the purple-red sweater and white trousers with pink roses, white daisies and green stems. A top-down drone composition with foreground framing places the reclining subject in the middle, surrounded by layers of flowers.
tips: Change the sweater to a pastel knit for a softer spring palette.
Swap daisies for sunflowers to create a brighter summer version.
Use a square 1:1 frame for an album-cover style result.

title: Oversized Shirt Portrait Under Pink Flowers and Foliage
description: This prompt creates a relaxed, stylish portrait of a young man in an oversized soft-coloured shirt with the top buttons undone, paired with denim trousers and a watch on his left wrist. His dark hair is slightly messy, his jawline sharp, and he looks straight at the camera with a smile while keeping one hand in his pocket. He stands against a dark grey wall, with green foliage and pink flowers hanging overhead, which adds a natural frame and a touch of colour above the subject. The contrast between the muted wall and the bright flowers keeps the image clean but interesting. This is a versatile prompt for profile pictures, LinkedIn-friendly casual portraits, dating profiles and everyday Instagram posts. It also suits college farewell photos or birthday posts where you want a simple, confident look. The prompt asks for a close match with your face, so a front-facing reference with even light is recommended. The original text has a stray quotation mark, which most image tools ignore, but you can remove it for a cleaner prompt.
styleNotes: Soft daylight gives an even, natural look without harsh shadows. A neutral grey wall and pastel shirt are balanced by green leaves and pink flowers at the top of the frame. The subject stands centred in a three-quarter-length composition, with the overhead foliage acting as a natural canopy.
tips: Pick a specific shirt shade such as sage green or sky blue for a more defined look.
Change the grey wall to exposed brick for a more urban street style.
Remove the stray quotation mark from the prompt text for cleaner parsing.

title: Purple Ruffled Gown Editorial in a Daisy Field
description: This high-fashion editorial prompt shows a young woman in a field of purple daisies, framed from the waist up. She wears a voluminous purple ruffled gown with a strapless neckline, a large ribbon bow in her long brown hair styled in soft waves, and gold earrings with a matching necklace. Her makeup is soft and dreamy, and the warm, romantic light of sunset falls across the scene in pastel tones. The prompt aims for a fashion magazine look, combining a fairy-tale outfit with a natural outdoor setting. It works well for birthday shoots, pre-wedding solo portraits, graduation celebrations, and Instagram posts with a dreamy aesthetic. It is also a good option for anyone who enjoys princess or cottagecore styles. The prompt asks that the face remain unchanged, so upload a clear portrait with natural light for the closest result. The purple palette is coordinated across the gown, bow and flowers, giving a polished, styled finish. If purple is not your colour, the whole scheme can be shifted to blush pink, sky blue or ivory while keeping the same composition.
styleNotes: Warm sunset backlight with soft fill creates a romantic glow and gentle pastel tones. The palette layers purples in the gown, bow and daisies, with gold jewellery adding small warm accents. A waist-up editorial composition places the subject in the centre, with flowers softly blurred in front and behind.
tips: Change the gown and flowers to blush pink for a softer birthday theme.
Swap the ribbon bow for a flower crown to give a garden-party feel.
Use a 4:5 vertical frame for Instagram or 2:3 for printing.

title: Candid Celebrity Moment Surrounded by Camera Crowd
description: This playful prompt makes you look like a celebrity caught on camera. The subject, based on your uploaded photo, stands in a crowded place while people around hold cameras and phones to take pictures. Fans fill the background, and the slight chaos of the crowd gives the image a lively, red-carpet or airport-arrival feel. The prompt asks for a candid, real-life moment with natural lighting and sharp details, so the result should look like a press photo rather than a posed studio portrait. It is a fun choice for birthday posts, celebration announcements, achievement updates such as passing an exam or landing a job, and light-hearted social media content. It also works for creators who want a thumbnail showing a 'famous' moment. The prompt is short, so adding details about your outfit, time of day and location can improve consistency, such as 'wearing a black blazer at night outside a theatre'. A clear, front-facing reference photo will help your face stay recognisable among the crowd. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner and can be removed.
styleNotes: Natural ambient lighting with occasional camera-flash highlights adds realism. The palette is driven by the subject's outfit against a varied, busy crowd. The subject is placed centrally in sharp focus, while surrounding photographers and fans fill the frame with motion and soft blur.
tips: Describe a red carpet and evening gown or suit for an awards-night version.
Set the scene at an airport arrival gate for a travel-style paparazzi shot.
Add camera flashes in the background to make the moment feel more dramatic.

title: Little Girl in Yellow Tulle Gown Among Pastel Blooms
description: This children's portrait prompt shows a six-year-old girl with a radiant smile standing gracefully in a lush arrangement of pastel flowers. Her long, wavy brown curls are decorated with small floral pins, and she wears an elegant off-the-shoulder gown in soft yellow with a voluminous tulle skirt. The background is a gentle blur of white, cream, pink and turquoise blossoms, which surrounds her with colour without competing with her face. The style is soft and fairy-tale-like, similar to a professional kids' studio shoot. It is a lovely choice for birthday invitations, birthday photo posts, family albums, school annual-day memories and framed prints for grandparents. The prompt starts by asking to convert your image into an ultra-realistic photo, so upload a clear, well-lit picture of the child. Always use your own child's photo or one you have permission to edit. If the child's hair is straight or short, you can adjust the description so the result still looks like them. The yellow gown pairs well with summer and spring themes, but it can be changed for festive seasons.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused light gives a bright, airy studio feel. The palette combines pale yellow with pastel pink, cream and turquoise blossoms. A centred, full or three-quarter-length composition frames the child among flowers, with a creamy blurred background that keeps attention on her smile and dress.
tips: Adjust the hair description to match your child's real hairstyle for a closer likeness.
Change the gown to pink or lavender for a princess-themed birthday.
Add a '6th Birthday' balloon or sign to make it a ready-made invitation image.

title: Maroon Silk Saree Portrait With Jasmine and Flower Basket
description: This prompt creates a photorealistic portrait of a South Indian woman in a rich maroon silk saree with a golden border. Her hair is braided and decorated with jasmine flowers, and she wears delicate gold earrings and bangles. She holds a flower basket gracefully, which adds a gentle, traditional touch to the pose. The background is outdoors in soft daylight, with greenery blurred behind her so the saree's colour and gold border stand out. The overall look is classic and elegant, close to a temple visit or festival morning photograph. This prompt suits Varamahalakshmi, Diwali, Ugadi, Pongal and wedding-season posts, as well as traditional day photos and family greetings. It is also a good option for anyone who wants a dignified profile picture in ethnic wear. The original prompt describes an generated portrait of a woman, but you can add 'based on the uploaded photo' to use your own face. Use a reference photo with even lighting for the best result. The maroon and gold palette is timeless, though the saree colour can be easily changed to match your own favourite silk.
styleNotes: Soft natural daylight gives even, gentle illumination on face and silk. The palette pairs deep maroon with gold zari, white jasmine and green background foliage. A three-quarter composition centres the subject holding the basket, with a shallow depth of field blurring the greenery for a clean, traditional portrait.
tips: Add 'based on my uploaded photo' at the start to use your own face.
Fill the basket with marigolds and mango leaves for a festival offering look.
Switch the saree to mustard or peacock green while keeping the gold border.

title: Blue Chiffon Saree Couple Back-to-Back in Cloud Garden
description: This couple prompt shows a woman with long, dark, wavy hair in a dual blue and cream chiffon saree with a full-sleeve blouse, posing joyfully in the style of a classic Bollywood song sequence. Her partner stands back-to-back with her in a cream kurta, looking sideways. The background is a dreamy flower garden with clouds drifting through, giving the scene a filmy, fantasy feel. Both faces are meant to stay the same as the uploaded photos, so clear images of each person are important. This style suits anniversary posts, pre-wedding save-the-date images, Valentine's Day greetings and couple profile pictures. The playful pose and soft colours make it feel light and romantic rather than formal. Because the prompt includes two people, results may need a couple of attempts to get both likenesses right; uploading a single photo of the couple together often helps. The coordinated blue and cream palette ties the two outfits together. If you prefer a different look, the chiffon saree can be swapped for a lehenga, or the kurta changed to a sherwani for a wedding theme.
styleNotes: Soft, bright daylight with a hazy glow suits the dreamy setting. Blue and cream outfits are coordinated against colourful flowers and white clouds. A back-to-back composition places the couple in the centre with the woman slightly forward, framed by flowers and drifting clouds for a filmy fantasy look.
tips: Upload one clear photo of the couple together to improve both likenesses.
Change the saree to red and the kurta to gold for a wedding anniversary theme.
Add falling rose petals for a more romantic film-song moment.

title: Cartoon Cat and Mouse Selfie With a Young Girl
description: This playful children's prompt creates a selfie scene featuring a young girl alongside a well-known cartoon cat and mouse pair. The grey cat with yellow eyes holds a black smartphone in his paw, angled toward the camera, with a wide, excited grin. The brown mouse stands beside him smiling with his mouth open, and the girl stands next to the mouse, copying the same position and cheerful expression from the uploaded photo. The result is a mix of real-life photography and cartoon characters, which makes it fun for kids' birthday posts, school holiday photos and family sharing. Because the characters are trademarked, this image is best kept for private, personal use rather than printed merchandise or commercial posts. You can also replace the characters with a generic grey cat and small brown mouse to keep the same playful idea without the specific cartoon designs. Use a clear, front-facing photo of the child with good lighting. The prompt asks for the same face, body and hair as the uploaded image, so a full-body reference gives the most accurate result.
styleNotes: Bright, even lighting suits the cheerful cartoon-meets-real look. The palette uses the cat's grey, the mouse's brown and the child's outfit colours against a simple background. A tight, selfie-style composition places all three characters close together, with the phone angled toward the viewer in the foreground.
tips: Replace the cartoon characters with a generic cat and mouse to avoid trademarked designs.
Add colourful birthday hats and confetti around everyone for a party-themed selfie.
Use a full-body reference photo so the child's outfit is carried over accurately.

title: Black Saree Portrait Holding Warm String Lights
description: This festive prompt shows a young woman with long, straight dark hair and subtle makeup wearing a classic black saree with a shimmering border. She holds a cluster of warm white string lights in her hands and looks down at them with a gentle smile, so her face is softly lit by the bulbs. Silver jhumka earrings add a traditional accent. Behind her, a tunnel or pathway of golden bokeh lights creates a magical background full of soft glowing circles. The contrast of the black saree with the warm lights gives the image an elegant, evening feel. This prompt is ideal for Diwali, Christmas, New Year's Eve and Karthika Deepam posts, as well as birthday portraits taken at night. It also suits anyone who wants an elegant profile picture with a festive glow. Use a clear photo of your face for the reference, and add 'based on the uploaded photo' if your image tool needs that instruction. Because the light source is in her hands, the downward gaze is important for the effect; keep that part of the prompt when customising.
styleNotes: The main light comes from warm string lights in the subject's hands, softly lighting the face from below. A black saree and silver jhumkas contrast with golden bokeh behind. A medium close-up composition with a downward gaze places the lights near the centre, surrounded by circular background bokeh.
tips: Swap string lights for a clay diya held in both hands for a Diwali version.
Change the black saree to deep red or emerald for more colour.
Use a 9:16 frame for festive stories and status updates.

title: Punjabi Patiala Suit Portrait on Black Off-Road Jeep
description: This full-body cinematic prompt shows a stylish young woman sitting confidently on the hood of a rugged black off-road jeep. She wears a Punjabi Patiala suit in a mochaccino and black shade with a colourful chunni draped over her shoulders, light makeup and jewellery. She holds a long decorated stick, a lathi, resting casually on her shoulder, and wears sunglasses for a bold, playful attitude. The setting is an open, arid landscape that adds to the rugged mood. This prompt blends traditional Punjabi dress with a tough, adventurous vibe, making it popular for Lohri, Baisakhi and Navratri posts, as well as birthday portraits and road-trip themed images. It works well for anyone who wants a confident, desi-swag style photo. The original wording is a little jumbled, so you may get better results by tidying it into one clear sentence describing the outfit and setting. Use a clear face reference that matches the hairstyle you want. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner and can be removed for a cleaner result.
styleNotes: Bright, warm daylight suits the dry, open landscape. Mochaccino and black clothing pairs with a colourful chunni and the glossy black jeep. A full-body composition places the subject seated on the hood, with the lathi creating a strong diagonal line and the arid background stretching behind.
tips: Rewrite the outfit as one clear phrase, such as 'black and mocha Patiala suit with a phulkari chunni'.
Change the arid setting to mustard fields for a Punjab countryside look.
Remove the lathi and add a cup of chai for a relaxed road-trip version.

title: Three-Pose Collage Portrait With White Flowers
description: This collage prompt creates a soft-focus image of a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a light pink top or dress, shown in three different poses within one frame. In the first close-up, she smiles brightly while playfully holding a small white flower near her nose. In the second, she adjusts a white flower in her hair, and the third is a full-body shot of her smiling downward with a flower tucked in her hair. The background is dreamy and ethereal, keeping the mood light and feminine. Combining three moments in one picture makes this prompt useful for birthday posts, Instagram carousels condensed into one image, and profile banners. The original prompt includes a placeholder name, so you can replace it with your own name if you want it written on the image or simply remove it. A clear, well-lit face reference will help keep all three poses looking like the same person. The pastel pink palette is soft and flattering, and the white flowers give a fresh, natural touch that suits spring and summer posts.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused lighting and a slight glow create a dreamy finish. The palette centres on pale pink clothing, white flowers and a light, misty background. A three-panel collage composition mixes a close-up, a mid-shot and a full-body view, giving variety while keeping a consistent look across poses.
tips: Replace the placeholder name with your own or remove it for a text-free collage.
Change the white flowers to pink roses to match the outfit more closely.
Use a 16:9 frame for a wider banner or a 4:5 frame for feed posts.

title: Yellow Floral Chiffon Saree Among White Roses
description: This prompt creates a close-up, high-fashion portrait of a young woman wearing a yellow floral-print chiffon saree with a sleeveless blouse. She smiles softly while holding a white rose in one hand, accessorised with a diamond ring, chain, bracelet and small diamond earrings. Her black hair is loose and slightly messy, with a few strands falling across her face. She stands among white roses, and the scene has cinematic blue-white tones with soft natural light. The prompt mentions an 85 mm lens, which gives a flattering perspective with a softly blurred background. The mood is ethereal and calm, like a page from a fashion magazine. This style works well for birthday posts, engagement or pre-wedding solo shots, spring greetings and elegant profile photos. The prompt asks to keep facial features unchanged, so a clear, front-facing reference is best. Although white heels are mentioned, the close-up framing may not show them; switch to a full-length shot if you want the footwear visible. The cool tones give a fresh contrast to the warm yellow saree.
styleNotes: Soft natural light with a cool blue-white grade gives an airy, ethereal mood. A warm yellow floral saree stands out against white roses and cool tones. The 85 mm close-up composition creates gentle background compression and bokeh, with loose strands of hair adding texture across the face.
tips: Ask for a full-length shot if you want the white heels and saree drape visible.
Warm up the grade to golden hour if you prefer softer, sunnier tones.
Swap the white rose for a small bouquet for an engagement theme.

title: Pink Outfit Collage With Yellow Flowers in Three Poses
description: This collage prompt shows a young Indian woman with long dark hair in a light pink top or dress, captured in three poses combined into one soft-focus image. In one close-up she smiles brightly and holds a small yellow flower near her nose; in another she adjusts a yellow flower in her hair; and in the third, a full-body shot, she smiles downward with a flower still in her hair. The background is dreamy and ethereal, giving the collage a gentle, magazine-style feel. The yellow flowers add a cheerful pop of colour against the pastel pink outfit. It is well suited to birthday posts, friendship day messages, profile banners and spring or summer social media updates. The prompt includes a placeholder where you can add your own name, or you can remove it to keep the image text-free. For the best results, use one clear, front-facing reference photo with soft lighting so all three poses stay consistent. This version is a sunnier alternative to the white-flower collage and pairs nicely with Haldi or Vasant Panchami themes when the outfit is changed to yellow.
styleNotes: Soft, glowing light and gentle blur create a dreamy look. Pastel pink clothing pairs with bright yellow flowers for a cheerful contrast. The three-pose collage arrangement combines close-up, medium and full-body framing, with a light, misty background tying the panels together.
tips: Change the outfit to yellow for a Haldi or Vasant Panchami themed collage.
Replace the placeholder name with your own or remove it entirely.
Specify a vertical layout for stories or a horizontal layout for banners.

title: Couple Portrait With Black Off-Roader in Flower Tree Garden
description: This couple prompt shows an Indian couple in a garden filled with blooming silk-cotton (bombax) flower trees. The man sits casually on the bonnet of a black off-road SUV, wearing a pink-to-white gradient suit, white jeans, white shoes, a smartwatch and blue rectangular sunglasses. The woman stands beside him in a pink gown, matching his colour scheme. Warm daylight filters through the trees, creating a relaxed outdoor mood with greenery and flowers in the background. The prompt asks for both faces and hairstyles to remain the same as the uploaded photos, so clear images of each person help. This style suits pre-wedding shoots, anniversary posts, engagement announcements and couple profile pictures. The coordinated pink outfits and the bold black vehicle create a fun mix of romantic and stylish. If you do not want a vehicle in the scene, it can be replaced with a garden bench or swing. Generating a few variations is useful, since two-person prompts sometimes need adjustments to get both likenesses right. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner.
styleNotes: Warm daylight with soft shadows gives the garden scene a relaxed glow. Pink and white outfits are coordinated against the glossy black vehicle and red-orange tree blossoms. The composition places the seated man on the bonnet and the woman standing beside him, with trees framing the couple in the background.
tips: Replace the vehicle with a wooden swing for a softer garden romance shot.
Change both outfits to beige and white for a minimalist pre-wedding look.
Upload a single photo of the couple together to improve likeness.

title: Trishula Back Tattoo Portrait in Misty Ocean Waters
description: This devotional-themed prompt creates a dramatic image of a young, athletic man standing waist-deep in dark, turbulent ocean water, facing away from the camera with his head turned slightly to the side. A large, intricate, symmetrical Trishula, the trident associated with Lord Shiva, is tattooed down the centre of his back. He wears a simple orange-beaded necklace, which adds a spiritual touch. In the vast, misty background, the prompt describes a colossal dark stone statue rising from the sea, intended as a statue of Lord Shiva, though the original text is cut off before naming it. The atmosphere is powerful and reverent, with heavy mist and moody tones. This style is popular for Maha Shivaratri, Shravan month and Karthika Somavara posts, and for devotees who want an image expressing faith and strength. Because the subject faces away, the face reference matters less, making this a good option for people who prefer not to show their face. Complete the final sentence by naming the statue, for example 'a colossal stone statue of Lord Shiva in meditation', to get a consistent result. Treat the theme respectfully when sharing.
styleNotes: Moody, diffused light filters through heavy sea mist, creating a solemn atmosphere. Dark blue-grey water and stone tones dominate, with the orange beads as a small warm accent. The back-facing composition centres the trident tattoo, with the giant statue looming in the misty distance for scale.
tips: Finish the cut-off line by naming the statue, such as 'Lord Shiva in meditation'.
Add a rudraksha mala instead of orange beads for a more traditional devotional look.
Use a 9:16 frame so the statue towers above the figure in the composition.

title: Seaside Sand Hearts Couple Scene at Sunset
description: This romantic prompt shows a seaside scene at golden sunset. A 28-year-old man sits on the sand with a heart drawn in front of him, containing a name written inside. On the other side, a woman sits facing him with her own heart in the sand, also holding a name. The two hearts mirror each other, creating a sweet, symmetrical story about two people connected across the beach. Warm golden light, gentle waves and a soft sky give the image an emotional, cinematic quality. The original prompt uses the first names of a well-known film couple; for personal use, replace them with your own names and your partner's name so the image tells your story. This style suits anniversary posts, Valentine's Day messages, proposal announcements, wedding countdowns and long-distance relationship greetings. Because the faces are not specified with references in the original wording, you can add 'based on the uploaded photos' if you want your own likeness. Clear sand lettering works best with short names, so keep each name to one word for legibility. The sunset palette gives warmth without needing extra props or decorations.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour sunlight bathes the scene, casting long soft shadows across the sand. The palette blends amber sky, golden sand and deep blue sea. A symmetrical composition places the man and woman on opposite sides with the two sand hearts in the foreground, leading the eye between them.
tips: Replace both names with your own and your partner's first names.
Add 'based on the uploaded photos' so the couple resembles you.
Keep each name short so the sand lettering stays clear and readable.

title: Vintage Black Car on Misty Mountain Road Portrait
description: This prompt creates a moody, cinematic portrait of a stylish 25-year-old man with blonde, messy hair leaning casually against the front of a vintage black car parked on a mountain road. He wears black sunglasses, a loose black and white short-sleeve shirt, white trousers and black and white sneakers. The car has classic round headlights and a chrome grille, giving the scene a retro character, and the licence plate is visible. Behind him, misty mountains partly hidden by clouds create a cool, atmospheric backdrop. The overall feel is confident and modern with a retro touch. This prompt suits road-trip posts, travel content from hill stations, automotive enthusiasts' profiles and men's fashion inspiration. The blonde hair is part of the original description, so change it to your real hair colour if you want a more natural likeness. The prompt asks for a close face match, so use a clear reference photo. The licence plate can be customised with your initials or left blank. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the corner and can be removed if needed.
styleNotes: Soft, overcast light filtered through mountain mist creates muted, even tones. The palette is monochrome-leaning: black car, black and white outfit, grey clouds and green-grey hills. A three-quarter composition places the subject leaning on the car's front, with the road and mountains receding into the misty background.
tips: Change 'blonde messy hair' to your own hair colour for a closer likeness.
Add your initials on the licence plate or ask for a blank plate.
Switch the car colour to cream or racing green for a more vintage feel.

title: Laughing Toddler With Cartoon Cat and Mouse Playmates
description: This children's prompt blends a real-looking toddler with animated characters in a warm, playful scene. A cute three-year-old boy sits on the floor laughing, wearing a white T-shirt and denim shorts. Around him, a famous cartoon cat and mouse duo play: the mouse holds a tiny piece of cheese near the boy's shoe, while the cat peeks out from behind a toy box. The style is a soft blend of cartoon and real photography, with gentle lighting and a colourful background scattered with toys. The mood is joyful and lively, capturing the kind of laughter parents love to remember. This image is suited to birthday posts, family albums, playroom prints and holiday greetings. Because the characters are trademarked, keep this for private, personal sharing rather than merchandise or commercial use; you can also describe a generic cartoon cat and mouse to get a similar effect. Use a clear, recent photo of the child with good lighting for a close likeness. The prompt asks for a near-identical face, so a front-facing photo where the child is smiling works best.
styleNotes: Soft, warm indoor light gives a cosy, friendly mood. Bright toy colours fill the background, with the white T-shirt and blue denim keeping the child clean and central. A low, floor-level composition places the boy in the middle with cartoon characters on either side, creating a balanced, playful scene.
tips: Describe a generic cartoon cat and mouse instead of the trademarked characters.
Add balloons and a small cake to turn it into a birthday image.
Change the outfit to a festive kurta for Diwali or Eid greetings.

title: Urban Crouch Fashion Shot With Gold Sunglasses
description: This fashion photography prompt shows a confident young woman with long, wavy dark hair peeking over oval gold-rimmed sunglasses with a playful smile, looking straight at the viewer.
