She wears a fitted black ribbed long-sleeved crop top, light blue distressed denim shorts and black knee-high slouchy boots with block heels. A gold watch with floral detail and a delicate gold chain hanging from her shorts add small accessories that catch the light. She is posed in a dynamic crouch on textured asphalt, with a softly blurred urban backdrop of grey concrete structures and railings. The image has the look of a streetwear magazine shoot. It suits fashion and lifestyle creators, Instagram profile updates, birthday posts and city travel content. The crouching pose adds energy and is less common than standing portraits, which helps the image stand out. Use a clear, front-facing reference photo for the face. If you prefer a more modest outfit, the shorts can be swapped for wide-leg jeans or a skirt while keeping the same pose and setting.
styleNotes: Soft daylight with gentle contrast suits the urban setting. Black and denim-blue clothing is accented with gold sunglasses, watch and chain against grey concrete. A low camera angle captures the crouching pose, with the subject filling the frame and the blurred city background adding depth.
tips: Swap the denim shorts for wide-leg jeans for a more covered streetwear look.
Change the location to a graffiti wall for a bolder urban background.
Use a 4:5 crop so the full crouching pose fits an Instagram fashion post.

title: Teal Saree Portrait Beside a Winding Stream
description: This environmental portrait prompt shows a young woman in a flowing teal-green saree sitting gracefully beside a small, winding stream in a lush grassy field. She looks down at the water with a calm, thoughtful expression, suggesting quiet reflection. The lighting is soft and overcast, creating luminous shadows and gentle highlights on her face and the folds of the saree. Colours are muted with warm skin tones, subtle film grain and low contrast, giving the image a timeless, cinematic quality. The prompt is well structured, with separate sections for lighting, mood, colour and depth, which helps image tools produce consistent results. This style is ideal for poetry and quote posts, nature-themed profile photos, personal portfolio images and calm birthday portraits. It also works for anyone who wants an artistic image that feels like a still from an art-house film. The face is requested to match the uploaded reference exactly, so choose a clear photo with soft light. The teal saree pairs naturally with green fields, but other muted colours such as dusty rose or ivory would suit the same mood.
styleNotes: Soft overcast light creates luminous, even illumination with gentle shadows. Muted teal, green and earthy tones dominate, finished with subtle film grain and low contrast. An environmental composition places the seated subject off-centre beside the curving stream, which leads the eye through the grassy field.
tips: Change the saree to dusty rose or ivory while keeping the muted film look.
Add light morning fog over the field for a more poetic atmosphere.
Use a 3:2 horizontal frame to show more of the stream and landscape.

title: Burgundy Suit Walking With Red Roses at Golden Hour
description: This romantic outdoor prompt shows a young man in a burgundy suit and white shirt walking slowly toward the camera with a cheerful smile, holding a bouquet of red roses in one hand. The golden-hour sun behind him creates a glowing rim light around his silhouette and a soft flare through the trees. The background is a softly blurred rustic fence with foliage, and the shallow depth of field keeps him sharp. The mood is lively, confident and heartfelt, as if he is on his way to surprise someone special. The prompt specifies a 4:5 vertical frame, which fits Instagram feed posts well. It suits Valentine's Day, proposal announcements, anniversary greetings, Rose Day and wedding-season content. It is also a good choice for a confident, dressed-up profile picture. The face and hairstyle are requested to remain identical to the reference, so upload a clear portrait. Gentle HDR and lens haze are mentioned, giving a polished, studio-quality finish while keeping natural skin tones. The burgundy and red palette is warm and coordinated, but the suit colour can be changed to navy or beige.
styleNotes: Golden-hour backlight creates a glowing rim around the subject and soft lens flare. Burgundy, red and white are set against warm green and brown background tones. A 4:5 vertical composition shows the subject walking toward the camera, centred, with a shallow depth of field blurring the fence and trees.
tips: Change the suit to navy or beige for a different formal look.
Swap red roses for sunflowers for a cheerful birthday version.
Add a small gift box in the other hand for a proposal or anniversary theme.

title: Linen Shirt Look Leaning on a Two-Tone Luxury SUV
description: This automotive lifestyle prompt shows a young man leaning casually with one hand on the hood of a premium luxury SUV, turned slightly toward the camera. The front-right angle shows off the car's two-tone finish, champagne on the upper body and glossy black on the lower half, shimmering under soft daylight filtering through lush green trees. He wears an off-white oversized linen shirt, black baggy jeans and chunky sneakers, with a silver luxury watch and frameless narrow sunglasses. The overall look is relaxed but polished, like an editorial for a lifestyle magazine. This prompt suits car enthusiasts, aspirational lifestyle posts, new vehicle celebration images and men's fashion inspiration. The original version names a specific luxury SUV model and sneaker brand; you can keep these or describe a generic two-tone SUV and chunky white sneakers. The prompt includes a height detail, which helps set proportions relative to the car. Use a clear face reference for the best likeness. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the corner and can be removed for a cleaner image.
styleNotes: Soft daylight filtered through trees creates gentle dappled highlights on the car and subject. Champagne and black paint pair with an off-white shirt and black jeans for a refined neutral palette. A three-quarter front-right composition shows both the subject and the car's front, framed by green foliage.
tips: Describe a generic two-tone SUV if you prefer not to name a car brand.
Change the linen shirt to a pastel polo for a summer look.
Use a 16:9 frame to fit the full length of the vehicle.

title: Concert Stage Walk With Flaming Guitar and Sparks
description: This high-energy prompt creates a cinematic close-up of a young man walking with intensity across a concert stage. His black shirt is partly on fire with glowing orange flames, and he drags a burning guitar behind him, leaving a trail of fire. Sparks scatter in motion blur, the air is thick with smoke, and faint firelight glows in the background. The lighting mixes moody golden-orange highlights with cool shadows, giving the image an aggressive, dramatic look like a rock music video or film poster. The expression requested is intense and action-focused. This style is a good fit for musicians, band promotions, gaming or action-themed profile images, YouTube thumbnails and fan-art style posters. Because it is a dramatic fantasy scene, it works best for creative and entertainment uses. The face is requested to match the uploaded photo, so a clear, front-facing reference with good light is recommended. If you prefer something less intense, reduce the fire to just the guitar and keep the shirt intact. HDR realism is requested, so expect strong contrast and vivid detail in the flames.
styleNotes: Golden-orange firelight contrasts with cool blue-grey shadows for a dramatic, high-contrast look. Black clothing and dark stage tones make the flames and sparks stand out. A close, slightly low-angle composition shows the subject walking toward the camera, with motion-blurred sparks and smoke filling the frame.
tips: Keep the fire only on the guitar for a less intense version.
Add a crowd silhouette and stage lights for a live-concert feel.
Use a 16:9 frame when making YouTube thumbnails or wide concert posters.

title: Junkyard Editorial With Red Vintage Car and Sledgehammer
description: This edgy fashion editorial prompt shows a man dressed in a grey vest, white shirt with a red skinny tie, grey tailored trousers, a black leather jacket, black leather gloves, black sunglasses and black Chelsea boots. He holds a red sledgehammer in his left hand, striking the front bonnet of a glossy red vintage car, while holding a cigar near his lips with his right hand. The setting is a car junkyard filled with damaged vehicles, which gives the scene a gritty, rebellious feel. The focus stays on the man and his outfit, framed as a close-up portrait. The style suits creative fashion posts, music video concepts, poster designs and bold profile images for people who like a tough aesthetic. The original prompt names a specific classic car brand; you can keep it or describe a generic red vintage sedan. The cigar detail can be removed if you want a smoke-free image for broader sharing. Use a clear face reference to keep the likeness. Red accents on the tie, hammer and car tie the composition together with a consistent colour story.
styleNotes: Cinematic, contrasty lighting with hard highlights suits the gritty mood. Grey and black clothing is punctuated by red in the tie, sledgehammer and car. A close-up editorial composition keeps the man in focus, with the damaged cars of the junkyard blurred behind for depth.
tips: Remove the cigar for a smoke-free version suitable for wider sharing.
Describe a generic red vintage sedan instead of a named brand.
Swap the junkyard for a neon-lit garage for a night-time look.

title: Rear View Lifestyle Shot on a Luxury SUV Trunk
description: This lifestyle prompt shows a young man leaning casually on the rear of a premium luxury SUV, with sunlight dappling through a green canopy of trees above. The car's rear design and two-tone paint reflect a high-end feel. He wears an off-white oversized linen shirt, black baggy jeans and chunky sneakers, with a silver watch and frameless sunglasses that catch the warm daylight. The prompt mentions a cinema-grade 50 mm lens, which gives a natural perspective, balanced exposure and rich, realistic contrast. The mood is calm and confident, like a weekend getaway or a lifestyle magazine feature. This prompt suits automotive enthusiasts, aspirational lifestyle posts, road-trip content and fashion inspiration. It is a natural companion to front-angle car prompts if you want a matching set of images. The original version names a specific SUV model, lens maker and sneaker brand; these can be replaced with generic descriptions. The prompt includes a stray phrase, 'font site', which can be deleted. Use a clear face reference for the best result, and remove the signature line if you prefer a clean image.
styleNotes: Dappled warm sunlight through leaves creates soft, natural highlights. A neutral palette of off-white, black and champagne paint sits against green foliage. The 50 mm composition shows the subject leaning on the trunk from a three-quarter rear angle, with balanced exposure and gentle background blur.
tips: Delete the stray words 'font site' from the prompt for cleaner results.
Pair this with the front-angle version to create a matching two-photo set.
Add an open boot with travel bags for a road-trip story.

title: Candid Walk Through Bougainvillea Path With Hands in Pockets
description: This prompt captures a stylish young man mid-step as he walks along a path lined with green foliage and pink bougainvillea. Both hands are tucked into his pockets, giving a relaxed, confident walk. He wears a black and white gradient half-sleeve shirt with loose-fitting trousers, his hair is natural, and his sunglasses reflect the sunlight. He glances slightly to the side, creating a spontaneous moment rather than a posed look. Soft bokeh from flowers and sunlight fills the background, adding a romantic, dreamy layer. This style suits casual profile pictures, summer posts, travel content and fashion inspiration for men who like a clean, effortless look. The prompt specifies a height and face match with the uploaded image, so use a clear, front-facing reference. The original wording is informal in places, so tidying it into shorter phrases may improve consistency. The pink flowers and monochrome outfit create a pleasing contrast that works well in social media feeds. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner and can be removed for a clean result.
styleNotes: Bright sunlight with soft bokeh highlights gives a warm, airy feel. A black and white outfit contrasts with vivid pink bougainvillea and fresh green leaves. A full or three-quarter-length walking composition places the subject on the path, with flowers framing both sides and blurring into the background.
tips: Simplify the outfit wording to 'black and white gradient shirt, loose beige trousers'.
Change the bougainvillea to yellow flowers for a different colour accent.
Use a 9:16 frame to emphasise the walking path and height.

title: Red Modified Off-Roader at a Jaipur Petrol Station
description: This automotive prompt shows a young man posing confidently at an Indian petrol station in Jaipur during the day, leaning on a heavily modified red off-road SUV. The vehicle has a glossy red finish, custom wheels and a lowered body, giving it a bold, customised look. He wears casual streetwear: a white T-shirt, brown jacket, dark jeans and white sneakers. Bright petrol station lights reflect on the car's surface, adding shine to the scene. The setting gives the image a local, road-trip character that feels different from studio or garden shots. This prompt suits car modification enthusiasts, road-trip posts across Rajasthan, new vehicle celebrations and casual profile pictures. The original version names a specific SUV model and sneaker brand; you can keep those or describe a generic red 4x4 and white sneakers. The prompt asks for a full face match, so use a clear reference photo. Since it is set in daylight, mentioning a time such as 'late afternoon' can add warmer tones. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the corner, which can be removed.
styleNotes: Daylight combined with bright station lighting adds reflections on the glossy red paint. The palette features vivid red against white, brown and denim clothing and the neutral tones of the station. A three-quarter composition shows the subject leaning on the side of the vehicle, with fuel pumps and canopy behind.
tips: Change the time to dusk so the station lights glow more strongly.
Describe a generic red 4x4 if you prefer not to name a model.
Swap the brown jacket for a denim jacket for a lighter look.

title: Relaxed Convertible Portrait With Foreshortened Leg Pose
description: This prompt creates a cinematic portrait of a stylish young man with wavy hair lounging in the driver's seat of a white convertible sports car with the roof open. He stretches one leg across the other seat toward the camera, creating a relaxed, foreshortened perspective that makes the image feel dynamic and playful. He wears a glossy black full-sleeve button-up shirt, light beige cargo trousers, a white smartwatch, a bracelet, a chain and oversized square sunglasses. Soft natural light, a shallow depth of field and a muted green background with trees give a moody, editorial feel. The prompt references a 50 mm lens look with smooth bokeh. This style suits car lovers, summer road-trip posts, fashion inspiration and confident profile pictures. The unusual leg-forward pose makes it stand out compared with standard car portraits. Use a clear face reference for best results. If you want a more classic pose, describe him sitting upright with one arm on the door instead. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner.
styleNotes: Soft natural light keeps contrast gentle and moody. A white car, glossy black shirt and beige cargo trousers form a clean neutral palette against muted green trees. A foreshortened composition brings the leg toward the lens, with the face in focus and a smooth bokeh background behind the open-top car.
tips: Describe an upright seated pose with an arm on the door for a classic look.
Change the car colour to red or black for a bolder image.
Add a coastal road background for a seaside drive feel.

title: Yellow Leather Jacket and Sports Car in Dubai
description: This prompt creates a cinematic portrait of a man leaning against a yellow and black modified muscle car parked in front of Dubai's Museum of the Future. He wears a yellow leather jacket, white T-shirt, black jeans, yellow sunglasses and sneakers, colour-matched to the car. Warm golden sunlight bathes the scene, with lens flares reflecting off the car's surface and soft amber tones on his skin and jacket. The style blends luxury fashion photography with a sports-car editorial, giving a confident, smooth and radiant mood. The prompt mentions an 85 mm lens and HDR realism, which suggests a flattering perspective and vivid detail. This style suits travel posts from Dubai, car enthusiast content, birthday images with a luxury theme and bold profile pictures. The original version names a specific car model and sneaker brand; you can describe a generic yellow muscle car and plain sneakers instead. The face and hairstyle are requested to match the reference, so use a clear photo. The coordinated yellow and black palette makes the subject and car feel like one designed composition.
styleNotes: Warm golden sunset light creates amber highlights and lens flares across the car and jacket. Yellow and black dominate, set against the silver curves of the landmark building. An 85 mm three-quarter composition places the subject leaning on the car, with the architecture softly blurred behind.
tips: Describe a generic yellow muscle car if you prefer not to name a brand.
Change the landmark to a city skyline you have visited.
Switch the colour scheme to red and black for a different look.

title: Cuban Collar Shirt Pose on a White Custom SUV
description: This vertical 9:16 prompt shows a stylish, confident 21-year-old man with voluminous hair sitting casually on the bonnet of a customised white luxury SUV. He wears an oversized Cuban-collar shirt, denim trousers and white sneakers, with a cinematic colour grade over the whole image. The prompt asks for the entire vehicle to be visible in the frame, highlighting its mirror-gloss white paint, black rims, chrome accents, smoked headlights, low-profile tyres and bright white LED daytime running lights. Because both the subject and the full car need to fit, the result is a wider shot than a typical portrait, which makes it useful when the vehicle is as important as the person. This prompt suits new car celebrations, car enthusiast posts, Instagram stories, and confident lifestyle profile photos. The original wording names a specific luxury SUV brand; you can keep it or describe a generic white premium SUV. Spelling in the original is a little rough ('Qban qualar', 'cenemetic'), so correcting these words may improve results. Use a clear face reference to keep your likeness in the wider frame.
styleNotes: A cinematic colour grade with soft contrast suits the polished, glossy vehicle. White paint, chrome and black rims form a crisp monochrome palette, with the patterned shirt adding colour. The 9:16 vertical composition fits the whole SUV with the subject seated on the bonnet near the centre.
tips: Correct the spellings to 'Cuban collar shirt' and 'cinematic' for more reliable results.
Describe a generic white premium SUV if you prefer no brand names.
Add a night city background with LED reflections for a dramatic version.

title: Colourful Oversized Shirt Half Portrait in Lush Greenery
description: This prompt creates a half-length portrait of a young man in an oversized, colourful shirt, leaning casually with voluminous styled hair. Soft, moody cinematic lighting highlights his facial features in a natural way. The background is filled with deeply blurred lush green foliage, and leaves in the foreground drift softly out of focus, creating layers of depth. The earthy setting and relaxed pose give the image a calm, natural vibe that still looks styled. This is a flexible, everyday prompt that works well for profile photos, dating apps, Instagram posts and personal branding images for creators who want a friendly, approachable look. Because the prompt keeps clothing details simple, the colourful shirt is the main point of interest, so you can easily describe a specific print such as tropical leaves or abstract patterns. The face is requested to remain unchanged from the uploaded photo, so use a clear, front-facing reference. The original text ends with an incomplete phrase about the outfit, which you can clean up for better results. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the corner.
styleNotes: Soft, moody side lighting gently sculpts the face. A vibrant shirt is set against deep green foliage, creating an earthy palette with one colourful focal point. Half-length framing with blurred foreground leaves and a creamy background adds layered depth and draws attention to the subject.
tips: Name a specific print such as tropical leaves or abstract waves for the shirt.
Clean up the unfinished outfit phrase so the prompt reads clearly.
Add warm late-afternoon light for a golden version of the same scene.

title: Indigo and Lime Bandhani Saree Nature Portrait
description: This prompt produces a hyper-realistic, HDR medium-full shot of a young woman seated outdoors in nature. She has long dark hair, subtle pink makeup and a pleasant smile, and wears a vibrant indigo and lime green tie-dye saree with traditional bandhani patterns. Silver rings, earrings and bangles complete the look. She is angled slightly to the right, looking up and to the left, with her right hand touching the fabric of the saree. The overall image has a dramatic, deep, soft green grade that matches the natural surroundings. This style suits Navratri, Teej and Raksha Bandhan posts, traditional day photos and nature-themed profile pictures. The bandhani pattern adds a Gujarati and Rajasthani touch that pairs well with festive greetings. The face is requested to stay identical to the uploaded photo, so choose a clear image with soft light. The original text has a few typos and an unfinished line about the left hand, which you can complete, for example 'left hand resting on her lap'. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the corner and is optional.
styleNotes: Soft natural light with an HDR finish brings out texture in the saree and skin. Indigo and lime green bandhani patterns sit within a deep green colour grade, with silver jewellery adding cool highlights. A medium-full composition shows the seated subject angled right, gazing up-left for a graceful, candid feel.
tips: Complete the unfinished pose line, for example 'left hand resting on her lap'.
Change the bandhani colours to red and yellow for a Navratri theme.
Add a garden swing or jhoola for a Teej festival setting.

title: Silver Saree Portrait Under Cascading Fairy Lights
description: This festive prompt shows a young Indian woman elegantly draped in a silver saree, standing among cascades of warm, twinkling string lights. She looks upward with a serene, thoughtful expression while gently holding one of the light strands. Her long dark hair is styled in a half-updo with braided sections, and she wears striking chandelier earrings and black bangles. Behind her, the background melts into soft, glowing bokeh, creating a magical and celebratory atmosphere. The silver saree reflects the warm lights, giving the fabric a gentle shimmer. This prompt suits Diwali, Christmas, New Year's Eve and wedding reception posts, as well as night-time birthday portraits and elegant profile photos. It is a brighter, more upward-looking companion to similar string-light prompts, with an emphasis on reflection and calm. The original version does not mention a face reference, so add 'based on my uploaded photo' at the start if you want your own likeness. Use a clear, well-lit reference photo. The silver and warm gold palette is classic, but a gold or champagne saree would work equally well.
styleNotes: Warm string lights provide soft, sparkling illumination and reflections on the silver fabric. The palette pairs silver and black accents with warm golden bokeh. A medium shot with an upward gaze places light strands across the frame, framing the face while the background dissolves into glowing circles.
tips: Add 'based on my uploaded photo' at the start to use your own face.
Change the saree to gold or champagne for a warmer festive tone.
Add floating diyas in the foreground for a Diwali version.

title: White Suit Portrait on a Crystal Throne Against Black
description: This minimalist power portrait shows a confident man sitting forward on a throne made entirely of diamonds and crystals, with an intense expression. Several swords are scattered on the floor around the throne, adding a dramatic, symbolic element. He sits with his legs crossed, wearing a white fitted suit and a silver luxury watch. The background is pure black, so the white suit and sparkling throne stand out sharply. The image is meant to symbolise modern power, success and ambition, shot in a high-fashion editorial tone with cinematic lighting. This style suits entrepreneurs, motivational content creators, birthday posts with a royal theme, achievement announcements and bold profile images. The original prompt names a specific watch brand and contains a few spelling errors ('dimond', 'swarods', 'suite'); correcting these helps image tools understand the request. The face is requested to stay identical to the uploaded photo, so use a clear, front-facing reference. The strong contrast of white on black makes this image work well as a poster or cover. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner.
styleNotes: Cinematic spotlighting from above creates bright highlights on the crystal throne and suit. A stark palette of white, silver and sparkling clear tones sits against a pure black background. A centred, symmetrical composition places the seated subject on the throne, with swords scattered in the foreground.
tips: Correct the spellings to 'diamond', 'swords' and 'suit' for clearer results.
Change the white suit to black for a darker, villain-style portrait.
Add a gold crown on his head for a royal birthday king theme.

title: Checked Shirt Couple Under a Tree With Rose
description: This outdoor prompt shows a young man sitting on the grass with his back against a tree. He wears a brown checked shirt over a white T-shirt, white slim-fit trousers and white sneakers, with a white smartwatch on his left wrist and a mala-style locket around his neck. A red rose lies on the grass beside him. Soft natural light and blurred greenery create a calm, dreamy scene, and the prompt ends by introducing a young woman sitting nearby, making it a couple image. The face, hairstyle, nose and lips are meant to match the reference closely, so use a clear photo. This prompt suits Valentine's Day, Rose Day, anniversary posts and casual couple profile pictures. The original version is cut off just after introducing the woman, so add details about where she sits, what she wears and how they interact, for example 'sitting beside him in a pastel kurti, smiling as he offers her the rose'. The prompt names a sneaker brand and smartwatch brand, which can be kept or described generically. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the corner.
styleNotes: Soft, natural daylight under the tree gives gentle shadows and an even glow. Brown checks, white clothing and a single red rose sit against fresh green grass and foliage. The composition centres the seated man against the tree trunk, leaving space beside him for the second person.
tips: Finish the cut-off line by describing the woman's outfit and pose.
Have him offer the rose to her for a clear romantic moment.
Describe generic white sneakers and smartwatch if you prefer no brand names.

title: Light Blue Saree Couple Portrait on Beige Backdrop
description: This elegant studio prompt shows a young couple posing indoors against a soft beige backdrop. The woman wears a light blue embroidered sheer saree with silver jewellery and a blue maang tikka, smiling gracefully. The man wears a cream shirt with an open collar and looks at her affectionately. The simple background puts all the attention on the couple and their coordinated outfits. The mood is warm, graceful and refined, similar to a professional couple photoshoot. This prompt works well for engagement announcements, anniversary posts, wedding invitations, save-the-date cards and festive couple greetings such as Karwa Chauth or Diwali. Both faces are requested to match the uploaded image, so a clear photo of the couple together gives the best likeness. The neutral backdrop makes it easy to add text later for invitations or greetings. Because the prompt is short, you can add camera details such as 'medium shot, soft studio light from the left' for more control. The light blue and cream palette is calm and elegant, though it can be switched to pastel pink or ivory to suit your occasion.
styleNotes: Soft, diffused studio light gives even, flattering illumination. Light blue embroidery and silver jewellery pair with cream clothing against a warm beige backdrop. A medium two-person composition places the woman facing the camera and the man turned toward her, leaving clean space for added text.
tips: Add 'soft studio light from the left, medium shot' for more control over lighting.
Change the saree to pastel pink for an engagement theme.
Leave space on one side to add invitation or greeting text later.

title: Night Café Conversation Couple Among String Lights
description: This prompt shows a slim young man sitting in an outdoor café at night, wearing a loose black shirt, black baggy cargo trousers and a black smartwatch, with naturally styled dark hair. Lush green plants with small pink and white flowers surround the seating area, and the café behind is softly lit by warm string lights and lamps, creating a cosy, modern atmosphere. Across from him sits a young woman, created as a new character with long dark hair and a pastel casual outfit. The two are engaged in a lively conversation with warm, natural expressions. The image feels like a candid moment from a date night or a catch-up with a friend. It suits couple posts, café or restaurant promotions, short film concept art, and relaxed lifestyle content. Since the woman is created rather than based on a photo, you can add 'based on the second uploaded photo' if you want her to resemble a real partner. Use a clear reference of the man's face. The warm lights and dark outfits create a pleasant contrast that suits evening themes.
styleNotes: Warm string lights and lamps create a cosy, low-light glow with soft bokeh. Black clothing contrasts with pastel tones on the woman and pink-white flowers among green plants. A two-person composition at a café table shows both faces in profile or three-quarter view, with lights blurred behind.
tips: Add a second uploaded photo so the woman resembles your partner.
Place coffee cups and a dessert on the table for a fuller café scene.
Change the setting to a rooftop café with a city skyline.

title: Yellow Sari Portrait in Bamboo Grove at Golden Hour
description: This professional portrait prompt shows a young woman wearing a vibrant yellow sari with subtle metallic threads and a crisp white blouse. She stands among lush green bamboo foliage, smiling softly as she tucks a strand of hair behind her ear with her right hand. The image is captured at golden hour, with warm, soft directional light coming from the upper right and gentle rim lighting that outlines her silhouette. A shallow depth of field and strong bokeh blur the bamboo behind her, keeping her face and the saree sharp. The prompt is well structured with lighting direction specified, so results tend to be consistent. Add 'based on my uploaded photo' at the beginning if you want your own face. Use a clear reference photo with soft light. The bamboo setting is less common than flower gardens, giving the image a distinctive natural backdrop.
styleNotes: Warm golden-hour light from the upper right with subtle rim lighting defines the silhouette. Bright yellow and white clothing glows against deep bamboo greens. A medium composition with a hand-to-hair pose, shallow depth of field and strong bokeh isolates the subject from the leafy background.
tips: Add 'based on my uploaded photo' to use your own face.
Switch the yellow sari to orange or coral for a Sankranti theme.
Use a 2:3 vertical frame to show more of the tall bamboo.

title: Pink Lotus Bouquet Portrait in White Bordered Saree
description: This prompt creates a cinematic nature portrait of an Indian woman in a traditional white saree with a black border and a decorative blouse, sitting outdoors among lush green foliage. She holds a large bouquet of pink lotus flowers and stems close to her chest, smiling warmly while looking up and away. Traditional silver jewellery, including a necklace, bracelets and large earrings, adds a classic touch, and her hair is partly tied back with white flowers tucked in. The lotus bouquet is the visual centrepiece; you can change it to water lilies or marigolds depending on the occasion while keeping the same composition.

tips: Switch to a red-bordered white saree for a Durga Puja look.
Replace lotuses with marigolds for a Navratri or Diwali version.
Add a temple pond in the background for a devotional setting.

title: Teal Silk Saree Portrait on a Black Street Motorcycle

She rests her chin on her hand and looks straight at the camera with a confident, slight smile. A front-facing composition places the seated subject behind the headlight, with a chin-on-hand pose and shallow depth of field.

Change the saree to red and gold for a festive biker look.
Add 'based on my uploaded photo' for better face matching.

title: Waist-Deep Water Splash Portrait at Golden Sunset
description: This vertical 9:16 prompt creates a cinematic portrait of a person standing waist-deep in calm water during a golden-hour sunset. They wear a black long-sleeve shirt, stylish sunglasses and a subtle necklace, keeping the same face and hairstyle as the uploaded image. With one hand, they splash water upward, creating a dynamic arc of droplets that catch the sunlight and sparkle against the warm sky. The black shirt makes the subject a strong silhouette against the bright sunset. If you prefer a lighter look, switch to a white linen shirt. A small Prompt King signature is requested in the lower left corner.

A black shirt forms a strong silhouette against orange, gold and soft pink sky tones reflected in the water. A vertical composition places the subject centrally, with the splash arc creating a dynamic diagonal across the frame.
tips: Switch to a white linen shirt for a lighter, beachy look.
Remove sunglasses if you want your eyes visible for better likeness.
Change the setting to a lake with mountains for a different travel feel.

title: Double Exposure Style Poster With Two Poses
description: This poster prompt creates a stylised digital composition featuring the same young man twice in one frame. On the left, he walks toward the viewer wearing a black sweatshirt with white lettering, light blue jeans, black and white sneakers and round sunglasses. Behind him, a second, larger image shows him in profile wearing a light-coloured button-down shirt over a black T-shirt, with sunglasses and a watch. A layered composition places a full walking figure in the foreground left and a larger profile portrait behind, creating depth and a poster-style hierarchy.

Specify a colour for the background wash, such as soft blue or sepia.
Use a 2:3 vertical frame for a classic movie-poster shape.

title: South Indian Couple Movie Poster Style Multi-Pose Frame
description: This couple prompt creates a hyper-realistic, cinematic scene of a South Indian couple standing together in a modern artistic frame, styled like a contemporary movie poster. The man wears a trendy jacket and a watch, and the woman wears an elegant pastel dress, both smiling with natural romantic energy. Their poses change across the frame: a playful hug, holding hands, leaning close near a glass window with sunlight reflections, and a dreamy soft-focus moment. A multi-pose poster composition arranges several moments across the frame, with window reflections adding light and depth.
tips: Replace the signature with your names and wedding date for a save-the-date.
Change the woman's dress to a silk saree for a traditional version.
Use a 16:9 layout for a wide banner showing all poses.

title: Pencil Line Sketch Portrait on a Notebook Page
description: This prompt turns your photo into a pencil line drawing on a notebook page, showing the artwork as if it is still being made. The face is drawn in a photo-style sketch with intricate detail, matching the features of the uploaded image, using clean graphite lines on white paper. A hand appears in the frame, with the right fingers holding a pencil and an eraser, which adds a sense of the artist at work. tips: Change the signature text to your own name or the recipient's name.
Ask for coloured pencils instead of graphite for a softer, warmer drawing.
Add a coffee mug or spiral binding to make the desk scene more realistic.

title: Graphite Portrait Sketch on Marble With Phone Reference
description: This prompt creates a hyper-realistic graphite pencil portrait on clean, textured white paper, placed neatly on a marble table.
